# dsh-model-rotator

> [简体中文](./README.zh.md) | **English** | [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md)

Model auto-ranking and transparent failover for DeepSeek Harness.

When the current model hits a quota wall, an expired credential, a rate limit or
a transient network error, this plugin switches to the next-best configured
model **inside the same turn** — and the user sees an ordinary reply.

## What it does

1. **Discovers** every dialable `provider/model` on this machine
   (`ctx.llm.listProviders()` + each adapter's `listModels()`).
2. **Filters** out families that cannot answer a chat turn — embeddings,
   rerankers, ASR/TTS, OCR, image/video generation, content moderators and
   judges. Dialing one of those can only fail the turn and burn a cooldown slot
   that a real model could have used.
3. **Skips the image-reading mode.** dsh-vision-router wraps a chat route into a
   twin (`<provider>-vision`) whose only job is to add image reading to that same
   model. It is one model reachable twice, not a second one, so failing a text
   turn over into it would answer through the image pipeline — and the
   same-model preference below would rank the twin *first*. Those routes are
   therefore never candidates (a model id that merely *mentions* vision is still
   a chat model and stays). The model list can switch one back on when a wrapper
   name does not follow the convention.
4. **Ranks** the survivors by measured connectivity (Laplace-smoothed success
   rate), speed (median TTFT and throughput) and an active failure cooldown. A
   model that *is* the current one — or a close relative of it — on another
   provider carries a bonus, because the model you picked is usually the model
   you want, just from a working channel.
4. **Retries before it believes a failure.** A provider fails transiently: a
   rate-limit blip, a reset socket, an overloaded channel. One miss therefore
   does not count as a fault — the same model gets `retriesPerModel` more tries
   (2 by default, 0–5), `retryBackoffMs` apart (300 ms, then the double of it),
   before the failure is acted on. A retry is not a switch: it asks nothing and
   changes nothing.
5. **Fails over** at the `llm/stream` waterfall: attempt 1 is the untouched
   harness path; a failure that produced **no content at all** abandons that
   attempt, closes its upstream stream, and re-dispatches the next candidate as
   a fresh `ctx.llm.stream()` — the same model first while retries remain, then
   the ranking above.

Once any content chunk has been yielded the attempt is never retried — a second
attempt would duplicate visible text. That zero-content window is exactly the
retryable window.

A turn the caller cancelled (Stop, a deadline, a closed client) ends there: the
walk stops instead of burning attempts on a reply nobody will read.

### What counts as content

"Flow" is the switch that closes the retry window, so it means *the user has been
shown reply text* — and nothing weaker. A `reasoning-delta` is not content: the
harness folds reasoning away again when a retry happens, which is exactly what
makes retrying a reasoning-loop or reasoning-effort failure safe. Markup chunks
(`block-start`, or a `block-end` carrying a reasoning block) are not content
either. Counting those was a real defect: a live model looked dead because a
block-start closed the window and the very next error was taken as final.

### Automatic calls are not conversation turns

A compaction summary and a session title ride the same `llm/stream` seam but are
not a user turn. Their refusals are usually statements about *that lane* — a
proxy answering "bili owns compression here" — so asking a second provider to
carry the plumbing is the wrong reflex: it burns a real model on work nobody
reads, and it is the single loudest source of spurious switching. The plugin
therefore passes any call carrying `purpose: "compaction"` or
`purpose: "session-title"` straight through, error included. An unnamed call —
every ordinary turn — keeps failing over exactly as before.

## Announcing a switch

A switch is otherwise silent: the reply simply arrives from a different model.
The plugin now records it on the **Model switches** tab, beside 对话 / 轨迹 /
上下文, one row per switch — when it happened, which model answered instead, and
why:

```
14:07:31  modelscope/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash → trae/deepseek-v4.1-flash   (quota)
```

The tab reads the plugin's own record
(`GET /_dsh/model-rotator/switches?session=<id>`), so a switch costs **no
conversation context**. The conversation it belongs to is **injected by the Host**
— the cell registers `inject: (sessionId) => ({ sessionId })` and reads
`props.sessionId`, the same contract the built-in 对话 and 轨迹 tabs use (before
0.2.11 it read a field the Host never had, so the tab could not tell which
conversation it was in). Records are filed per conversation, and the session is
bound **where the switch happens** — `ctx.get('agents').currentInitiator()` answers
with the agent that started the call — rather than at the turn boundary, which is
process-wide: whichever conversation stops a turn next would otherwise drain the
queue and take everyone else's rows with it. A call with no live turn (a plugin
route, a host without `agents`) still records, with an empty session; empty-session
rows appear only in the every-session view.

When this conversation has no rows of its own but the log is not empty, the tab
falls back to **every conversation's** rows and labels the view as such, so history
never reads as "nothing happened".

If you also want the old line in the transcript, turn `noticeSwitch` on and the
plugin posts it as before — `模型已切换：A → B`, with the failure kind in brackets
when it is known (`(quota)`, `(rate-limit)`).

| Behaviour | |
|-----------|--|
| Default | **not posted** (`noticeSwitch: false`). The record is on the tab; the row is optional |
| Shape | the host's own notice mechanism: a `user/message` whose source is `{ kind: 'model-rotator/switch', form: 'notice', summary }`. The conversation UI renders that form as a context row, not as something you typed |
| Timing | the notice row is posted at the turn boundary, via `agent/turn-stopping` + `agent.steer`. The switch already happened and the answer is already streaming, so announcing it mid-turn would insert a row in the middle of the reply it describes (the *record* is not written here — see above) |
| Scope | the root conversation only. A switch inside a subagent transcript is somebody else's log |
| On | `noticeSwitch: true` (or the settings-page toggle) |

The event type is deliberately **not** a private one. The persistence reader
refuses to interpret a session log containing a type it does not know
(`dsh-session`'s `KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES`), so an invented event would make a
log carrying it fail to load. `user/message` is known, and `notice` is a form the
client already understands — the same pair the harness uses for its own
"model changed" line.

The vendor half of the label is the provider's own `displayName` when the host
publishes one (硅基流动 for `siliconflow`), falling back to the route id. The id
stays visible in the model list, because that is what `config.json`'s lists use.

## Asking before switching

A failover replaces the model the user picked, and it can do so silently. The
default is therefore to ask first: when the current model fails with no content,
the plugin raises a question in the conversation through the harness's own
human-interaction seam (`ctx.userQuestions.askTimed()`), offering **切换** and
**保持当前模型**.

| Reply | Outcome |
|-------|---------|
| 切换 (or any answer that is not a refusal) | the next candidate serves the turn |
| 保持当前模型 (or a typed refusal — 不/否/取消/拒绝/no/cancel/stop/…) | nothing further is dialed; the turn ends on the original error |
| no answer inside the window | the switch proceeds — the request was time-boxed, not vetoed |

The question is raised **once per turn**: approving the first switch covers the
rest of that walk, so a cascade of dead models does not become a cascade of
identical cards. The wait is 20 s by default and configurable.

**Two failures are no longer asked about.** An exhausted balance (`quota`) and a
request the provider refuses as unsupported (`unsupported`) are deterministic
dead ends: the money does not come back inside the window and the next dispatch is
refused identically. Declining there cannot keep the model working — it only ends
the turn, after a card and a wait — so those switch on their own, and the tab
still records why. **Auth keeps its question**: a 403 is often a burst-rate proxy
that clears, so "keep my model and let me retry" is a real choice there.

Failover is deliberately fail-open. If the seam is missing, the ask throws, the
turn has no live root agent (a delegated sub-agent has nobody to answer), or the
timeout is reached, the walk continues unconfirmed. An unattended harness must
not stall on a card nobody is watching.

## The failure kind decides the rest

A failure is not just a string: it is classified, and the class decides how long
the model sits out.

**A quota wall is not a rate limit.** `429 insufficient balance` and `429 too many
requests` are the same HTTP status, yet one clears in seconds and the other does
not until the allowance resets. The plugin reads the kind out of the message -
`insufficient quota`, `out of credits, please top up`, `余额不足，请充值`, `额度已用尽`,
`402 Payment Required` and similar - and treats a balance problem differently:

| Kind | Rest | Retry first? |
|------|------|--------------|
| `quota` | until the next day at `quotaCooldownHour` (00:00 local by default), and never less than `quotaCooldownMs` | no - the balance does not refill between two dispatches |
| `auth` | ordinary exponential backoff | yes - a 403 from a burst-rate proxy does recover |
| `unsupported` | ordinary exponential backoff | no - the same provider returns the same refusal to the same request |
| `rate-limit` | ordinary exponential backoff | yes |
| `server` / `network` | ordinary exponential backoff | yes |
| unclassified | ordinary exponential backoff | yes |

`unsupported` is the request-shape refusal — *"provider X model Y does not
support reasoning effort high"*, *"unsupported model"*. It is decided before the
request is read, so the retry dispatches would repeat it verbatim; skipping them
is what turns a session-level mismatch into one switch instead of three.

An authentication failure is classified *before* a bare `429`, because waiting
never repairs a key: for `429 invalid api key` the honest name is `auth`, not
`rate-limit`. The distinction is recorded, not acted on - both take the same
backoff; only `quota` changes the policy.

The rest is at least "the following day at `quotaCooldownHour`". A wall hit at
23:50 still pays the full `quotaCooldownMs` floor, so it returns at 11:50 the
next day rather than ten minutes later at midnight.

`model_rotator_status` shows it: the ranking marks such a row `QUOTA-REST` (with
the remaining hours) rather than `COOLDOWN`, the `type` column names the class,
and a `last failure seen` line lists each model's last error with its kind.

Measured state - counters, the last error and kind, the cooldown horizon -
**outlives the process**, because the restart a user performs right after being
told their balance is gone must not undo the rest. It is written to
`%DSH_HOME%\model-rotator\stats.json` (or `dirname(config.json)`), debounced, and
read back once on first use. Latency samples deliberately stay in memory: they
are a 20-sample sliding window, and a stale window is worse than a short one.
`statsPersistTtlMs` bounds the age of a restored file (24 h by default; 0
disables the file entirely).

## What it does NOT do

It never reads, writes or rewrites model/provider configuration. It does not
touch `cordis.patch.yml`, `agent-default-model`, `llm-pi-ai` or any provider
registration. It only observes the stream waterfall at runtime.

## Non-chat filtering

The harness adapter strips the catalog's own `wire: 'chat'` marker before
handing rows to `listModels()`, so capability cannot be read off the row.
Name matching is the available signal, and it is deliberately narrow — a
pattern must not touch a chat model that merely mentions a modality
(`Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct` is chat; `Z-Image-Turbo` is not).

The filter denies families across vectors/ranking, speech, image generation,
document parsing and safety classifiers — in both the plain and the `-vision`
provider variants. It runs during discovery, so the count the plugin reports
(`discovered`) is already the post-filter pool, and a machine's numbers depend
entirely on which providers are configured. Ask a live install rather than
quoting a figure from here:

```
model_rotator_status      # "discovered" = candidates after this filter
```

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `model_rotator_status` | Read-only: enabled state, config path, discovered pool, measured ranking. |
| `model_rotator_benchmark` | Probe candidates with a minimal live request to refresh TTFT/throughput and cooldowns (bounded, spends a little quota). |
| `model_rotator_select` | Pin/unpin the head of the failover order; the ranking still decides the tail. |

The status tool also reports the two manual lists and the vision rule, so a model
the user can see in the directory but not in the ranking can be explained without
reading the code:

```
  disabled models  : workbuddy/hy3
  vision twins     : never a candidate (the dsh-vision-router mode wraps a model, it is not a second one)
  model list route : /_dsh/model-rotator/models (GET the grouped list; POST {key, enabled} to switch one off or on)
```

## Configuration

Optional, at `%DSH_HOME%\model-rotator\config.json` (hot-reloaded on change).
Every field has a safe default, so the plugin works with no file at all.

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "allowImageFailover": false,
  "maxCandidates": 4,
  "cooldownBaseMs": 60000,
  "maxCooldownMs": 1800000,
  "quotaCooldownMs": 43200000,
  "quotaCooldownHour": 0,
  "statsPersistTtlMs": 86400000,
  "confirmSwitch": true,
  "confirmTimeoutMs": 20000,
  "adoptSwitchedModel": true,
  "retriesPerModel": 2,
  "retryBackoffMs": 300,
  "preferSameModel": true,
  "weights": { "connectivity": 0.5, "speed": 0.3 },
  "excludeProviders": [],
  "excludeModels": [],
  "excludePatterns": [],
  "disabledModels": [],
  "enabledModels": [],
  "pinned": ""
}
```

- `enabled` — master switch.
- `allowImageFailover` — image turns are skipped by default: a text-only
  fallback cannot read an image, so failing over there would produce a wrong
  answer rather than a missing one.
- `maxCandidates` — cap per turn (hard ceiling 8).
- `cooldownBaseMs` / `maxCooldownMs` — exponential backoff bounds
  (`base * 2^(n-1)`, clamped to `max`).
- `quotaCooldownMs` — minimum rest after a quota wall (default 12 h, ceiling
  26 h). Counted from the failure, not rounded to the hour.
- `quotaCooldownHour` — local hour (0–23) at which an exhausted model may be
  tried again (default 0 = next midnight). The rest always reaches that hour of
  the *following* day, so a wall hit at 00:05 does not revive the same evening.
- `statsPersistTtlMs` — how long measured state survives a restart (default
  24 h, ceiling 30 d; 0 = do not persist).
- `confirmSwitch` — ask in the conversation before leaving a failed model
  (default `true`; see above).
- `confirmTimeoutMs` — how long that question waits before switching anyway
  (default 20000; clamped to 1 s … 10 min).
- `adoptSwitchedModel` — after a switch, make the model that actually
  answered the model of *this session*, so the conversation header shows what is
  really in use (default `true`). Session-local only: no provider configuration
  and no saved default is touched, and the harness's own "model changed" notice
  then names the right pair.
- `retriesPerModel` — extra tries the same model gets before its failure is
  believed (default 2, hard ceiling 5). A retry needs no confirmation because it
  does not change the model.
- `retryBackoffMs` — pause before each retry (default 300; the nth retry waits
  n times this, capped at 10 s).
- `preferSameModel` — rank the same model on another provider first, then close
  relatives, then the measured ranking (default `true`).
- `windowGuard` — skip a failover candidate whose context window cannot hold
  this conversation plus a reply (default `true`). The window comes from the
  adapter that owns the route (`resolveModelInfo`), not from the catalog: a
  profile may declare a window, but only the buyer fits the request. A route
  whose adapter publishes no window is never skipped, a harness that cannot
  report the conversation's pressure gets no guard at all, and a route on the
  same window as the current one is exempt - the guard decides about *moving*.
  A held-back candidate is reported as `window` in the model list, and the
  status tool states the pressure it measured.
- `noticeSwitch` — *also* post the one-line switch notice in the conversation
  (default `false`; the switch record is on the Model switches tab either way —
  see "Announcing a switch" above).
- `weights` — connectivity vs speed in the score.
- `excludeProviders` / `excludeModels` — keep specific routes out of the pool.
- `excludePatterns` — extra regex sources appended to the non-chat deny list.
  An invalid pattern is skipped, never fatal.
- `disabledModels` — models switched off from the model list on the settings
  page. Each entry is `"provider/model"` or a bare model id (which matches every
  channel serving that model). A per-row entry outranks the channel rule.
- `disabledProviders` — whole channels switched off from a channel header's
  button. One entry per provider id. Closing a channel also clears the per-row
  `enabledModels` entries inside it, so the switch cannot be silently undone;
  enabling a row afterwards writes a new entry that does take effect.
- `enabledModels` — the opposite, and the only way to put a vision twin back into
  rotation when its wrapper name does not follow the `<provider>-vision`
  convention. Written by the same switch.
- `pinned` — preferred head of the failover order.

## Settings page

The plugin ships both halves of a real settings page: the server-side `Config`
schema the Harness serves for the `model-rotator` namespace, and a browser
bundle (`client.js`, declared through `dsh.client` plus `exports["./client"]`)
that renders the form in two host cells from one component:

- **Settings → Model failover**, its own entry in the Settings navigation
  (`settings.section`, id `model-rotator`, order 20). The Harness renders the
  plugin settings pages this way; the shell hands the cell `{ close }` and
  filters by the registration id.
- the **model-rotator** card in the Plugins panel (`plugins.item`), which
  renders the same form as its card body.

Both cells only appear while the host actually serves the namespace. Only the
fields that are safe to personalize appear there:

| Field | |
|-------|--|
| `enabled` | master switch |
| `allowImageFailover` | also fail over image turns |
| `maxCandidates` | models one turn may try |
| `cooldownBaseMs` | backoff base |
| `maxCooldownMs` | backoff cap |
| `quotaCooldownMs` | minimum rest after a quota wall |
| `quotaCooldownHour` | hour at which an exhausted model returns |
| `statsPersistTtlMs` | how long measurements survive a restart |
| `confirmSwitch` | ask before switching |
| `confirmTimeoutMs` | how long that question waits |
| `adoptSwitchedModel` | show the switched model on this session |
| `retriesPerModel` | tries before a failure is believed |
| `retryBackoffMs` | pause between those tries |
| `preferSameModel` | same model on another channel first |

`weights.connectivity` / `weights.speed` are **not** on the page: the form
model stages one top-level key at a time, so nested values stay in
`config.json`. Long lists meant for editing by hand or by tool —
`excludeProviders`, `excludeModels`, `excludePatterns`, `pinned` — stay
there too.

### The model list

Below the settings form the same page renders **模型列表 / Models**: every
discovered `provider/model`, with its health and a switch — plus a switch on each
channel header that closes **every model behind that provider in one click**. The
pair of levels is deliberate: a channel switch is the useful action when a key or
an endpoint dies (everything behind it is unreachable at once), while a row switch
is what you reach for when one model is bad and its neighbours are fine.

The list is split into two sections, because they answer different questions:

| Section | Contents |
|---------|----------|
| **对话渠道** (chat channels) | the routes failover actually ranks — the candidates |
| **识图模式** (vision mode) | the `<provider>-vision` twins, each labelled with the channel it wraps (`amd-vision → amd`) |

**Three fold levels, all independent**: each section, each provider channel inside
it, and the roster as a whole. Chat channels start open and the vision section
starts **closed**: there are as many twins as everything else on this machine
(453 of 906 rows in the last live scan), and none of them is ever a candidate, so
leaving them folded is what makes the page readable at all. Two buttons —
**全部展开 / 全部收起** — open or close every section and channel at once.

Closing a channel writes a single `disabledProviders` entry rather than one entry
per model — the channel is the unit you are thinking in, and a list of a hundred
ids would be unreadable and impossible to undo honestly. Four rules keep the two
levels from fighting:

- the header button is labelled from the channel's own flag, not from whether its
  rows happen to be in rotation — a channel whose rows are all off for per-row
  reasons is still **open**, and one closed from the header must offer the action
  that reopens it;
- a closed channel offers **启用本渠道**, and the row switches underneath stay
  available for putting one model back without reopening the whole channel;
- closing a channel clears the stale per-row overrides inside it (so the button
  does what it says), and a row you switch on **afterwards** wins (a fresh,
  deliberate statement beats an older blanket one);
- a **vision** channel carries no channel switch at all. Its rows are kept out by
  the twin rule, which the channel flag cannot lift, so a button there would write
  an entry that changes nothing while reading like a promise. Use a row switch.

The channel label is the vendor name the host publishes on the registered route
(`硅基流动` for `siliconflow`), falling back to the route id when a route
publishes no label; the id is kept in parentheses when the two differ.

A folded line never hides what matters: every channel header (and every section
header) prints the same tally — derived from the rows, not from a host-supplied
counter, so the two layers cannot disagree. A collapsed provider still says
whether it is healthy. The page also rebuilds the sections from `channels` when
the host does not send `groups`, because the two halves are versioned together
but not *loaded* together.

```
▼ 对话渠道                    453 个 · 可用 447 · 冷却 6 · 关闭 0
    ▼ 硅基流动 (siliconflow)     65 个 · 可用 63 · 冷却 2 · 关闭 0   [关闭本渠道]
        ● deepseek-v4.1-flash   冷却中   retry in 511m · rate-limit      [关闭]
    ▶ cline                    55 个 · 可用 55 · 冷却 0 · 关闭 0   [关闭本渠道]
▶ 识图模式（vision-router 创建）  453 个 · 可用 0 · 冷却 0 · 关闭 453
```

| Column | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| dot + label | `可用` (nothing resting, no failure on record), `未测` (never tried), `冷却中`, `额度耗尽` (until the next-day boundary), `异常` (last attempt failed), `已关闭` |
| detail | TTFT and success/attempt counts, or the remaining rest, or why the row is out of rotation |
| switch | 关闭 / 启用 |

The reasons a row can be out of rotation are named rather than collapsed:
`manual` (switched off here), `vision` (the vision-router twin, a default the
switch can overrule), `provider` / `excluded` (from `config.json`),
`non-chat` (a family that cannot answer a chat turn), `combo` (a virtual
route). Only the first two are switchable from the page — the rest are
structural or owned by the file.

The roster reads its data over HTTP rather than through the settings form. Its
route is `/_dsh/model-rotator/models`: `GET` returns the grouped list
(`groups` = the two sections, `channels` = one entry per provider carrying its
`kind` and the `sourceChannel` a twin wraps, `models` = every row; a section and a
channel carry the same `models`/`ok`/`resting`/`off` counters, so one row shape
renders both and a folded line still reports its state),
`POST {key, enabled, scope}` flips one switch and answers with the refreshed list
(`scope: "provider"` for a channel header, omitted or `"model"` for a row). The
form carries the user's *policy* (how many candidates, how long to wait), while
this is a *roster* that changes whenever a provider republishes — and its rows
save one at a time, straight to `config.json`, so a refresh cannot discard a
half-typed number above it. The route is registered through
`ctx.inject(['webServer'], …)` because the host publishes the web server
*after* plugins load; it is auth-gated by the host exactly like every other
non-public path.

The two layers merge as **defaults < config.json < settings page**, and the page
wins only for the keys it actually owns: a key the page never sets still comes
from the file. `model_rotator_select` never writes a page-owned key back into
`config.json`, so a stale file value can never masquerade as authoritative.

The namespace is the plugin's cordis id (`model-rotator`) — a server half
without a client half shows nothing, which is why both ship together. A host
that ships no generic settings form has to be given one: the page is the
plugin's own React form, so the fields above are exactly the ones this bundle
stages, not every key the `Config` schema accepts.

The `Config` export needs schemastery *inside the host process*. The plugin
ships its own copy under `vendor/node_modules/` and loads that copy by absolute
path when a bare import cannot be resolved from the plugin's real path, which is
what makes the page appear on installs where the manifest link resolves outside
the profile's `node_modules`.

`model_rotator_status` ends with an **in force right now** block that lists the
merged value of every effective key next to the layer it came from
(`[default]`, `[config.json]` or `[settings page]`), so what is actually
driving the plugin is visible without reading two files and doing the merge in
your head. Further lines report the live picture: `ask channel` (whether the
pre-switch question can actually reach you, and why not when it cannot),
`adopt on switch`, `model in use now` (read from this session's request
header), `session switch` (whether the plugin can record the swapped model on
the session), `failure verdict` and `switch order`.

## Install

From npm (recommended):

```
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-model-rotator
```

From GitHub:

```
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:chimneyQ/dsh-model-rotator
```

From a local checkout, the same command takes the directory instead:

```
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <path-to-this-directory>
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so its `cordis.patch.yml` wires the
plugin automatically, and it has no dependencies to build. A full app restart is
required for the host to load it.

To confirm the host actually wired it up (a failed first install can leave the
dependency recorded without adding the plugin to `dsh.profile.bundles`), check
that `dsh.profile.bundles` in `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/desktop/package.json` lists
`dsh-model-rotator`.

## Test

```
node test-offline.mjs     # failover + consent gate, against a stub harness
node test-settings.mjs    # server-side settings contract, against the host rules
node test-client.mjs      # browser bundle: loader shape, card registration, fields
```

All three run with no network and no DSH process. `test-offline.mjs` (135
assertions) covers failure-then-retry, no-retry-once-text-flows, image-turn skip,
all-candidates-failed, cooldown accounting, aborted-signal passthrough,
non-chat filtering through a real waterfall, tool registration, and the consent
gate (prompt off, approved, declined by button and by typed text, timeout,
one-question-per-walk, and every fail-open path). Failure classification and the
quota rest are asserted through the exported `classifyFailureKind()` and
`quotaRestUntil()` seams — day boundaries, the pre-midnight floor, a month
rollover, "a quota wall never burns a retry", "an unsupported request is not
retried", and the on-disk round trip including TTL expiry and a malformed file.
The non-chat assertions call the exported `isNonChatModelId()` seam so they
test the shipped pattern table rather than a copy of it.

Two later scenarios pin the defects fixed after the first live run: **16** — a
`-vision` provider is never dialed, while a *model named* something-vision
stays a candidate, and switching a twin back on really does restore it; and
**17** — a reasoning-only attempt still gets its retries, text still closes the
walk, and an empty `block-start` counts as nothing. The list route is driven
end to end in **14** through an opt-in HTTP harness (GET, POST, the file write,
a bare model id, an empty key, a hand-edited file, and the whole channel switch
including its precedence rules). **16** additionally
asserts the two page sections — the twins counted apart from the chat channels,
each naming the channel it wraps — and **15** that a `purpose: "compaction"` call
is passed through untouched while an ordinary turn still fails over.

# `dsh-feishu-notify` — DSH (Cordis) adapter

Feishu (Lark) cards from **DSH** when a turn ends, when the harness needs your decision, or when it
needs an **answer** from you (including plan review).
Sending goes through the shared `feishu-notify` CLI, which resolves the webhook from **your own
config** — this package ships **no address** and never talks HTTP itself.

> **Status: implemented, not yet published.** Everything below is measured against DSH
> **0.2.0-rc.2** on this machine. `packages/dsh` was linked into a throwaway profile (**since
> deleted**) and the turn-end path (card arrival, `--channel dsh` resolution, uninstall) was verified
> end-to-end; the
> `user-questions/request` waterfall is implemented against the shipped `.d.ts` and covered by stub
> tests, but **has not been observed firing inside a live DSH** (see “Verified vs not” at the end).

## What it does

Two subscriptions — `session/event` (the post-commit fire-and-forget feed) and the blocking
`user-questions/request` waterfall — mapped to cards:

| Hook | Card | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `session/event` → `turn/end`, `reason.kind === 'completed'` | ✅ 任务完成 | turn wall-clock, model, folded per-turn tokens, session-cumulative output |
| `session/event` → `turn/end`, `kind === 'error'` | ❌ 任务失败 | `LlmFailure` message / code / HTTP status |
| `session/event` → `turn/end`, `kind === 'aborted'` | ⏸ 任务已中断 | cancellation cause (`user` / `parent` / `hook` / `disposed`) |
| `session/event` → `turn/end`, `kind === 'blocked'` | 🚫 任务被拦下 | |
| `session/event` → `turn/end`, `kind === 'max-tokens'` | ⚠️ 已达 token 上限 | |
| `session/event` → `turn/end`, any other `kind` | ❓ 未知状态 | never throws; the raw `kind` is printed verbatim |
| `session/event` → `approval/asked` | 🔔 需要你决定 | tool name + asker's reason |
| `session/event` → `tool/result` with `isError` | ❌ 工具失败 | **off by default** (`toolFailures: true` to enable) |
| `user-questions/request` | ❓ 需要你回答 | the question list (`header` / `question` / options) |
| `user-questions/request` with `intent.kind === 'plan-review'` | ❓ 需要你回答 · 计划待批 | the same card, marked, plus the `approve` label |

Metrics are **omitted, never invented**: no model → no model line, no token usage → no token line.
There is deliberately **no tok/s** — DSH only gives turn wall-clock time (tool waits included), and
dividing by that would be a meaningless number.

## `user-questions/request` is a **blocking** waterfall (read this before changing it)

DSH's only real “the harness needs an answer from you” hook is the Cordis **waterfall**
`user-questions/request` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-user-questions/lib/types/types.d.ts:145`):

```ts
'user-questions/request'(this: Scoped<Agent>, request: AskUserQuestionRequestEvent,
                         next: () => Promise<AskUserQuestionAnswer>): Promise<AskUserQuestionAnswer>
```

Two rules keep this adapter transparent:

1. **Fire-and-forget.** The handler starts the `spawn` and returns; it never `await`s the send.
   Awaiting an external process inside a blocking hook is how one plugin turns its own network
   round-trip into someone else's latency.
2. **Always delegate.** `next()` must be called and its promise returned — in a Cordis waterfall a
   listener that does not call `next()` **vetoes the rest of the chain**
   (`@deepseek-ai/cordis/lib/index.js:317-331`), so the real answering UI would never see the
   question and `ask()` would resolve with a bogus answer.

Net effect: the handler is transparent (the promise you get back is exactly `next()`'s), and the
only thing we add before delegating is a `spawn`. See `tests/user-questions.test.mjs` for the
falsifiable version of this — a hanging sender promise must not stop `next()` from being called
synchronously.

## Not implemented (and why)

- **Answering from the card.** The approval/question waterfalls belong to the DSH client UI. Cards
  are one-way (same as the opencode adapter) — we notify, we never answer.
- **`agent/turn-stopping` as “turn finished”.** It fires *before* the turn closes and another listener
  may `agent.steer()` it back to life — using it would send false “done” cards.
- **`sessionStats` / TPS / generation-only time.** That projection is mounted by the `dsh-web-app`
  bundle only, so non-web profiles don't have it.
- **`session/event → user-question-reply`.** The original task design assumed this; it is wrong.
  `user-question-reply` is a `MessageSourceMap` member
  (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-user-questions/lib/types/types.d.ts:104`), i.e. `user/message.source.kind`, not a
  session event — registering that name would never fire. The real hook is the waterfall above.

## Config

Only two keys; the webhook and channel definitions still live in the CLI's own config
(`~/.config/feishu-notify/config.json`):

```yaml
# profile cordis.patch.yml — a patch config replaces the whole config
- id: feishu-notify
  name: dsh-feishu-notify
  config:
    channel: dsh          # the --channel name, not an address
    toolFailures: false
```

Every card class is on by default (turn end, approvals, user questions / plan review); only
`toolFailures` is opt-in because a single turn can produce dozens of failing tool calls.

## Which bot do the cards go to? (the `dsh` channel)

`channel: dsh` is a **name**, never an address — the CLI resolves it from *your* config. Today
`dsh` and `default` point at **the same bot** on the machine this was built on (verified: their
webhook fingerprints match, `opencode`'s does not — see the snippet below). That is a deliberate
current choice, not a defect: one bot, per-adapter channel names, so the wiring is already in place.

To give DSH its own bot later, only the CLI config changes — nothing in this plugin:

```bash
# 1. create the bot in the Feishu group, copy its webhook, then feed it on stdin so it never
#    lands in argv / shell history (the plugin still ships no address):
printf '%s' 'https://open.feishu.cn/open-apis/bot/v2/hook/…' \
  | feishu-notify-cli channel add dsh --webhook-stdin --force

# 2. verify reachability + see the effective wiring (also prints each channel's masked address):
feishu-notify-cli doctor --channel dsh
```

`--force` is required because the channel already exists. After the swap the plugin needs no
restart of its config — it only ever passes `--channel dsh`.

> **Checking whether two channels share a bot.** `doctor` (and `channel list`) print a **masked**
> address: the unique part of a Feishu webhook is the *token* (`…/bot/v2/hook/<token>`), and that is
> redacted — so two channels on one bot look exactly like two channels on different bots, and no
> same-address call-out exists today. If you want to compare without printing the address, fingerprint
> it locally (Node is already a dependency of this project; output is 8 hex chars + the channel name):
>
> ```bash
> node -e '
> const fs = require("fs"), crypto = require("crypto");
> const file = process.env.HOME + "/.config/feishu-notify/config.json";
> const c = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
> for (const [name, entry] of Object.entries(c.channels ?? {})) {
>   console.log(crypto.createHash("sha256").update(String(entry.webhook)).digest("hex").slice(0, 8), name);
> }
> '
> ```
>
> Equal fingerprints ⇒ same bot. Adding that call-out inside `doctor` would be a change in
> `packages/cli`, which is outside this adapter's scope.

## Install (once published)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> pnpm add dsh-feishu-notify
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the plugin manager appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles`
automatically. For local development, point the dependency at this directory instead
(`link:` / `--dsh-dev-dir` via `feishu-notify-cli install --target dsh`).

## Uninstall

`dsh plugin --profile <name> remove dsh-feishu-notify` also drops it from `dsh.profile.bundles`.
If you added an `- id: feishu-notify` override to the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`, delete that
line too — a patch matching no row only produces a startup warning, but it is still litter.

## Troubleshooting

Failures are logged at **ERROR level unconditionally** (no debug flag gates them):

- **No card at all.** Check the DSH log for `dsh-feishu-notify: 找不到发送端 feishu-notify`.
  The sender is resolved on every send: `FEISHU_NOTIFY_BIN` → `~/.local/bin/feishu-notify` → `PATH`
  → give up. If `FEISHU_NOTIFY_BIN` is set but not executable, it is **not** silently ignored —
  that error means exactly what it says.
- **Cards go to the wrong bot.** The `--channel` name must exist in the CLI config; note this
  adapter, unlike the opencode one, does **not** retry without `--channel`.
- **No “需要你回答” card.** That hook is a **scope-filtered** waterfall: listeners tagged with an
  agent scope only see that agent's questions, while an untagged listener (this plugin registers on
  the root context) is admitted globally (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope/lib/index.js:329-337`). If you
  re-register it from an agent-scoped context you narrow it deliberately. Note we are a *listener*,
  not an answerer — if no UI claims a request DSH still reports `NO_PROVIDER`, exactly as it would
  without us.
- **Version drift.** Built against DSH 0.2.0-rc.2. No `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer is declared on
  purpose (rc versions in peer ranges are a minefield); every service is duck-typed.

## Development

```bash
npm test -w packages/dsh
```

No DSH runtime is needed: pure mapping functions and a fake-`ctx` harness cover the event mapping,
plus a real `spawn` against a stub executable that proves the argv contract.

## Verified vs not

| Area | State |
|---|---|
| `turn/end` → card, real profile, `--channel dsh` resolution, uninstall | ✅ observed end-to-end in a throwaway profile |
| `user-questions/request` mapping + fire-and-forget / `next()` contract | ⚠ stub tests only — **never observed firing in a live DSH** (no real `ask_user_question` was driven through a live profile) |
| Root-context listener admitted by the scoped waterfall | ⚠ read from `dsh-scope` source (untagged ⇒ global), not observed at runtime |
| `approval/asked`, `tool/result`, the other four `turn/end` reason kinds | ⚠ stub tests only |
| Install from the npm registry (`dsh plugin … add dsh-feishu-notify`) | ⚠ package is not published yet |
| DSH versions other than 0.2.0-rc.2 | ⚠ not tested |

# feishu-notify (monorepo)

Feishu (Lark) bot notifications for local AI agents — one config layer, one sender, one
adapter per agent. **No webhook is ever compiled in**: the address is resolved at send
time from the user's own config, and if it cannot be resolved the sender exits `2` with
guidance instead of delivering to somebody else's bot.

This repository is a **single repo with three packages** (`npm` workspaces): the CLI is built, and
both adapters (opencode, DSH) are built and awaiting publication.

## Packages

| Package | Path | Status | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `feishu-notify-cli` | [`packages/cli`](./packages/cli) | ✅ **implemented** (not on npm yet) | The core: the `feishu-notify` bash sender + the `feishu-notify-cli` Node config/diagnostics/`install` CLI. Ships both binaries. |
| `opencode-feishu-notify` | [`packages/opencode`](./packages/opencode) | ✅ **implemented** (not on npm yet) | opencode v2 plugin: cards on turn end / permission / form, routed with `--channel opencode`. Holds **no** webhook — it calls the sender, which resolves the address from your config. |
| `dsh-feishu-notify` | [`packages/dsh`](./packages/dsh) | ✅ **implemented** (not on npm yet) | DSH (Cordis) bundle: cards on turn end / approval / **user questions & plan review**, routed with `--channel dsh`. Also holds no webhook. |

Legend: ✅ implemented and measured · ⚠ assumed / not directly observed · ✖ not implemented.
Per-area verification state (including what is *not* yet observed in a live DSH) is in
[`packages/dsh/README.md`](./packages/dsh/README.md#verified-vs-not).

## Layout

```
.
├── package.json                 # private root: workspaces ["packages/*"], test fan-out
├── LICENSE                      # MIT (every package carries the same copy)
├── README.md / README.zh-CN.md  # this file — repo overview
└── packages/
    ├── cli/                     # the implemented core package
    │   ├── package.json         #   name: feishu-notify-cli, bin ×2, files whitelist
    │   ├── bin/feishu-notify    #   the sender (bash)
    │   ├── bin/feishu-notify-cli#   config/init/channel/doctor/resolve/footer/install (Node)
    │   ├── lib/                 #   config resolution, commands, sender, wiring self-check, install targets, secret gate
    │   ├── tests/               #   assertions + byte-exact golden fixtures
    │   └── README.md            #   the full documentation for the package
    ├── opencode/                # the implemented adapter (not published yet)
    │   ├── package.json         #   name: opencode-feishu-notify, main → src/feishu-notify.ts
    │   ├── src/feishu-notify.ts #   the plugin (no webhook: passes --channel, the CLI resolves it)
    │   ├── scripts/deploy.mjs   #   copy the plugin to the live dir; --check is a drift gate
    │   ├── tests/               #   module / channel / sender-resolution / routing / live-hash suites
    │   └── README.md            #   install, events, channel semantics, troubleshooting
    └── dsh/                     # the implemented DSH/Cordis adapter (not published yet)
        ├── package.json         #   name: dsh-feishu-notify, dsh.bundle.patch → cordis.patch.yml
        ├── cordis.patch.yml     #   the bundle layer: one `insert` row for the plugin (channel: dsh)
        ├── lib/index.js         #   turn end / approval / tool failure / user questions (no webhook)
        ├── tests/               #   pure mapping + fake-ctx harness + real-spawn stub executable
        └── README.md            #   events, the blocking user-questions waterfall, channel/bot, limits
```

## Start here

The complete documentation — install, config format, command reference, agent
compatibility, security model, rollback — lives in the package READMEs:

- [`packages/cli/README.md`](./packages/cli/README.md) (English) · [`README.zh-CN.md`](./packages/cli/README.zh-CN.md) (中文)
- [`packages/opencode/README.md`](./packages/opencode/README.md) (English) · [`README.zh-CN.md`](./packages/opencode/README.zh-CN.md) (中文)
- [`packages/dsh/README.md`](./packages/dsh/README.md) (English) · [`README.zh-CN.md`](./packages/dsh/README.zh-CN.md) (中文)

Quick version (install the CLI **globally** — two real binaries in one bin directory; do not point
your wiring at a development checkout, which is how the 2026-10-18 rename made notifications fail
silently):

```sh
npm i -g feishu-notify-cli            # puts both commands on PATH
feishu-notify-cli init                # asks for your webhook, verifies with a test card
feishu-notify-cli doctor              # wiring self-check (sender/resolver/Node, dangling symlinks) + per-channel reachability
feishu-notify-cli install --dry-run   # show what would be merged into your agent configs; writes nothing
feishu-notify-cli install             # wire it up: claude-code writes; opencode is declared once its package is published; dsh is gated
```

Add `--channel <name>` when you want a target pinned to a specific bot: for Claude Code it is
appended to the hook command, for opencode it is written into `options.channel`. Without it, each
caller uses your config's `activeChannel`.

From a clone (this is also the state until the package is published):

```sh
node packages/cli/bin/feishu-notify-cli init
# or, from inside the package:
cd packages/cli && node bin/feishu-notify-cli init
```

## Develop

```sh
npm test                      # from the repo root: fans out to every workspace
cd packages/cli && npm test   # the CLI suite
cd packages/opencode && npm test   # the plugin suite (includes the live drift gate)
cd packages/dsh && npm test   # the DSH adapter suite (no DSH runtime needed)
npm run secret-scan           # the publish gate (whole-repo git index + the CLI tarball)
```

`npm test` from the root runs the workspace `test` scripts (`packages/cli`,
`packages/opencode` and `packages/dsh`). The plugin suite's live-hash gate **skips** on a machine where the plugin was
never deployed (`deploy --check` exit `2`); it fails only on real drift. The secret gate
deliberately scans the **whole repository index** (not just the current directory) so that neither
the root files nor the other packages can drift out of its view.

## License

MIT — see [`LICENSE`](./LICENSE).

# dsh-restart **简体中文** | [English](README_EN.md)
> 装完插件总要重启 DeepSeek Harness 才生效，而界面上没有任何重启入口。 > 这个插件在标题栏的「应用 / 编辑」右侧补上一个「重启」按钮，点两下，九秒后回来。 > > *Installing a plugin always means restarting DeepSeek Harness, yet the UI has no > restart entry point. This plugin puts a Restart button next to the Application / > Edit menus in the title bar. Click twice, and you are back in nine seconds.*
--- ## 亮点 - **补上内核缺失的一环。** 桌面版没有任何能被插件触发的重启通路（详见「为什么不能简单地 quit + 重新启动」），这个插件自己开一条，而不是让用户手动去托盘退出再双击图标。 - **外观自动一致。** 按钮插进的是 preload 造菜单条时留下的 open shadow root，样式由那份 shadow 样式表里的裸 `button` 规则提供，因此高度、内边距、hover 背景与「应用 / 编辑」天然相同；界面语言也跟随 `` 切换。 - **不弹控制台窗口。** 重启脚本整条命令包在 `conhost.exe --headless` 里，不给脚本分配任何窗口。否则默认终端为 Windows Terminal 时，脚本会跑在可见窗口里，新实例继承该控制台后窗口永不消失，手动关掉还会连带杀掉新实例。 - **失败可查。** 每一步写进 `$DSH_HOME/logs/dsh-restart-plugin.log`，最后一步以「新实例的 Host 子进程开始监听」作为重启成功的判据，不比对端口号——桌面版固定以 `--port 0` 启动，每次的端口都不一样。Host 与 `dsh-subprocess-local` 的 runner 同名，靠命令行里的 `dsh-desktop-host/lib/index.js` 区分。 - **零依赖、无构建步骤、纯插件挂载。** 宿主端只 import `node:` 内置模块；浏览器端是手写的 `__ModuleLoader__` bundle，不经打包器。不改内核，不留补丁，卸载只需移除 bundle 条目。 ## 你会看到什么 ![标题栏按钮的位置与两种状态](docs/images/titlebar-button.svg) Windows 标题栏，紧挨着「应用」「编辑」的右侧。点击行为： 1. **第一次点击** → 按钮变成「确认重启？」（4 秒内不点会自动撤销） 2. **第二次点击** → 按钮显示「正在重启…」并禁用，旧实例被结束，新实例自动拉起 重启会终止正在运行的任务，而这个按钮位置又太顺手，所以做成两次点击。 整条链路长这样——重点是重启脚本必须由 WMI 创建，否则会被旧实例一起带走： ![重启链路](docs/images/restart-flow.svg) ## 安装 **前置**：DeepSeek Harness 桌面版（Windows），内核 0.2.0-rc.2 上验证通过。 ### 方式一：桌面版内置 CLI（推荐） 桌面版自带一个能管理 `desktop` profile 的 CLI——`@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-host/lib/cli.js` 以 `manageDesktopProfile: true` 启动内核启动器，从而绕过了「desktop profile 由 Electron 独占管理」这道闸门。用法： ``` set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 "C:\D\software\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe" --expose-internals ^ "C:\D\software\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop-host\lib\cli.js" ^ plugin --profile desktop add https://codeload.github.com/csuwzw/dsh-restart/tar.gz/refs/tags/v1.0.1 ``` 把路径换成你自己的安装目录。**注意 `github:csuwzw/dsh-restart` 这种写法需要 git**：pnpm 会先跑 `git ls-remote https://github.com/csuwzw/dsh-restart.git HEAD` 去解析 ref，机器上没有 git 就直接失败 （`'git' 不是内部或外部命令`）。上面的 codeload tarball URL 不需要 git，它就是一个普通压缩包地址。 三种写法在**没有 git** 的 Windows 上实测（用桌面版 CLI，空 profile）： | 写法 | 结果 | | --- | --- | | `github:csuwzw/dsh-restart` | 失败，`git ls-remote` 找不到 git | | `github:csuwzw/dsh-restart#main` / `#v1.0.0` | 失败，同上（任何 ref 名都会触发 `ls-remote`） | | `github:csuwzw/dsh-restart#<40 位 commit sha>` | 成功 | | `https://codeload.github.com/csuwzw/dsh-restart/tar.gz/refs/tags/v1.0.0` | 成功 | | `https://codeload.github.com/csuwzw/dsh-restart/tar.gz/refs/heads/main` | 成功 | 想固定版本就用 tag 形式的 codeload URL，想跟最新就用 `refs/heads/main`（代价是版本不再可复现）。 装完重启一次（或直接用刚装上的按钮）。 ### 方式二：桌面版插件管理器 打开 **设置 → 插件**，在安装框里填入本仓库地址或本地目录路径。这是应用自己管理的安装通道，更新时机由它掌握。 ### 方式三：手工放置 把 `package.json`、`index.js`、`client.js`、`restart.ps1`、`cordis.patch.yml` 复制到 `/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-restart/`，然后： 1. 在 profile 的 `package.json` 里，`dependencies` 加入 `"dsh-restart": "1.0.1"`（不要写 `link:`——桌面端会拒绝含符号链接的 profile 树） 2. 在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组末尾追加 `"dsh-restart"` 3. 重启应用一次 **不要再往 `cordis.patch.yml` 添加条目**：被 `dsh.profile.bundles` 引用的包，其自带的 patch 层会自动生效；两处同时注册会报 `duplicate loader entry id`。 ### 安装后验证 日志文件应当出现： ``` 2026-10-17 02:27:59.155 armed: oldPid=39848 port=19387 exe=C:\D\software\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe 2026-10-17 02:27:59.470 taskkill /PID 39848 /T /F -> exit=0 2026-10-17 02:28:00.332 launched: C:\D\software\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe (old alive=False) 2026-10-17 02:28:09.738 verify: main=40120 host=40488 listening=[58157] after 9s ``` 四行齐全且最后一行 `listening=[...]` 非空，即完整链路可用。方括号里是新实例的端口，与旧实例的 `port=` 不同属正常。**首次安装必须手动重启一次**，按钮之后才存在。 ## 实现结构 ``` index.js 宿主端：注册 POST /api/dsh-restart/restart（仅回环可达）， 收到请求后用脱离 DSH job object 的 WMI 进程安排重启 client.js 浏览器端：标题栏菜单条里的按钮（手写 __ModuleLoader__ bundle） restart.ps1 真正干活的重启脚本，由宿主经 WMI 启动 cordis.patch.yml 作为 profile bundle 挂载宿主端 client.test.cjs 假 DOM 离线自测：挂载时机、两次点击、语言跟随、清理 icon.svg 本文件与 README 顶部的图标 ``` ## 为什么不能简单地 quit + 重新启动 设计过程中逐个排除了五条更短的路，每条都留下了可复现的取证： - **没有可用的优雅退出入口。** 桌面版把重启能力锁在 Electron 主进程里，插件够不着；唯一那处 `app.relaunch()` 位于 `development` 分支内（`resources/app.asar` 的 `main.js`），生产版不生成该菜单项。托盘菜单只有打开/退出，渲染进程的 `dshDesktop` API 全表里也没有 quit/restart。 - **宿主进程被关在 job object 里。** 从插件里普通 spawn 出来的进程与 Host 同属一个 job，旧实例一退出就会被一并带走，拉不起新实例。所以本插件用 WMI（`Win32_Process.Create`）创建重启脚本：它的父链是 `WmiPrvSE.exe → svchost.exe → services.exe`，已脱离该 job，且仍在 explorer 的交互会话里（`sessionId=1`、`UserInteractive=true`），因此能启动带界面的新实例。 - **窗口关闭只是隐藏。** 主窗口的 `close` 事件被 `preventDefault()` 拦下改为隐藏到托盘，所以必须真正结束进程（`taskkill /T /F`），而不是发关闭消息。 - **单实例锁要求旧进程先走。** 新实例拿不到锁就只会聚焦旧窗口，所以脚本先等旧 pid 消失，再清理残留端口占用，最后才拉起新实例。 - **重启脚本必须跑在无窗口环境里。** 默认终端若是 Windows Terminal，它会忽略 PowerShell 的 `-WindowStyle Hidden`。实测对照： | 启动方式 | 存活期内观察到的控制台窗口 | | --- | --- | | `powershell.exe -File restart.ps1` | **2 个**（`CASCADIA_HOSTING_WINDOW_CLASS` + `PseudoConsoleWindow`），全程都在 | | `conhost.exe --headless powershell.exe -File restart.ps1` | **0 个** | 新实例继承那个控制台后，窗口被日志一直占着不会消失；手动关掉窗口还会连带杀掉新实例（Windows 关闭控制台窗口会终止附着其上的所有进程）。`conhost --headless` 不给脚本分配窗口，这条继承链就此断开。 Host 无需特殊处理：它与 Electron 之间是 IPC 连接，Electron 一退出，Host 收到 `disconnect` 就自行走 shutdown 流程，端口随之释放。 ## 路由 ``` POST /api/dsh-restart/restart Headers: content-type: application/json x-dsh-restart-action: restart ``` 响应 `{ ok: true, oldPid, exe, port }` 后 300ms 才真正动手，让响应先落到浏览器。 **安全围栏**：以对端 socket 地址判定回环（Host 头是调用方可控的，只作附加检查），并要求自定义动作头——这会把请求变成非简单请求，外部页面无法在不触发 CORS 预检的情况下构造它，从而挡住 CSRF。非 POST 回 405，非回环或缺少动作头回 403。 脚本的端口参数取自请求连接的**本端端口**（`req.socket.localPort`），不是硬编码：webServer 的端口可以配成 0 由系统分配，写死会在那种部署下清错对象。 ## 验收情况 逐项取证见 [验收记录](docs/verification/2026-10-17-v1.0.0.md)，含每次对照实验的原始观察值。 | 项目 | 结果 | | --- | --- | | 端到端重启 | 四步日志齐全，新实例的 Host 重新监听，**9 秒恢复** | | 控制台窗口 | `conhost --headless` 下全程 **0 个**（原实现 2 个，全程都在） | | job object 隔离 | WMI 子进程 `IsProcessInJob` 返回 **FREE**，sessionId 与 explorer 相同 | | 客户端离线自测 | **25 项全部通过**（假 DOM，不需要浏览器） | | 路由信任围栏 | GET→405、无动作头→403、错 content-type→403、正确→200 | | 干净环境安装 | 空 profile 装 tgz 成功，逐文件 sameHash | | 卸载残留 | profile patch 层、注册表、服务、计划任务均无残留 | 发版记录见 [docs/releases/](docs/releases/)：当前 [v1.0.1](docs/releases/v1.0.1.md)（修 1.0.0 的安装文档错误）。 ## 已知边界 - **仅 Windows。** 重启脚本依赖 WMI、`conhost.exe` 与 `taskkill`，这三者在其它平台都不存在。宿主端与浏览器端本身是跨平台的，但脚本不跑就没有重启能力。 - **会终止正在运行的任务，不等待收尾。** 桌面版自身也没有可用的优雅退出通路（见上），所以这里如实终止而不是假装优雅。 - **宿主端与客户端产物的改动都要重启 DSH 才生效。** 宿主端本身是启动时挂载的；客户端 bundle 由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules` 在启动 compose 时一次性读入并缓存，只有启用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-hmr` 时才有 watcher 刷新。本 profile 未启用 HMR，所以刷新页面也不会拿到新版。 - **按钮位于标题栏菜单条而非原生菜单内。** 那条原生菜单由 Electron 主进程用 `applicationItems()` 构建，且 IPC handler 强制校验 sender（`assertDesktopSender`），插件无法往里加项，所以只能做视觉一致的同级按钮。 - **没有重启失败的自动重试。** 脚本只记录结果，不做第二次尝试——旧实例已被终止的情况下盲目重试会造出重复实例。 ## 开发 无安装步骤、无依赖。需要 Node ≥ 20。 ``` node client.test.cjs client.js # 离线自测，25 项检查 ``` 自测覆盖：菜单条已存在时的挂载、菜单条晚到时的 MutationObserver 补挂、语言跟随切换、第一次点击不发请求、确认态超时自动撤销、第二次点击才发请求、请求头正确、正在重启时禁用、清理函数摘掉按钮。 自测用极简 DOM stub，不需要浏览器，也不出网。 仓库结构： ``` index.js 宿主端：注册 POST /api/dsh-restart/restart（仅回环可达） client.js 浏览器端：标题栏菜单条里的按钮（手写 __ModuleLoader__ bundle） client.test.cjs 离线自测 restart.ps1 真正干活的重启脚本，由宿主经 WMI 启动 cordis.patch.yml 作为 profile bundle 挂载宿主端 catalog/dsh-plugin.json 插件清单（manifest v0.15） docs/RELEASING.md 发版流程 docs/releases/ 各版本发布说明 docs/verification/ 逐项验收取证 docs/images/ README 用的示意图（手绘 SVG） PACKAGING.md 打包与分发指南 .github/workflows/ci.yml 语法检查、自测、BOM 守卫 ``` 改动 `client.js` 或 `index.js` 后，profile 里的副本需要显式同步——pnpm 的 `file:` 依赖用硬链接， 用编辑器整体替换文件会换 inode，源与副本就此脱钩。同步后重启 DSH 才生效（本 profile 未启用 HMR）。 ## 安全与隐私 - 插件不收集任何数据，不联网，除重启外不写任何文件（日志除外）。 - 唯一的网络暴露是一个仅回环可达的 POST 路由，且要求自定义动作头。 - 重启脚本以当前用户身份运行，不请求提权，不做持久化（不写注册表、不装服务、不建计划任务）。 - 日志内容仅为进程 id、可执行文件路径、端口与时间戳。 卸载：从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 移除 `dsh-restart`，再从 `dependencies` 移除该条目，然后删除 `node_modules/dsh-restart/`。插件不留任何补丁，日志文件可直接删除。 ## 免责声明 本插件会**结束正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 进程**——这是它的功能，不是副作用。点下「确认重启？」之前请确认没有需要保留的、正在生成中的任务：桌面版自身没有可用的优雅退出通路，所以这里是如实终止，不等待收尾。 重启**不删除任何数据**：配置、会话记录、插件、日志都原样保留。但如果某个任务正好写到一半，那一半会丢。 ## 反馈 - 安装或使用中遇到问题：[提交 Issue](https://github.com/csuwzw/dsh-restart/issues) - 想自己改：打包与分发见 [PACKAGING.md](PACKAGING.md)，发版流程见 [docs/RELEASING.md](docs/RELEASING.md) ## 许可证 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。 本项目为独立插件，与 DeepSeek 无隶属、认可或赞助关系。

decision.reason: Held for runtime execution policy acceptance. MIT, own Git identity and Windows DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 documentation are present. Route checks loopback peer/Host, POST JSON and action header. Same-SHA restart.ps1 force-kills the process tree and any remaining listener on the old port without proving that listener is the old DSH process. Destructive restart policy requires acceptance. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-ulanworker

把 OhMyOpenCode（原 oh-my-opencode）的 **Sisyphus 编排提示词**移植成 DeepSeek Harness 的一个智能体预设，
并把 `ultrawork` 与 `handoff` 两个技能打进同一个插件里。

> 移植正文来自上游 SUL-1.0 许可的项目，本仓库整体按同一许可分发。
> 修改范围与来源见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)，许可原文见 [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md)。
>
> 仓库：<https://github.com/CycleZero/dsh-ulanworker> —— 公开仓库。
> 公开分发按 SUL-1.0 的约束进行：免费、非商业用途，并保留 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md) 与 [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md)。

装完之后：

- 新建会话时预设列表里多一个 **Sisyphus**，它的系统提示词就是移植后的 Sisyphus 正文；
- 在 Sisyphus 会话里 `/ultrawork`、`/handoff` 直接可用，也可以被模型通过 `skill` 工具加载；
- 没有覆盖任何出厂预设，`standard` / `ptc` / `minimal` / `cordis` 原样保留。

## 目录

```
dsh-ulanworker/
├── package.json         插件清单（dsh.bundle.patch 指向下面的补丁）
├── build.mjs            生成器：把提示词 + 工具面渲染成 cordis.patch.yml
├── surface-delta.js     声明并施加"与出厂 standard 预设的差异"
├── prompts/sisyphus.md  移植后的系统提示词（唯一正文来源）
├── preset-plugins.yml   工具面：逐字取自出厂 standard 预设
├── cordis.patch.yml     生成物，不要手改
├── index.js             预设内插件：唯一入口（注册技能 + 注册派发工具）
├── subagent.js          角色化派发工具（替换原生 subagent），由 index.js 相对导入
├── yaml-lite.js         两个加载器共用的极简 YAML 解析
├── roles/<name>/
│   ├── role.yml         角色定义：toolName / summary / model / toolFilter
│   └── persona.md       该角色的系统提示词
├── skills/
│   ├── ultrawork/SKILL.md
│   └── handoff/SKILL.md
├── verify.mjs           离线自检：技能、角色、派发请求、工具面差异
├── smoke.mjs            真挂载冒烟：在真实进程里把 8 个角色各组合一次
├── smoke-probe.mjs      冒烟用的探针插件（不属于 bundle 运行时）
└── locale/{zh,en}.json  Plugin Manager 卡片文案
```

## 安装

在本工作区的会话里：

```text
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle",
               target="/home/poyuan/文档/deepseek-harness/default-workspace/dsh-ulanworker")
```

它会把包装进当前 profile 的依赖并选中该 bundle。装完后新开会话即可在预设列表里选 **Sisyphus**。
换 profile（例如 `headless`）需要在该 profile 的会话里重复这一步——插件是按 profile 安装的。

## 改提示词

正文只有 `prompts/sisyphus.md` 一份。改完必须重新生成补丁再重装，否则运行的是旧正文：

```bash
node build.mjs          # 重新生成 cordis.patch.yml
node build.mjs --check  # 只检查补丁是否与正文同步
```

生成器会拒绝三种会让预设静默损坏的输入：正文含 `{{...}}`（persona 的 `prefix` 是模板，会被当变量解析）、
正文含制表符、以及工具面锚点行缺失。

## 这个预设长什么样

| 层 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `persona.prefix` | 移植后的 Sisyphus 正文，34,411 字符（上游 fallback/default 家族实测 31,457 字符） |
| `persona.suffix` | **不声明**。0.2.1 起只注册 `provider` / `model` 两个提示词变量，`{{cwd}}` 已移除（写了会让整轮报 `unknown prompt variable`）；工作目录改由运行时上下文提供 |
| 工具面 | 与出厂 `standard` 预设逐行相同（bash、read/write/edit、glob/grep、jobs、skill、goal、plan mode、compaction、subagent 全家、ask-user、todo、web、present） |
| 技能 | `ultrawork`、`handoff`，由 `index.js` 以 runtime 技能注册进预设作用域 |

工具面不是手抄的：`preset-plugins.yml` 是从 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/presets/standard.patch.yml`
里整块抽出来的，构建时逐字拼进去。这样"提示词里写到的工具"与"会话里真实存在的工具"不会漂移。
校验脚本会断言两者逐行相等（18 行）。

## 移植映射：删掉了什么，换成了什么

上游提示词大量引用 OpenCode 插件专有的东西。原则是**留思想、换机制**：凡是 DSH 没有的一律不出现，
但那条规则想达到的效果必须留下。

| 上游 | DSH 里的处理 | 保留的思想 |
|---|---|---|
| `task(subagent_type=..., load_skills=[...], run_in_background=true)` | `subagent`（fresh）/ `subagent_fork`（继承上下文），后台续用式 | 委派优先、六段式 brief、一次只委派一件事 |
| `task(task_id="ses_...")` 续用 | `send_message` 给同一个子智能体 | 续用省 70% token，绝不为了追问新开一个 |
| `background_output(task_id="bg_...")` / `background_cancel` | 删除。子智能体结束会收到一次结算通知；后台 shell 作业才用 `job_output` / `job_kill` | 绝不轮询、结束回合等通知、绝不留活进程 |
| `oracle` 专家 | `subagent(role="oracle")`：只读 persona + deny 写类工具，见 `<Oracle_Usage>` | 独立第二意见、依赖它的实现必须等它、结果没回来不许交付 |
| `metis` / `momus` / `prometheus` / `plan` | `ask_user_question` 澄清 + 工作区计划文件 + 对抗式 reviewer 子智能体 | 先定性再动手、把计划写下来、计划也要被攻击一遍 |
| `atlas`（待办编排器） | 就是本预设自己 | 用 todo 驱动执行 |
| `explore` / `librarian` 专家 | 直接 `grep`/`glob`/`read` 并行；面太宽时发并行 search 子智能体；外部资料用 `web_search`/`web_fetch` | "委派过的搜索自己不重做"（Anti-Duplication 整节保留） |
| `lsp_diagnostics` | 项目自己的 typecheck / lint / build / test 命令，用 `bash` 跑 | 证据条款：没有干净输出就不算完成 |
| category（visual-engineering / ultrabrain / deep-low…） | 删除。改为 `subagent(role=…)` 选角色 + 在 brief 里点名技能 | 委派前必须评估全部技能、按领域挑执行者 |
| `todowrite` / `TaskCreate` | `todo_write` | 立刻建、立刻标、绝不批量 |
| `apply_patch`、`rg`、`interactive_bash` | `edit`/`write`、`grep` 工具、`bash` + 后台作业 | 用工具做工具的事 |
| `.omo/plans/*.md`、notepad 文件协议 | 换成 `.dsh/plans/*.md` 与 `.dsh/notepad/*.md`，见下节 | 状态落在纸上，不落在上下文里；压缩或丢上下文后先读回自己的笔记再继续 |
| `background_cancel(all=true)` 禁令 | 换成 DSH 的对应禁令：不留后台作业/端口、子智能体未终结不许收尾 | 清理是要留回执的动作 |

另外补了三条 DSH 侧的事实约束，因为不写会误导：

- `workflow` 与 Agent Teams **只在用户明确要求时**才启用，ultrawork 模式本身不构成授权；
- 子智能体的委派深度默认封顶一层，所以 brief 里不能让它再开子智能体；
- 本部署没有 LSP 快捷通道，"诊断"就是项目自己的那条命令。

上游那些**从实时 catalog 渲染**的动态节（工具选型表、委派表、category+技能指南）没有对应物，
移植成静态文本，规则保留、表格按 DSH 的真实工具面重写。

## 角色化派发：`subagent(role=…)`

原生的 `subagent` 工具被**替换**成一个角色化派发工具：它同样是 `ctx.subagents` 的消费者，但多了一张角色表和一次参数映射。主 agent 派发时选的是角色。

**组合方式是"每个角色一个预设"，不是请求里的字段。** Harness 0.2.1 起，子代理的 persona 与工具集合不再由启动请求指定
（`persona` / `toolFilter` 已从 `SubagentStartRequest` 与 provider 能力里移除），只剩两条路：不指定 `agentPreset`
就加入父会话的组合，指定了就**挂载那个预设**——persona 与工具都由预设决定。所以每个角色在补丁里都声明了一个
自己的预设 `role-<toolName>`，`build.mjs` 从同一份 `role.yml` + `persona.md` 生成，派发时传
`agentPreset: role-<toolName>`。

| role | 职责 | 工具档 | 该预设挂载的行 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `oracle` | 只读高智商顾问：架构决策、硬调试、自查 | `reader` | `tool-fs`（write/edit 关）`tool-fs-search` `tool-bash` `tool-web` `skill-filesystem` `tool-skill` `tool-jobs` |
| `metis` `momus` `plan` `explore` `librarian` | 预规划 / 对抗评审 / 工作分解 / 代码检索 / 外部检索 | `reader` | 同上 |
| `looker` | 读图/截图/PDF 并报告内容 | `vision` | `tool-fs`（write/edit 关）`tool-fs-search` |
| `atlas` | 端到端执行一份写好的计划并留下证据 | `worker` | `reader` 的全部，`tool-fs` 可写，另加 `tool-todo` `present` |

**"只读"现在是事实，不是承诺。** 七个只读角色的预设里 `tool-fs` 带着 `write: false, edit: false`，
`dsh-tool-fs` 因此**根本不注册** `write`/`edit`——不是"调了会被拒"，是工具列表里没有。唯一的例外是 `bash`
（oracle 要靠它复现故障，explore 要靠它读 `git log`），所以 persona 明说：写工具没有，但 `bash` 能改文件，别用它改。
`looker` 连 `bash` 都没有。

**为什么不再用 `toolFilter`。** 旧做法要求 `deny` 里的每个名字在本部署真实存在，写错一个就整条角色崩——0.2.0
时代踩过：`spawn_teammate` 在没装 Agent Teams 的部署里不存在，7 个角色全废，而且是**调用时**才炸。
改成预设后这个类别消失了：预设里的行要么解析得到，要么在**挂载时**报 `agent-preset/invalid`，不会拖到调用。

**模型语义**（每个角色的 `role.yml`）：`model` / `provider` / `reasoningEffort` **留空就跟随主会话**，填了就只用填的那些字段，其余字段仍从主会话继承。

```yaml
# roles/oracle/role.yml
model: ""              # 空 → 请求里根本不带 agentOptions → 继承主会话路由
# model: gpt-5.6-sol   # 非空 → agentOptions: { model: gpt-5.6-sol }
```

这条规则是**结构性的**，不是文档承诺：留空时 `buildChildRequest()` 返回的对象里没有 `agentOptions` 键，`verify.mjs` 直接断言这一点。

改角色是纯数据操作：编辑 `roles/<name>/role.yml` 与 `persona.md`，加角色只需新建一个目录
（`enabled: false` 可摘掉某个角色而不删文件），然后 `node build.mjs` —— persona 与工具档会被编译进该角色预设。

**改完必须重启 dsh。** 名册（`toolName` / `summary` / `model`）是**挂载时读一次**的（`loadRoster()` 在 `apply()` 里），
新预设也要等补丁层重新应用并重新挂载才生效。实测过：`role.yml` 下午改完，直到晚上重启才生效，新开会话也不行。

### 与出厂工具面的差异是声明式的

`preset-plugins.yml` 逐字来自出厂 `standard` 预设，`surface-delta.js` 声明这唯一的差异：禁用 `tool-subagent`，插入 `ulanworker-subagent`。构建会断言"除了这两行，其余每一行都逐字节未变"，并断言生成物确实来自这份差异。所以"只替换了派发工具、其它一行没动"是**被检查的事实**，不是说法。

### 两条部署约束（都是实测踩出来的）

1. **以 `link:` 装进 profile 的 bundle，其自身的 import 从工作区解析**——`@deepseek-ai/*` 只在 DSH 安装目录里，加载不到。所以这个工具不走 `defineTool`，直接用 `ctx.tools.register({...})` 注册手写 JSON Schema 的工具，并且不 import 任何 DSH 包。副作用是它也完全不依赖 DSH 内部 API，只有 `ctx.tools` 与 `ctx.subagents` 两个服务接缝。
2. **预设内的嵌套行只认裸包名，不认子路径导出。** 曾经把技能与派发工具拆成两行，第二行写 `dsh-ulanworker/subagent`；新建会话时报
   `agent-preset/invalid: ulanworker-subagent (dsh-ulanworker/subagent): never started`。原因是 `EntryGroup.update()` 把导入失败 `.catch()` 进日志，条目留在 store 里但没有 fiber，审计只能报"从未启动"——真实原因被吞掉了。同一包的裸名行（技能）当时是正常的，所以判定是子路径在嵌套行里解析不到。
   现在两者合并成**一个入口**（`index.js`），派发模块用相对导入引入。一行、一个插件、两种职责，但模块文件仍然是分开的。

## 工作状态目录：`.dsh/`

上游把计划写进 `.omo/plans/*.md`，把 notepad 扔进 `mktemp` 临时文件。两者在 DSH 里统一到工作区的
`.dsh/` 下——这个目录本来就已经被 `handoff` 技能用来落盘接续文档（`.dsh/handoff/`），所以是"沿用既有约定"
而不是新发明一个：

| 路径 | 内容 | 谁写 |
|---|---|---|
| `.dsh/plans/<YYYYMMDD-HHmmss>-<slug>.md` | 2 步以上任务的书面计划；todo 是它的实时游标，两者不能互相替代 | 智能体自己 |
| `.dsh/notepad/<YYYYMMDD-HHmmss>-<slug>.md` | 持久 notepad：Plan / Scenarios / Now / Todo / Findings / Learnings，初始化一次后**只追加** | 智能体自己 |
| `.dsh/handoff/` | 用户要交接时由 `handoff` 技能落盘的接续文档 | `handoff` 技能 |

写进提示词的硬规则：

- 有计划文件时，**先写计划文件，再把每一步镜像进 `todo_write`**；
- 发现、决策、跑过的命令、证据文件路径**当场追加**，不留到回合结束；
- 出现压缩提示、历史被摘要、或已经看不到自己前面的步骤时：**先停下重读 notepad 与计划文件**，
  从 `## Now` 续上，不重新规划、不重做已完成的步骤；
- 走不通的路也要留在 `## Learnings` 里——那是接手回合最便宜的一条信息；
- `.dsh/` 是工作状态不是交付物：不提交、不当成果展示、不中途整理。

`## Phase 3 - Completion` 的收尾清单里因此多了一条：计划文件与 notepad 必须与真实发生的事一致。
评估计划时，`Plan saved to .dsh/plans/*.md` 会触发"把该文件路径原样交给 reviewer 子智能体"这条 Key Trigger——
与上游把 `.omo/plans/*.md` 路径交给 Momus 是同一个动作。

## 保真度对照

| 上游结构 | 移植后 |
|---|---|
| `<agent-identity>` | 保留，身份覆盖语义一致 |
| `<Role>` | 保留 |
| `<Behavior_Instructions>` Phase 0 / 1 / 2A / 2B / 2C / 3 | 全部保留，含 Step 1.5 轮次局部意图重置、Step 2.5 上下文完备闸门 |
| `<Oracle_Usage>` | → `<Consultant_Usage>` |
| `.omo/plans/*.md` 计划触发 | → `.dsh/plans/*.md`（路径交给 reviewer 子智能体） |
| notepad 持久草稿协议 | → `.dsh/notepad/*.md`，`<Durable State>` 节 + 收尾清单一条 |
| `<Task_Management>` | 保留 |
| `<Tone_and_Style>` | 逐字保留 |
| `<Constraints>` | 保留 Hard Blocks / Anti-Patterns / Soft Guidelines 三段 |

上游 `default.ts` 里那份是**死代码**（全仓库零调用），线上跑的是 `sisyphus-dynamic-prompt-*` 拼出来的版本，
后者多出 `<agent-identity>` 与 Step 1.5 / Step 2.5 两个闸门。这里按**线上版本**移植，所以比 `default.ts` 更完整。

## 验证状态

已经做到的：

- `install_bundle` 首次返回 `application: applied`、`changed: true`、无 warning；`list_bundles` 显示
  `dsh-ulanworker` `enabled:true, installed:true`，`rows` 里是 `preset-sisyphus`；
- 随后做了一次 `set_bundle enabled=false` → `enabled=true` 往返，两次都 `applied` 且无 warning，
  以强制这一层补丁重新激活，确保磁盘上的 `index.js` 与 `cordis.patch.yml` 就是当前生效的代际；
- `preset-sisyphus` 行在合成配置里存活，状态与出厂预设同为 `schema`，配置满足
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` 的 schema（`id` + `plugins` 必填）；
- **`dsh --profile web --dump-config` 输出里的 persona `prefix` 反解回来与
  `prompts/sisyphus.md` 逐字节相等（36,177 字符）**——即运行时拿到的正文就是这份文件；
- 同一份 dump 里确认：20 个顶层行、`ulanworker` 行在、`delegation` 组里原生
  `tool-subagent` `disabled: true`、`tool-subagent-fork` 与 `tool-subagent-control` 仍启用；
- 工具面差异是**声明式且被断言**的：除 `surface-delta.js` 里那一禁一插，其余每一行与出厂
  `standard` 逐字节相同，且生成物确实等于 `applySurfaceDelta(preset-plugins.yml, SURFACE_DELTA)`；
- 补丁 YAML 可解析；生成器自带的块标量反解断言在每次 `node build.mjs` 时都会跑；
  负向对照：往正文里塞一个 `{{cwd}}` 会让构建以非零码退出；此外**整份补丁里的每个 `{{…}}` 都必须是已注册变量**
  （`provider` / `model`），否则构建失败——这条守住了 0.2.1 把 `cwd` 从变量表移除后的那类整轮崩溃；
- `node verify.mjs` 通过，四组检查：
  1. **技能**：`name` / `description` / `whenToUse` / `metadata` 全部解析；正文恰好等于去掉
     frontmatter 的正文；`resourceBase` 指向各自目录；`disable-model-invocation` / `user-invocable`
     的拼写与语义与文件系统 provider 一致；缺 frontmatter、缺 description、非法布尔值、旧键名
     四条拒绝路径按预期告警并跳过；
  2. **角色**：8 个角色齐全且排序稳定；每个都有非空 persona（>400 字符）、summary、合法工具档，
     且 `preset` 恰好等于 `role-<toolName>`；补丁里每个启用的角色都有对应预设；
     **默认不钉任何模型**；重复 toolName、缺/空 persona、非 kebab 名、缺工具档、工具档写错、
     model 含空格、`enabled` 拼错等畸形角色全部按预期抛错；`enabled: false` 的角色被摘掉；
     全部禁用的花名册报错；
  3. **派发**：用一个桩 `ctx.subagents` **真的跑了一遍注册出来的工具**——断言工具名、必填字段、
     role enum 等于花名册；后台调用返回 `started subagent child-1 (role: oracle)` 且启动 spec 里
     **没有 `agentOptions` 键**、且带着 `agentPreset: role-oracle`；前台调用返回子 agent 文本；
     `max-tokens` 停止原因变成带部分输出的报错；provider 缺 `agentPreset` 能力时**挂载即失败**而不是首次派发才炸；
  4. **真挂载检查**（`node smoke.mjs`）：复制一份当前 profile 到临时 `DSH_HOME`，插入一个探针，
     以 `--port 0` 冷启动一个真实 `dsh --profile web`，读取 `agentPresets.list()` 的 `broken` 字段，
     断言 `sisyphus` 与 8 个 `role-*` 预设**全部挂载成功**。探针同时声明一个**故意坏掉**的预设，
     所以 PASS 意味着"检测器确实在工作"，而不是"什么都没报"。这一条抓到过两类离线检查看不见的问题：
     角色预设里丢掉了行的必备 `config`（`tool-fs-search` 的 `sampleOverCapGlobResults`），
     以及预设里引用了不存在的包；
  5. **工具面 + 提示词一致性**：提示词里 `role="…"` 出现的每个角色都在花名册里，花名册里每个角色
     都在提示词里出现过；提示词依赖的 `subagent_fork` / `send_message` 对应行仍启用，原生
     `tool-subagent` 确实被禁用。临时 fixture 目录已删除；
- 全文审计：移植后的提示词里不再出现 Oracle、lsp_diagnostics、todowrite、background_output、
  `.omo/`、category 名、metis/momus/atlas 等不存在的东西；出现的每个工具名都在 DSH 工具表里；
  计划与 notepad 只落在 `.dsh/` 下。

**我没有验证到的**：预设被选中时真正渲染出的系统提示词，以及会话内的技能目录与 `/ultrawork` 的注入。
预设是按会话选择的，当前会话跑的是 `standard`，无法自我切换。请你这样确认（约 10 秒）：

1. 新开一个会话，在预设选择里选 **Sisyphus**；
2. 问它"你是谁"——应答自己是 Sisyphus；
3. 输入 `/ultrawork` 或 `/handoff`——应直接注入技能正文；
4. 让主 agent 派一次活（例如"用 explore 找一下 X 在哪"）——工具表里应只有**一个** `subagent`，
   带 `role` 枚举，且它能返回一个子 agent id。

任何一步不对，把现象告诉我，我按 `--dump-config` 与插件日志继续查。

### DSH 升级会同时改两件事（0.2.1 实测）

升级 DSH 后如果预设报 `agent-preset/invalid`，先查这两条：

1. **子代理组合契约变了。** 0.2.1 把 `persona` / `toolFilter` 从 `SubagentStartRequest` 和 provider 能力里移除，
   改成"每个子代理选一个预设"。旧写法会在挂载时报
   `cannot honour this roster (missing persona, toolFilter)`，整个预设不可用。本仓库已按新契约实现
   （每个角色一个 `role-*` 预设），并在 `package.json` 里声明 `engines.dsh >= 0.2.1-rc.2`，
   旧版本会拒绝安装而不是炸在挂载期。
2. **升级会重写 profile 的 `package.json`，可能把第三方 bundle 从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里丢掉。**
   实测：升级后 `dsh-ulanworker` 直接从 bundles 列表消失，插件根本不加载（`set_bundle` 也不会报错，因为
   它装的是"包"，加载看的是"bundles"）。用一次
   `plugin_manager` 的 `set_bundle(dsh-ulanworker, true)` 加回来即可，它会写回 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

升级后先看这一行：

```
python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('$HOME/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json'))['dsh']['profile']['bundles'])"
```

### 换了插件 JS 必须重启 dsh（否则改动不会生效）

`set_bundle` 关开一次能让**补丁层**重新应用（行会变），但**不会重新导入插件的 JavaScript**：
Loader 的 ESM 模块缓存按 URL 命中，同一个 `index.js` 只会在进程内求值一次。插件管理器文档写得很直白：
"replacing an installed package requires restart to load a fresh JavaScript module generation"。

这个坑真实踩到过：dsh web 进程从 10-09 起跑了五天，期间加的 `subagent` 派发工具一直不生效——预设挂载正常、
persona 正常、delegation 组正常，唯独新工具不出现。原因是进程里缓存的还是 `index.js` 的**第一代**
（只有技能、没有派发工具），后续所有改动对它都不可见。同一份代码在全新进程里（`dsh --profile headless`）
一次就注册成功。

所以规则是：

| 改了什么 | 需要做什么 |
|---|---|
| `prompts/sisyphus.md`、`roles/` | `node build.mjs`，然后**重启 dsh**：正文与角色预设都会编译进补丁，但名册是挂载时读的 |
| `skills/` | **重启 dsh**：挂载时读盘，补丁没变就不会重新挂载 |
| `cordis.patch.yml`、`surface-delta.js` | `node build.mjs` + `set_bundle` 关开一次 |
| `index.js` / `subagent.js` / `yaml-lite.js` / `surface-delta.js` | **重启 dsh**；并注意已存在的会话仍持有旧 revision，要**新开会话** |

排查这类问题时，进程年龄是第一手证据：

```
ps -eo pid,lstart,etime,cmd | grep "dsh web"
```

### 重复安装会怎样

对已安装的 bundle 再跑一次 `install_bundle` 会返回 `application: failed` 且 `error.code` 为
`ambiguous-install`。这不是损坏：pnpm 报告无变化后，管理器无法从前后依赖差异里认出"这次装的是谁"，
于是一路回滚（`changed: false`）。已装状态不变，`list_bundles` 仍是 `enabled/installed`。
改了 `index.js` 想要新代际时，用 `set_bundle` 关一次再开一次，比重复 install 干净。


## 已知取舍

- 技能正文在插件里有一份副本，与 `~/.dsh/skills/` 下的同名技能并存。在 Sisyphus 会话里 runtime 注册优先；
  改技能时注意**两处**，否则会出现"改了没生效"。
- `preset-plugins.yml` 是出厂 `standard` 预设的快照。DSH 升级后若要同步工具面，需要重新抽取一次。
- 提示词正文保留英文（上游原文即英文，"尽可能还原"优先于翻译）。
- 角色 persona 是**重写**而非逐字移植：OmO 的 oracle 单文件 28 KB、metis 21 KB，逐字搬会把 DSH 没有的
  工具写进子 agent 的指令里。这里保留的是角色契约（职责、必须/禁止、输出形状、工具纪律），每个约 1.7–2.4 KB。
- 派发工具**不暴露** `provider` / `model` / `reasoning_effort` 三个按次参数：那属于 Host 的
  `subagent-model-selection` 策略，其执行代码没有导出，自己实现等于绕过用户的 allowlist。
  要按次选模型就去开那个 Host 设置；要按角色钉模型就写 `role.yml`。
- 角色子 agent **不能再委派**（Host 委派深度默认 1），所以 `atlas` 是执行者而不是二级编排者。

# dsh-deepseek-stats（DeepSeek 余额/用量浮窗）

DeepSeek 账户「余额 / 用量」实时浮窗插件（DSH 长期生效版）：页面右上角悬浮卡片，展示官方余额、今日 token 消耗与峰谷计价成本，官方价目自动同步。

## 功能一览

- **排障**：余额取不到时，卡片会显示一行「诊断：账号服务 可见/不可见 · 账号登录态 … · 宿主账号凭据 有/无 · Key 有/无 · client版本 …」，宿主同时写日志 `[deepseek-stats] 余额通道诊断: {...}`，`/state.balanceDiag` 有完整字段；页脚显示插件版本号便于确认是否已热更。
- **官方余额（双通道）**：① Web/自建部署走 API Key——`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 经 DSH 凭据通道读取（不进浏览器），直连 `api.deepseek.com/user/balance`；② **DSH 桌面端**（登录官方账号、无 API Key）自动回落到官方账号通道 `ctx.deepseekAccount.getBalance(client)`，语义映射 `value`=充值余额、`bonusWallets`=赠金余额，卡片展示总额＝两者之和。15 秒缓存，点击 ⟳ 强制刷新（2 秒冷却，旋转反馈）；「价源」行会标注当前「余额源 API Key / 官方账号」。
- **今日用量**：宿主监听 `session/event` 的 `assistant/message`（含 `usage`）实时累加；启动时回填当日已落库事件——**按会话日志 mtime 预筛「今日活跃会话」**（长寿命会话不会因"创建得早"被漏掉），存储布局/服务不可识别时回退全量（上限 500 个会话）；按北京时间午夜自动滚动。展开卡片可见「回填」覆盖行（模式/候选/成功/折叠条数），`/state` 里对应 `backfill` 字段。
- **峰谷计价**：高峰时段 = 北京时间 周一至周五（**不含中国法定节假日**）09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00（价格 ×官方倍率，默认 2）；其余时段**包括周末与法定节假日全天、调休上班日**均为空闲 ×1（官方 2026-09 页脚注口径）。按每条消息发起时刻计价；缓存命中 / 未命中 / 缓存写 / 输出分档；未知模型不计价并在界面标注。内置价目（2026-09-10 官方）：`deepseek-flash` 0.02 / 1 / 4、`deepseek-v4-pro` 0.15 / 4.5 / 13.5（元/百万 tokens，空闲时段；高峰 ×2）。旧名 `deepseek-v4-flash`、`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` 与已转正的实验名 `deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910` 均按 `deepseek-flash` 计价；名称含 `flash` / `pro` 的未知变体分别按 flash / pro 价兜底。
- **节假日表**：内置 2026 全年（33 天法定休假日 + 6 个调休上班日），并按日从 `holiday-cn`（国务院公告口径数据集）同步当年与次年安排；同步失败保留内置表；卡片「价源」行会标注「节假日源 官方数据集 / 内置」。
- **官方价目自动同步**：启动时 + 每 6 小时抓取官方价目页并解析；**列数自适应**（列名取自表头，官方增删模型无需改代码）；失败回落内置价，并以「启动后 30 秒 → 2 分钟 → 8 分钟」退避重试；展开卡片可查看「价源」行（官方 / 内置）。
- **时段进度环**：卡片头部为动态圆环——绿色＝空闲、红色＝高峰，环弧代表当前时段剩余时间比例，悬停显示倍率与剩余时长。
- **交互**：标题栏可拖拽；▾ 收起为一行摘要（余额 + 今日消耗），▸ 展开为完整详情；每 10 秒自动刷新。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-deepseek-stats/
├── package.json        # 包名、dsh.bundle.patch / dsh.client 元信息
├── cordis.patch.yml    # bundle 补丁：自动注册 deepseek-stats 插件行
├── README.md
└── lib/
    ├── index.js        # 宿主半身（ESM 插件，直连官方接口 / 价目同步 / 用量折叠）
    └── client.js       # 客户端半身（__ModuleLoader__ 协议，浮窗 UI）
```

## 安装（其他 DSH 用户 / 其他机器）

```bash
# 1. 在 profile 目录安装（pnpm 直接安装 GitHub 仓库）
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm add github:czjlc3c3c3/dsh-deepseek-stats#semver:^1.0.0

# 2. 登记为 bundle：确保 ~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json 的
#    dsh.profile.bundles 数组包含 "dsh-deepseek-stats"（首次安装需手动加一次）

# 3. 重启 DSH web 进程，浏览器硬刷新（Ctrl+Shift+R）
```

包内 `cordis.patch.yml`（由 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明）会在 profile 组装时自动插入插件行，无需手动修改 `cordis.yml`。

更新：`cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web && pnpm update dsh-deepseek-stats` 后重启（`#semver:^1.0.0` 会自动取最新版本的 git tag）。

## 本地开发（改完重启即生效）

在仓库根目录执行 `pnpm link` 接入本机（或在 profile 的 `node_modules` 里用软链接指向仓库根目录），重启 DSH；改动提交推送 GitHub 后，其他用户 `pnpm update` 即可同步。

## 接口（宿主路由）

| 路由 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `GET /plugins/deepseek-stats/state` | 完整快照（余额 15 秒缓存 + 今日用量 + 时段 + 价源） |
| `GET /plugins/deepseek-stats/refresh` | 强制刷新余额（2 秒冷却） |

## 兼容性（DSH 版本 / 桌面端）

- **已验证**：DSH **0.1.7-rc.2**、**0.2.0-rc.1**、**0.2.0-rc.2**、**0.2.1-alpha.1**、**0.2.1-rc.2**（Web profile，另见下方桌面端）上功能完整——宿主 `session/event` 载荷（`(session, event)` + `assistant/message.usage`）、`TokenUsage` 字段、`credentials.resolve`、`webServer.register`（`:326`）、`sessionPersistence.root` / `dshHomePath`、会话日志布局 `…/<id>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd`、客户端 `__ModuleLoader__` 协议与 `shell.overlay` 槽位、bundle 路由 `plugins/??<id>/client.js&rev=…` 均未变。
- **变更面核查方式**：一律用「两版本 npm tarball 逐包 diff」（`https://registry.npmjs.org/@deepseek-ai/<pkg>/-/<pkg>-<ver>.tgz`），关键函数直接按区间取 md5 比对是否逐字节相同。0.2.1-rc.2 相对 alpha.1：新增 `engines.dsh` 门禁语义、客户端 **release 门禁**、`job/*` 与 `working-directory/change` 事件类型、`remote-access` 与 `working-directory`/`tool-working-directory` 服务行、若干 experimental bundle（plugin-market / ralph / session-search / session-titles / terminal / tool-worktree / cot-translation / badge-skill），移除 webhook 与 hooks-* 包；**本插件依赖的接口全部未变**。
- **用量事件**：DSH 里只有 `assistant/message` 带 `usage`；`assistant/attempt`（失败/重试/取消的尝试）**按类型不带 usage**，本机历史日志 71 条 attempt 亦未见用量记录——故按 `assistant/message` 折叠即为完整口径。
- **Search / Fetch 计费（v1.3.0 起，v1.3.1 加计费起始）**：官方 Search / Fetch API 各 **5 元 / 1000 次成功请求**（¥0.005/次，固定单价、不乘峰谷）；**默认自 2026-11-01 00:00（北京）起计入成本**——官方仅对「Server 端工具调用」路径写明"目前未计费、11-01 起按次收费"，独立 API 价格表未给生效日期，故免费期内只计数不计费（卡片标注），需要"现在就计"时设 `DSH_WEB_BILLING_START` 覆盖。插件按会话事件统计：`web_search` 按 `arguments.queries` 条数计（每条查询=一次 provider 请求），`web_fetch` 每次计 1；`tool/result` 有 `error` 字段=失败、成功但无结果=工具输出 `No results found.`，两者均不计费。**仅当 web provider 是独立 API（`deepseek-search-api` / `deepseek-fetch-api`）时计入成本**；DSH 默认组合（`deepseek-official` 服务端工具 + `http` 本地抓取）只计数不计费（服务端工具 2026-11-01 起才收费）。卡片显示次数、计费数与「模型 + Search/Fetch」合计；`/state.websearch` 有完整计数与口径。
  - 边界：多查询调用中任一查询失败会**整体中止**（已成功的查询已被计费但事件里看不出条数 → 少计）；切回服务端工具路径后（2026-11-01 起收费）次数**无法精确获得**（DSH 丢弃该用量的 `server_tool_use` 计数）。
- **回填策略**：按会话日志 mtime 预筛「今日活跃会话」；**布局不可识别**时全量兜底（上限 500），**布局已识别但今日无日志写入**时直接跳过（`/state.backfill.skippedEmpty`）——不会为此把全部会话重放校验一遍。
- **经反代/发布 URL 访问**：DSH 对外入口（manager 3080、或 nginx/tailnet）为**全路径转发**，`/plugins/*` 无需额外配置即可到达；客户端一律相对路径取数，`dsh web --public-url` 不影响本插件。
- **插件兼容门禁（重要，本插件安全通过）**：DSH 0.2.0 起，profile 组装时会核对每个 bundle 声明的 DSH 版本要求，**不匹配则该 bundle 被整体跳过**（启动日志：`dsh: skipping profile bundle "<name>": Error: Plugin <pkg>@<ver> is incompatible with dsh <runtime>…`）。
  - **0.2.1-rc.2 起语义更新**：优先看 `package.json` 的 **`engines.dsh`** 范围（声明了它就**只按它判定、忽略 peerDependencies**）；没有 `engines.dsh` 才回落到 `peerDependencies` 里的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`；**两者都没有则直接放行**。判定函数 `unmetRequirements`（`dsh-app-boot`），结果字段由 `peers` 改为 `requirements`。
  - 本插件只声明 `engines.node`（**无 `engines.dsh`、无 `@deepseek-ai/*` peerDependencies**），门禁因此总是放行——0.2.0-rc.1 / 0.2.1-alpha.1 / 0.2.1-rc.2 实测均未出现在跳过名单，功能完整。
  - 若将来要"声明支持范围"，可改用 **`engines.dsh` 的纯下界范围**（如 `">=0.1.7-rc.2"`）：新版本永远满足、不会因升级被跳过，但注意 semver 预发布语义（`-rc.N` 版本对 `>=` 范围的匹配需实测确认），改完必须重启并在日志里确认未被跳过。
  - **客户端 release 门禁（0.2.1-rc.2 新增，插件无需适配）**：客户端模块图携带 `WebBootRelease {version, commit}`；页面启动时的图与随后连上的 Host 版本不一致时，**图不会被应用**，更新暂停到"Host 回到该 release 或页面重载"。含义：**DSH 升级后已打开的标签页要刷新**才会换上新前端/新插件 bundle。插件侧无需声明任何东西（该字段由 Host 图携带，可选）。
  - **维护不变量：不要给本插件添加 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 的 peerDependencies**。一旦声明门禁就会开始校验，范围写窄就会像其它插件那样在 DSH 升级后被**静默跳过**（同机 `dsh-mnemon`、`dsh-zotero`、`dsh-plugin-writing-guard` 即因此被跳过）。
  - 核查：`grep 'skipping profile bundle' <DSH 启动日志> | grep deepseek-stats`（无输出=已加载；也可看日志里有否插件的 `[deepseek-stats]` 行）。
  - 万一将来被跳过：用 `dsh plugin allow-version` 或插件管理器授予**精确版本豁免**（写入该 profile 的 `compatibility.json`，形如 `{"<pkg>@<ver>": ["<DSH 版本>"]}`），再重启；桌面端由应用管理，豁免须在桌面端侧授予。
- **桌面端（Electron）实测 ✅**：桌面端**能正常加载本插件**（宿主半身 + 客户端半身都生效，浮窗出现）；余额走官方账号通道（登录官方账号即可，无需 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`，v1.2.0 起支持，实测正常）。桌面端使用**保留 profile 名 `desktop`**，外部 CLI 明确拒绝管理（`error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）；**0.2.0-rc.2 起改由 Desktop 应用内置命令运行时管理该 profile 的插件操作** → 桌面端安装/更新本插件请走**应用内的插件入口或内置命令**。⚠️ **桌面端更新插件后必须重启桌面应用**：宿主半身只在应用启动时装载、桌面端没有热更新，不重启则仍跑旧代码（典型现象＝更新了却报旧版提示）。排障第一步看卡片页脚显示的**插件版本号**是否为新版。
- 若桌面端浮窗不出现：先看卡片页脚版本号确认是否已热更（重启后仍为旧版号＝未加载新包），再看桌面应用启动日志里有无本插件的 `[deepseek-stats]` 行——**有=宿主半身已加载**（问题在客户端侧：`dsh.client.platform === "web"` 与界面/路由同源）；**完全没有=宿主半身未加载**（可能缺 `webServer` 服务，或被插件兼容门禁跳过：`grep 'skipping profile bundle' <日志> | grep deepseek-stats`）。

## 卸载

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm remove dsh-deepseek-stats
# 再从 package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 中移除 "dsh-deepseek-stats"，然后重启
```

## 更新方式

- **GitHub 安装的用户**：`cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web && pnpm update dsh-deepseek-stats` → 重启 DSH。
- **本机开发**：直接编辑本地仓库 `lib/` 下文件 → 重启 DSH 生效；改动提交推送 GitHub 即可同步给其他用户。

## 已知边界

- 余额为整个 DeepSeek 账号（官网、其他程序、其他机器共用 Key 都会扣减）。**「今日总计」= 本 DSH 全部署、所有会话（含子代理）的合计**，不是单个对话的消耗；只覆盖经由本 DSH 的模型调用，直接用 Key 调 API 的部分不计入。
- **回填完整性**：回填依赖会话日志的 mtime 预筛；若某会话日志的 mtime 早于今日（例如日志被外部工具改写/复制，或存储后端不是 JSONL），该会话今天的早前用量可能不被计入——此时可看卡片「回填」行的模式（`全量` 表示已兜底）。启动前的实时事件由 `session/event` 持续捕获，不受影响。
- DeepSeek 官方调整价格后，插件最迟 6 小时自动采用新价；同步失败期间按内置价目计费并在界面标注。
- **官方 V4 Pro 政策（2026-09-12 官方更新）**：官方已**撤销**原定 2026-09-14 起的 V4 Pro 下线/改由 V4.1 Flash 计费的计划——该日期之后继续提供 `deepseek-v4-pro` 的 API 服务，计费方式保持不变（如有变动另行通知）。因此插件按 pro 价目计算该模型用量即为正确，无需按时间分支处理。
- **节假日表来源**：法定节假日/调休安排取自社区数据集 `holiday-cn`（国务院公告口径，非 DeepSeek 官方发布）；网络不可达时用内置的 2026 表，跨年后需等国务院公布并由同步补上（同步失败会在「价源」行标注）。**中国港澳台地区及境外的公众假期不在该表内**。
- 高峰/空闲切换以请求发起时刻为准，跨时段请求按发起时刻所在时段计价。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# Agent Memory Backpack

> 让 DSH 与 Codex 两个桌面共享同一份**有版本、要审核、可门禁**的本地知识。

![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)
![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-24.13--24.x-brightgreen.svg)
![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20x64-lightgrey.svg)
![Protocol](https://img.shields.io/badge/protocol-v1-blue.svg)
![Contracts](https://img.shields.io/badge/contracts-39%2F39-brightgreen.svg)
![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-816%20passing-brightgreen.svg)
![Storage](https://img.shields.io/badge/storage-SQLite%20(local)-informational.svg)

**这是什么**：一个本地知识库插件——核心是只监听 `127.0.0.1` 的 HTTP 服务加一个 SQLite 文件，DSH 与 Codex 各有一个适配器，另有 MCP 入口与托盘桌面控制台。没有云端、没有外部推理、没有账号。

**给谁用**：同时使用 DSH 和/或 Codex、希望两个 agent 遵守同一套规范并复用同一批经验的人。

**不是全自动的地方**：两端桌面的「加载插件 + 信任 hooks」必须在各自的桌面 UI 里**亲手确认**一次，CLI 无法代劳——这是安全设计，不是缺陷。安装脚本把其余步骤做完，并把这一步明确打印出来。

规范与经验今天散落在每个 agent 自己的文件里：你在 DSH 里立了一条规则，Codex 不知道；你在 Codex 里踩过一次坑，下次在 DSH 里照样踩。**Agent Memory Backpack（AMB）** 把这件事收到一个本地库里——两端都从它读、都往它写，而写入要经过审核，改动留下修订史，一条规则可以直接拦住某个工具调用。

---

## 为什么

**现在的做法各有短板。**

- **各写各的 `AGENTS.md`**：两端各存一份，互相不知道对方改了什么，也没人知道哪条还有效。
- **聊天历史当记忆**：能回看对话，但不是结构化知识，检索靠关键词碰运气，改不了、也撤不回。
- **RAG / 向量库**：能读，但通常不能写回；基础设施重，数据常在别人机器上。
- **知识图谱**：结构好，但要专门的工具链维护，日常使用成本高。

**AMB 的选择**：把记忆当作**知识**而不是**文本**。

- **有版本**：每次修改是一条修订，可回溯、可取代、可按时间点看当时的库。
- **要审核**：agent 提交的只能是**候选**，采纳是人（或明确授权的入口）的动作，门禁在服务端强制。
- **可门禁**：一条规范可以按工具名直接拒绝调用，拒绝理由写清是哪条规则拦的。
- **本地**：一个 SQLite 文件、一个本地服务，凭据分离，无对外网络出口。

**与同类项目相比**：目前开源的 agent 记忆方案（官方 MCP Memory、Mem0、Zep/Graphiti、Basic Memory、doobidoo MCP Memory 等）大多把记忆当作**一段可检索的文本**。AMB 多出来的是**版本 + 审核 + 门禁**这一层。**它少什么**：没有实体关系图谱、不做多模态。这些是刻意的取舍，不是没做完（向量检索是可选的，默认关闭，见下文）。
