# dsh-ai-library · 资料馆

> 仓库：<https://github.com/Instant-KING/dsh-ai-library> · npm：`dsh-ai-library`

把**本地多源资料库**渲染成 DeepSeek Harness 的原生面板：左侧三级分类树、中间卡片网格、右侧预览（自带 pdf.js 阅读器），支持条目编辑与拖拽分组。

- 自带 pdf.js **4.10.38**，不需要外网 CDN
- Markdown 现场渲染、Office 文件转 PDF 预览
- 拖拽卡片改分组、批量打标签、新建/编辑/删除条目
- 数据全部留在本地；**除你主动检索 / 手动同步市场外不联网**（论文检索会请求公开 API，AnySearch 匿名请求，见下文 key 配置）

---

## 大肥鱼会替你做这些

- **像妈妈一样的大肥鱼**：你把东西弄得到处都是，它会把东西收好 —— 本机产物自动入库、自动分类、随时能搜。
- **要搜好用的插件？** 大肥鱼自己去[插件市场](https://api.dshmk.com/)翻，卡片上直接写清 star、版本、兼不兼容。
- **要写漂亮的前端组件？** 把 [react-bits](https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits) 这类仓库丢进来建库，大肥鱼就在馆藏里搜现成组件来做页面 UI —— 不用从零抄。
- **要搜真实存在的论文？** 大肥鱼自己调十个源的 API（arXiv / OpenAlex / Crossref / DOAJ / Europe PMC / INSPIRE / Zenodo / HAL / DataCite / OpenAIRE），带 DOI 和 PDF 链接，不会编文献。

## 安装

三种方式，选一种（装完**重启 DSH**）：

```bash
# ① npm（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-ai-library

# ② 直接从 GitHub
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Instant-KING/dsh-ai-library

# ③ 本地目录（开发用，不装包）
# clone 后在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里用绝对路径 insert：
#   - insert:
#       - id: dsh-ai-library
#         name: E:/path/to/dsh-ai-library/lib/index.js
```

装完第一次打开面板会自动建空库；把文件丢进 `<下载目录>/ai-library/items/` 就能看到。

## 论文检索需要配哪些 key

十个学术源（arXiv / OpenAlex / Crossref / DOAJ / Europe PMC / INSPIRE / Zenodo / HAL / DataCite / OpenAIRE）**免 key 直接用**。
下面几个是可选的付费/受限源，**不配只是查不到它的结果**，不会报错：

| 平台 | 配置项 | 去哪申请 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Sciverse** | `paperKeys.sciverse`（`sv-` 开头） | <https://sciverse.space/> → 开发者控制台 | 元数据 + **语义检索(RAG)** + 读原文 |
| IEEE Xplore | `paperKeys.ieee` | <https://developer.ieee.org/> | IEEE 论文 |
| ScienceDirect | `paperKeys.elsevier` | <https://dev.elsevier.com/> | Elsevier 期刊 |
| Springer | `paperKeys.springer` | <https://dev.springernature.com/> | Springer 论文 |
| AnySearch（可选） | `paperKeys.anysearch` | <https://www.anysearch.com/console/api-keys> | 网页检索；**留空也能用**（匿名免费配额） |

**两种填法（任选）**

1. 面板里填：工具栏「论文检索」→ 右上角「配置 key」→ 粘贴 → 保存（立即生效，不用重启）
2. 改文件：插件目录 `config.json`

```json
{
  "paperKeys": {
    "sciverse": "sv-你的token",
    "ieee": "",
    "elsevier": "",
    "springer": "",
    "anysearch": ""
  }
}
```

> ⚠️ **语义检索（RAG）只支持 Sciverse**：没配 `sciverse` 时面板提示「需要 sciverse key」，
> 接口返回 400 并说明原因，不会静默失败。
## 配置

插件目录下的 `config.json`（可不建，全部字段都有默认值）。参考 [config.example.json](config.example.json)。

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `root` | `<下载目录>/ai-library` | 数据根目录，其余路径从它推出 |
| `libraryFile` | `<root>/library.js` | 手写条目 |
| `projectFile` | `<root>/project-items.js` | 批量导入条目（可选） |
| `marketFile` | `<root>/market-items.js` | 市场同步产物（可选） |
| `githubFile` | `<root>/github-items.js` | GitHub 项目同步产物（可选） |
| `userItemsFile` | `<root>/user-items.json` | 面板编辑器写入的条目 |
| `itemsDir` | `<root>/items` | 文件根目录（只允许读这里） |
| `cacheDir` | `<root>/.cache` | 缓存 |
| `translateCache` | `<cache>/translate` | 翻译产物 |
| `marketCache` | `<cache>/market.json` | 市场原始目录缓存 |
| `vendorDir` | `<插件>/vendor` | 内置 pdf.js / three.js |
| `soffice` | 自动探测 | LibreOffice 可执行文件（Office 转 PDF） |
| `motionDir` | 空（关闭） | 外部只读挂载的提示词库 |
| `translateUrl` | `http://127.0.0.1:11008` | PDFMathTranslate 服务 |
| `workspaceDir` | 空 | 自动入库扫描的根目录 |
| `watchDirs` | `[]` | 自动入库监听的目录 |
| `autoCaptureOnBoot` | `false` | 启动后自动扫一次 watchDirs |
| `autoCaptureProject` | `自动入库` | 自动入库的分组名 |
| `autoCaptureDepth` | `2` | 自动入库递归深度 |
| `toolsEnabled` | `true` | 是否注册 14 个 AI 工具 |
| `marketUrl` | `https://api.dshmk.com/` | 插件市场源 |
| `marketEnabled` | `false` | 是否自动同步市场（默认关，开了启动后自动拉） |
| `marketLimit` | `300` | 市场最多收录条数 |
| `marketTtlMs` | 6 小时 | 市场缓存有效期 |
| `paperKeys` | `{}` | `{ ieee, elsevier, springer }`，论文检索用 |

所有路径字段都支持 `~`（会展开成用户主目录）。环境变量（优先级高于 config.json）：

```
AILIB_ROOT  AILIB_MOTION_DIR  AILIB_WORKSPACE  SOFFICE  PDFMATHTRANSLATE_URL
```

> 论文检索已内置（`lib/paper.js`，纯 Node），**不需要 Python**，也不需要外部项目。


> 🔐 **密钥说明**：`config.json` 里的 `paperKeys`（Sciverse / IEEE / Elsevier / Springer / AnySearch）
> 以**明文**保存在插件目录，同名项目通常都是这样。请确保该目录权限不被他人读取；
> 如果插件装在共享盘或多用户机器上，建议改用环境变量 `SCIVERSE_API_TOKEN` 等方式，或只填需要的 key。

### 主色（主题）

面板的主色（高亮、选中态、极光背景）来自 CSS 变量 `--ailib-accent`，解析顺序：

```
config.json 的 accent（或环境变量 AILIB_ACCENT）
  ↓ 没填
DSH 主题变量 --dsw-alias-brand-primary / --dsw-static-deepseek-500（DSH 若暴露了就用它）
  ↓ 都没有
插件默认金色 #e6c16f（视觉与旧版完全一致）
```

想让插件跟 DSH 品牌色一致，在 `config.json` 里写：

```json
{ "accent": "#4176E6" }
```

按钮尺寸、圆角、动效都不变，只换主色；极光背景的主色也会跟着变。

## 数据格式

`library.js` 是普通 JS：

```js
window.LIBRARY = {
  title: '我的资料库',
  items: [
    {
      id: 'k-1',                 // 唯一，必填
      kind: 'paper',             // paper / plugin / doc / note …
      status: 'available',
      title: '一维谐振子',
      summary: '升降算符解法',
      source: 'arXiv',
      tags: ['量子力学'],
      notes: ['摘自2026-03讲座'],
      files: ['items/papers/harmonic.pdf'],   // 相对 items/
      preview: {
        variants: [
          { label: '原文', src: 'papers/harmonic.pdf' },
          { label: '笔记', src: 'notes/harmonic.md' },
        ],
      },
    },
  ],
  groups: {
    'k-1': '力学',               // id → 子分类，不写就落到「未分类」
  },
}
```

把文件丢进 `<root>/items/`，条目里写相对路径即可。

### 合并优先级

```
多个数据源按顺序合并，后写的覆盖先写的：

  外部挂载源  <  批量导入  <  市场同步  <  GitHub  <  library.js  <  user-items.json
```

`user-items.json` 优先级最高，所以**编辑器改的东西永远生效，但不会动你的 `library.js`**。

---

## 编辑

| 操作 | 入口 |
|---|---|
| 新建 | 面板右上「＋ 新建」 |
| 编辑 | 卡片右上 ✎ |
| 删除 | 卡片右上 🗑（手写条目会被**隐藏**，源文件不动） |
| 改分组 | 把卡片**拖到左栏分组行** |
| 多选 | 卡片右上 ＋，或 Ctrl + 点击卡片 |
| 批量 | 选中后顶部出现：改分组 / 加标签 / 删除 |

> 删 `user-items.json` 即可回到「只有 library.js」的原始状态。

---

## 系统提示词

装载后本插件会往宿主注册一个 `ai-library` 提示词片段（`ctx.inject(['systemPrompt'], …)`，order 160），
告诉 AI：**本机新建/修改的文件要在回话前入库**，并给出各场景该用哪个工具（`library_import` / `library_autocapture` / `library_repo_build` / `library_save_url` / `library_paper_add`），以及先 `library_search` 查重、不要把密钥写进库。

片段文本是函数，数据根变化后下一个请求立即生效；服务不存在时不会影响插件加载。

## 给 AI 的工具

资料馆把这些能力**注册成工具**，AI 可以直接调用（不用翻文件）。共 14 个：

| 工具 | 类型 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `library_search` | 只读 | 搜条目。`meta` 搜标题/摘要/标签/备注；`fulltext` 深入文件内容（md/代码/PDF），返回命中片段；支持 `group` / `project` / `format` 限定（缩小范围省 token） |
| `library_get` | 只读 | 取一条的完整信息 + 文件是否存在 |
| `library_read` | 只读 | 抽文本：md/txt 直读，PDF 用自带 pdf.js（可按页） |
| `library_stats` | 只读 | 按类型/分组统计、有文件数、文本缓存状态 |
| `library_add` | 写入 | 新建条目（只写 `user-items.json`） |
| `library_update` | 写入 | 改字段（手写条目也能改，存为覆盖副本） |
| `library_save_url` | 写入 | 抓网页 → 存本地 md 快照 → 建条目 |
| `library_import` | 写入 | 把目录里的产物（pptx/docx/pdf/md/png/mp4…）批量入馆 |
| `library_autocapture` | 写入 | 增量入库：只收上次扫描后新增/变化的文件 |
| `library_repo_build` | 写入 | 从仓库建库：clone GitHub 或扫本地目录，README + docs 建条目 |
| `library_paper_search` | 检索 | 十源论文检索 + Sciverse（需 key），内置实现，无需 Python |
| `library_web_search` | 检索 | AnySearch 网页检索（匿名可用），找页面/PDF 落地页 |
| `library_paper_add` | 写入 | 把检索结果存成 `kind: paper` 条目 |
| `library_translate` | 长任务 | 提交 PDF 给 PDFMathTranslate，立刻返回 jobId |
| `library_job` | 长任务 | 查任务进度 / 产物 |

## 路由

宿主注册的全部 HTTP 路由（前缀 `/api/ai-library`）：

| 路由 | 方法 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/ai-library` | GET | 全量条目 + 大类 + 分组表 |
| `/file` | GET | 取 `items/` 下的文件（`?name=`） |
| `/vendor` | GET | 内置 pdf.js / three.js |
| `/log` | POST | 渲染进程错误上报 |
| `/item` | POST/PATCH/DELETE | 条目增改删 |
| `/bucket` | POST/PATCH/DELETE | 大类增改删 |
| `/install` | POST | 一键安装插件（`dsh plugin add`） |
| `/update` | POST | 自更新：本地 git 目录 `pull`，npm 安装则重装最新版 |
| `/repo` | GET | GitHub 仓库元信息 |
| `/compat` | GET | 包与当前 DSH 的兼容性 |
| `/og` | GET | GitHub 社交预览图（代理） |
| `/avatar` | GET | GitHub 头像（代理） |
| `/archive` | GET | 压缩包内容列表 |
| `/paper` | GET | 论文检索（十源 + Sciverse；`mode=semantic` 走语义检索） |
| `/paper/read` | GET | 读 Sciverse 原文切片（`doc` / `offset` / `limit`） |
| `/keys` | GET/POST | 论文平台 key 配置 |
| `/translate` | GET/POST | PDFMathTranslate 代理 |
| `/market` | POST | 同步插件市场 |
| `/motion` | GET | 外部提示词库资源 |

## 可选环境

插件**开箱即用**，下面这些都是可选的增强，**没有也能正常跑**。

| 能力 | 依赖 | 装法 | 什么时候才需要 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **论文翻译（保留排版）** | Docker + [PDFMathTranslate](https://github.com/PDFMathTranslate/PDFMathTranslate) | 见下 | 要读英文论文、需要**双语对照的 PDF** 时 |
| Office → PDF 预览 | 本机 LibreOffice | 正常安装即可 | 要预览 pptx / docx / xlsx 时 |
| 插件市场同步 | 外网 | 默认关闭，`config.json` 里开 `marketEnabled` | 想同步市场目录时 |
| 外部提示词挂载 | 本地目录 | 配 `motionDir` | 你有别的提示词库想只读挂进来时 |

### 论文翻译（可选）

**翻译成 PDF 是本插件最有价值的能力之一**：它不是把文字抽出来翻，而是**保留原文档排版**，生成中文/双语 PDF，公式、图表、目录位置都不动。

但它依赖 Docker，体积不小（镜像几 GB），所以**不是必装项**：

```bash
# 1. 装 Docker Desktop 并确保正在运行
# 2. 拉 PDFMathTranslate
git clone https://github.com/PDFMathTranslate/PDFMathTranslate
cd PDFMathTranslate
# 3. 起服务（默认监听 11008）
docker compose up -d
```

起好之后，在面板里打开任意 PDF，右上角「译中文」按钮就会工作。

> 没装也能用：按钮会提示「翻译服务不可用」，其余功能完全不受影响。
>
> 服务地址可改：`config.json` 的 `translateUrl`，或环境变量 `PDFMATHTRANSLATE_URL`。

**译文缓存**在 `<root>/.cache/translate/`，同一篇论文不会重复翻译。

---

## 给插件作者

资料馆是「收纳 + 检索」的底座：**任何插件只要能往 `POST /api/ai-library/item` 写一条数据，就自动获得分类树、卡片、预览、全文搜索和 AI 工具检索。**

字段契约、预览变体、工具注册写法、约定 —— 见 [INTEGRATION.md](INTEGRATION.md)。产品定位见 [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md)。

## 开发自检

改完代码、重启之前，先跑一遍预检（模拟 DSH 启动流程，逐项断言）：

```bash
node scripts/preflight.mjs
# 或者
npm run preflight
```

它会检查：

1. 关键文件是否齐全
2. `package.json` 合法、`name` 正确
3. **`cordis.patch.yml` 的 insert id 是否等于包名**（不一致会导致面板静默消失）
4. profile 的 `package.json` 合法
5. 宿主插件 import + apply（路由数、工具数、工具契约）
6. 客户端 bundle **被求值两次不炸**、只注册一次、注册 id 正确、能注册主面板

任何一项 ❌ 就别重启——省得触发 DSH 的「自动修复」把 profile 配置抹掉。

## 已知问题 / 踩过的坑

**1. 桌面版插件不能用 `import()` 加载相对路径**

渲染进程的源是 `dsh-app://`，`import('/api/...')` 会失败（`Failed to fetch dynamically imported module`）；但 `fetch()` 能用。所以加载 pdf.js 走的是 `fetch → Blob → import(blobUrl)`。

**2. pdf.js 只能用 4.x**

pdf.js 6 依赖 `Uint8Array.prototype.toHex`、`Map.prototype.getOrInsertComputed`（ES2025），Node 24 与常见 Electron 都没有 → 编译期就废。本插件锁定 4.10.38。

**3. 客户端插件必须自己声明 `module` / `exports`**

`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ factory })` 里 **loader 不注入**这两个变量，必须自己写：

```js
var module = { exports: {} };
var exports = module.exports;
Object.defineProperty(exports, Symbol.toStringTag, { value: 'Module' });
```

漏了会在模块求值阶段抛 `ReferenceError`，**整个界面起不来**。

**4. `ctx.config` 要声明 `inject: ['config']` 才能读**

未声明时访问会抛 `cannot get property "config" without inject`。

**5. Office 预览依赖本机 LibreOffice**

首次转 PDF 约 2 秒，之后命中缓存几十毫秒。没装 LibreOffice 时该功能静默降级为下载。

**6. 内嵌网页可能被对方拒绝**

带 `X-Frame-Options` / CSP 的站点（GitHub、知乎、DOI 等）在 iframe 里会空白，点击 `↗` 用新窗口打开。

---

## 开发

```
lib/
├─ index.js     宿主：8 条路由 + 数据合并 + 文件服务
├─ client.js    客户端：面板 UI + pdf.js 查看器 + 编辑器
└─ config.js    配置解析（路径全部从这里出）
vendor/         pdf.js 4.10.38 + 标准字体 + cmaps
```

改动生效方式：

| 改了什么 | 怎么生效 |
|---|---|
| `library.js` / `user-items.json` | 面板「刷新」 |
| `lib/client.js` / 样式 | 刷新页面 |
| `lib/index.js` / 新增路由 | **重启 DSH** |
| `config.json` | 重启 DSH |

本地自检（不用开 DSH）：

```bash
node .boot-check.mjs          # 客户端模块 boot + 面板渲染
```

---

## 许可

MIT（见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)）。

`vendor/` 下的 pdf.js 是 **Apache-2.0**，字体另有许可，详见 [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md)。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# FocusGuard

[Chinese](README.zh-CN.md) · English

Guardrails for AI coding agents, enforced at the hook layer. Four behaviours that make agents dangerous stop being prompt advice and become mechanically blocked events: **editing without reading first**, **conclusions without `[file:line]` evidence**, **whole-file reads that burn context**, and **asserting findings that were never verified**. A hit escalates through L1 push-back → L2 forced evidence → L3 fuse → L4 record → L5 downgrade → L6 report.

- **Zero dependencies** — the core package ships no runtime libraries (`dependencies` is empty)
- **Two enforcement surfaces** — a native DSH plugin (host hooks) plus the ZCode hook shell
- **Full audit trail** — every block is appended to `.focus-guard/AUDIT.log` (JSONL, rotated and archived)
- **Auditable rules** — `docs/RULES.md` marks which clauses are machine-enforced and which are not yet implemented

## Install

### DSH (native plugin, recommended)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:irisblackwood/focus-guard#path:/packages/core
```

Restart the session to activate. The bundle patch is declared by this package's `package.json` (`dsh.bundle.patch` → `src/dsh/cordis.patch.yml`).

> **Not on npm yet.** `npm install focus-guard` returns 404 — the package has never been published. Use the GitHub install above; it is the only supported route today.

⚠ Mutually exclusive with the official bridge (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code`). Mounting both double-runs the same hooks — pick one.

### ZCode

`.zcode-plugin/plugin.json` is ready; import this repository through ZCode's plugin flow.

## What it blocks

| Situation | Mechanism |
|---|---|
| Editing files or running mutating commands without investigating first | Layer 4 precondition: the target must have been read in this session, otherwise one refusal (new files exempt) |
| High-risk commands (recursive delete, format, force-push, publish, global install, system-path writes) | Layer 3 eligibility: **apply before execute**, denied without a grant; `fg_apply` is the request channel |
| Absolute red lines (`rm -rf /`, `DROP DATABASE`, `git push -f`) | Layer 1 zero-latency short-circuit denial, **no approval prompt** |
| Dangerous command strings that are merely **quoted** (test data, docs, eval fixtures) | Context exemption on three criteria (quoted / data marker / read-only command) → downgraded to semantic judgement instead of a hard denial |
| Wrongly blocked, no appeal path | `fg_appeal`: submit counter-evidence anchors, one human ruling, fully recorded |
| One-size-fits-all across models | Model profiles (`src/profiles/`): review intensity follows the model |
| Writing `grep`/`find` when the machine wants `rg`/`fd` | Environment fingerprint + hard command check, one-line substitution hint |

## Runtime additions (in-tree, 2026-10-18)

Shipped in the code, not yet reflected in the version number (still `3.0.6`):

- **Heartbeat and liveness** — `src/dsh/heartbeat.mjs:85`, `src/dsh/status.mjs:73`: every 10s the plugin atomically rewrites `.focus-guard/status.json`; `node src/dsh/status.mjs` reports `ALIVE` / `STALE` and exits `0` all-green, `2` module missing, `3` stale, `4` no file.
- **Module self-check** — `heartbeat.mjs:45`: the ten enforcement seams plus the heartbeat each report at startup; anything missing lands in `degraded`, is warned to the host log, and is injected to the model as `focus-guard-degraded`.
- **L4 cross-session record** — `src/dsh/workspace.mjs:38` (hash) / `:125` (turn record) / `src/dsh/index.js:71` (injection): state is keyed by `sha256(realpath(cwd))`; a hash mismatch injects nothing, so a renamed folder cannot inherit old state.
- **Whole-file read gate** — `src/dsh/pipeline.mjs:421` / `:645`: a target above 300 lines read without `offset`/`limit` is denied and pointed at XERJ (`xerj search` / `xerj def`). Configurable via `FG_WHOLE_FILE_MAX_LINES`.
- **Superpowers writing gate** — `src/dsh/pipeline.mjs:398`: a vague development request (dev verb + vague marker + no acceptance criteria) gets one denial before the first edit/write/destructive shell, requiring `brainstorming` or `writing-plans`; a retry or a loaded skill passes.
- **Graded destructive heuristic** — `src/dsh/pipeline.mjs:159`: `Remove-Item` / `fs.rmSync` weight by target — system path or recursive `0.9` (blocked), TEMP `0.2`, other `0.4`; redirection `0.15`.
- **Compaction watch** — `src/dsh/compactionWatch.mjs:239` / `:364`: observes `compaction/start|end|prune` and request-error collisions, records them, and never writes surface or cancels a turn.
- **Denial reasons in the audit** — `src/dsh/audit.mjs:120`: `auditDeny(exec, cmd, {trigger, level})` records the real rule (`redline:<name>`, `env-substitute`, `gate:fg_apply`, `evidence-gate`, `whole-file:lines`, `risk:<category>`) instead of a constant `high-risk-rm`.
- **Executor detection** — `src/core/env.mjs:18` + `src/dsh/index.js:31`: the master layer honours an explicit `FG_SHELL`; the DSH adapter declares `powershell`, ending the three-way mismatch between record, fingerprint and actual executor.
- **Audit isolation guard** — `tests/audit-isolation.mjs:1`: snapshots the real `AUDIT.log` before the suites run and fails the run if it grew (verified both ways: clean Δ0 PASS, deliberate pollution Δ1 FAIL).

## Six-layer eligibility

| Layer | Question |
|---|---|
| L0 | Request completeness — empty `purpose` / `scope` is denied |
| L1 | State — fuse / downgrade / budget exhausted |
| L2 | Absolute red lines (denied here, never reaches L3) |
| L3 | High-risk eligibility — matches a high-risk signature with no grant in this session → human approval |
| L4 | Preconditions — mutating targets must be evidenced; system paths and `.git`/`node_modules` are stricter |
| L5 | Semantic signals — the model probe's `mismatch` / high-risk score |
| L6 | Grant and record |

## Three commands

```bash
npm test                    # acceptance (version consistency, docs-vs-implementation alignment)
npm run test:eligibility    # eligibility + red-line exemption + appeal
npm run eval                # threat evaluation (high-risk detection rate + benign false-positive rate)
```

## Architecture

```
src/core/           master layer: zero-dependency, host-agnostic judging logic
src/adapters/dsh/   adapter layer: wires the master into DSH (fg_apply / fg_appeal + eligibility gate)
src/dsh/pipeline.mjs host hooks: pre-execute / system-prompt / post-execute
hooks/guard.mjs     ZCode execution shell (sealed: independent version, does not follow the main release)
```

**Layering rule**: the master layer must not depend back on the adapter layer (locked by an acceptance test).

## Version

Currently `3.0.7`. Eight version surfaces are asserted equal to each other and to the latest `CHANGELOG.md` entry.

## Docs

- Capabilities and troubleshooting: repository `README.md`, `INSTALL.md`
- Rule text: `docs/RULES.md`
- Changelog: repository `CHANGELOG.md`

## License

MIT © 2026 irisblackwood

# FocusGuard 聚焦护栏

[English](packages/core/README.md) · 中文

[![CI](https://github.com/irisblackwood/focus-guard/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/irisblackwood/focus-guard/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-3.0.7-369eff)](CHANGELOG.md)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-ffcb47)](LICENSE)
![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A518.17-339933)

**DSH 原生插件（3.0.5+）** + **ZCode 钩子** · 零依赖 · 钩子层 AI 行为治理

> **Hook-level guardrails for DSH**: blocks unverified edits, high-risk commands, and context-burning reads — with an auditable trail for every block.

> **FocusGuard 不是另一把 Hook 枪，它是 AI 行为治理的完整体系**：立法（法条定标准）→ 执法（引擎机械执行）→ 监察（全程留痕可复核）。日常对话零打扰，一旦出现未取证就改、结论无锚点、整读大文件烧上下文、无限空转等失控行为，立刻按梯度处罚——打回、强制取证、熔断、记档、降权、上报，人类随时可复核。

它不是提示词里的一句"请不要乱来"，而是把失控行为变成**钩子层可机械拦截的事件**。

## 30 秒速览

| 失控现象 | 机械拦截 | 人类看到 |
|---|---|---|
| 没调查就改文件 / 执行变更命令 | 触发① → L1 打回 | 一条拒绝原因 |
| 结论没有 `[文件:行号]` 证据 | 触发② → 收尾打回 | 一条打回理由 |
| 整读 50KB 大文件、裸 cat 刷屏 | 触发③ 体积三闸 | 一行"分段读或交子代理" |
| 反复无效调用、无限空转 | 触发④ 预算+停滞 → L3 熔断 | 熔断出口 + 三行降级方案 |
| 查无实据还硬凑 | 触发⑤ → 熔断 | 同上 |
| 拿到授权不吭声就绕过护栏 | 授权识别核验（引原文+法条） | 越权 → L3 熔断 |
| 顺手 `rm -rf` / `git push` / `npm publish` | 高危命令闸：一行审批单 | `y` 放行本次 / `n` 彻底阻断 |
| 上下文被巨量输出撑爆 | 污染检测 + 卷宗免重读 | 记档 + 复用已有取证 |
| 反复读同一个没变的文件 | 卷宗指纹 + TTL | 拦截本次 Read（`offset` 增量读永远放行） |
| 大搜索/大文档主会话硬扛 | 强制委派场景 + 委派法典 | KPI 计分，收尾结算委托池奖惩（3.0） |
| 表现只有记分牌没有后果 | KPI 兑现闭环（3.0） | 收尾即结算：等次 → 委托池 ±5/±2，跨任务累计 |
| 出了事日志是一笔糊涂账 | 因果链留痕 seq/chain/ref（3.0） | `npm run chain` 渲染因果树/因果图 |
| 经验库被 AI 自己写坏 | 资料分层 + 派生积木（3.0） | `.ai/library/` 只同步外部原文；积木由 library-build 派生，两区均禁直写 |
| 云端判定贵且离线不可用 | 本地零成本哨兵（3.0） | `FG_SENTINEL=1` 启用，Needle 2 可插拔外判 |
| 高危操作**事前**没有审核，出事才拦 | 资格审核六层 + `fg_apply` 申请通道（3.0.5） | 无授权 → 拒，理由指向申请入口 |
| 被**引用的**危险命令字符串被误拦 | 绝对红线上下文豁免：引号内 / 数据标记 / 只读命令三判据（3.0.6） | 降级到语义预判，不再直接拒 |
| 拦错了没有程序可走，只能绕过 | `fg_appeal` 误伤申辩（司法救济，3.0.6） | 人类一次性裁决：批准即豁免本次红线 |
| 大小模型一刀切，贵的模型被过度打扰 | 模型画像五份 + 按画像跳层（3.0.5） | 审核强度随模型调整 |
| 本机习惯用 `rg`/`fd`，AI 老写 `grep`/`find` | 环境指纹 + 命令硬校验（3.0.5） | 一行替代提示，不依赖模型自觉 |
| 超过 300 行的文件整读 | 第 1.4 层整文件闸 → 指向 XERJ 检索（2026-10-18） | `xerj search "<关键词>"` / `xerj def "<符号>"`，或带 offset/limit |
| 模糊需求上来就改代码 | 第 1.3 层 Superpowers 动笔闸（2026-10-18） | 先加载 `brainstorming` / `writing-plans`，再动笔 |
| 插件被炸了没人知道 | 心跳 + 11 模块启动自检（2026-10-18） | `status.json` 的 `modules_ok` / `degraded`，exit 0/2/3/4 |
| 换会话/改文件夹名后旧状态乱注入 | L4 跨会话卷宗按路径哈希路由（2026-10-18） | hash 不符 → 一条都不注入 |

## 为什么需要它

AI 智能体最常见的三种失控：

1. **思考失控**：没有证据就开猜，越查越偏，停不下来；
2. **资源失控**：整读大文件、未过滤刷屏，上下文和 token 被无意义输出撑爆；
3. **权限失控**：拿不准也硬改，先斩后奏，出了问题无法追溯。

"立法 → 执法 → 监察"三件套把这三类失控变成可拦截的行为事件：**法条**（[packages/core/docs/RULES.md](packages/core/docs/RULES.md)）定标准，**引擎**机械执行，**留痕**（`.focus-guard/AUDIT.log`）接受人类复核。

引擎按"母版层 → 适配层 → 宿主缝"三层组织（[《资料与代码分层总规范》](packages/core/docs/MASTER-PLAN-3.0.0.md)）：

| 层 | 位置 | 职责 |
|---|---|---|
| **母版层** | `packages/core/src/core/` | 零依赖、宿主无关的判定逻辑：六层资格审核 / 模型画像 / 绝对红线与上下文豁免 / 申辩 / 卷宗状态 / 审计写入器。**不得反向依赖适配层**（有验收用例锁定） |
| **适配层** | `packages/core/src/adapters/dsh/` | 把母版接进 DSH：`fg_apply` / `fg_appeal` 工具注册 + 资格闸。**只许向下依赖母版** |
| **宿主缝** | `packages/core/src/dsh/pipeline.mjs` | DSH 原生插件的三条缝：pre-execute / system-prompt / post-execute。作为**组装根**允许调用适配层 |
| **ZCode 执行壳** | `packages/core/hooks/guard.mjs` | 六事件钩子入口（`hooks.json` 协议接口保持不变）。**已封存**——ZCode 兼容层，版本号独立、不随主版本更新，改动须谨慎 |

依赖方向由 `packages/core/tests/layering.test.mjs` 锁定：`core → adapter → seam` 单向，另禁止 `zcode → 适配层/宿主缝`。自检脚本 `packages/core/tools/selftest.mjs` 属工具层，不在生产源码目录。

## 核心机制

### 空气层（日常零打扰）
对话、分析、讨论、解释：不查、不拦、不提醒。执法只看行为，不查词。

### 触发层（行为五条，违规即罚）

| # | 触发条件 | 判定 |
|---|---|---|
| ① | 未取证就改 | 本回合 0 次调查（读文件/Grep/搜索/只读命令）就 Write/Edit/改动类 Bash |
| ② | 无锚点结论 | 回合内调用 ≥5 次后收尾无 `[文件:行号]`/`[日志原文]`/工具结果，也未标【假设】 |
| ③ | 体积刺客 | 整读 >50KB 文件、Grep content 无 head_limit、裸 cat/type 刷屏（批示含"审计/盘点/审查"时，取证对象整读留痕不罚——2.5.3） |
| ④ | 动态预算超限 | 有效调用超任务预算，或连续 3 次无效调用（真失控） |
| ⑤ | 硬凑不熔断 | 查无实据仍强行猜测；连续 2 次未知声明同样熔断 |

### 梯度处罚（L1–L6）

`L1 打回重写 → L2 强制取证 → L3 熔断 → L4 记档 → L5 降权 → L6 上报人类`

同回合违规数累加自动爬升。熔断期只读调查类仍可用、改动类全拒、非只读放行的高危命令同样拒绝（2.5.2 修复）。人类新指令即"批示"、全部解除；**唯「停止/熔断」批示本身就是熔断**，不会被解除。

### 预算与进度检测（三预算池）

- 初始预算按批示关键词核定：审计/红队/重构/全量/批量/探索/遍历/升级/补丁 → **50**；修复/添加/修改/重命名/删除 → **15**；其他 → **10**。首轮可声明【任务规模】上调，只升不降，硬上限 **200**；
- **三池分立**：侦查池（只读，独立 15 次）／执行池（Write/Edit/变更命令）／委托池（子代理，独立 20 次），互不挤占；短指令『追加额度』执行/侦查/委托三池各 +10；
- **有效调用**（返回内容有变化/产生文件变更/出现新报错）满阈值自动续杯 +10；
- **无效调用**（重复读同一内容/同命令同返回/失败调用）连续 3 次 → 判真失控直接熔断；停滞 2 次可申请【信用延期】，由人类批示。

### 卷宗体系（四册，总纲见 [docs/MASTER-PLAN-2.0.0.md](packages/core/docs/MASTER-PLAN-2.0.0.md)）

工作区档案 `<工作区>/.ai/CASE_FILE.md`：

| 册 | 内容 | 维护方 |
|---|---|---|
| 【一】环境声明 | OS / Shell / 编码 / 路径分隔符 / 大小写敏感 / BSD 工具 / 可用命令 | 引擎（会话级一次检测，结果直接落卷可查阅） |
| 【二】项目依赖声明 | 依赖名 / 版本 / 安装路径 / 信任 TTL（如游戏本体 60 天） | **人工填写** |
| 【三】侦查取证记录 | 文件名 / 读取时间 / mtime / size / SHA-256 / 变更历史 / TTL / 验证方式 | 引擎自动追加 |
| 【四】工作额度台账 | 初始额度 / 已用 / 剩余 / 有效 / 无效调用 / KPI | 引擎（回合末落卷） |

- **环境检测一次全程复用**：SessionStart 检测一次，`UserPromptSubmit` 不重检，仅在探测到 shell 变化时重检；
- **跨回合取证指纹**：mtime + size + SHA-256（≤200KB）+ git 脏态，指纹一致且 TTL 未超 → **免重读放行**（拦截本次 Read，复用已有取证）；不一致或超时 → 放行真重读并更新卷宗。时间戳伪造（`touch -d`/`cp -p`/`git checkout`）无法绕过 SHA 内容校验；**免重读限同一会话内**——跨会话继承的卷宗指纹只提示不拦，首读永远放行（2.5.3）；
  - **边界（别读成"任何尺寸都防伪"）**：SHA-256 只对 ≤200KB 的文件计算。超过 200KB 退回 mtime+size+git；工作区没有 git 时（`gitDirty` 为 null），"同尺寸改写 + 还原 mtime"无法被察觉。大文件请依赖版本库或单独做内容校验；
- **自适应 TTL**：首次 4 小时 → 7 天内有变 2 小时 → 7–30 天未变 24 小时 → 30 天未变 7 天；优先级 **依赖声明 > 人工标注（【三】TTL 列手填）> 自适应**；
- **免重读豁免**：`offset` 增量读永远放行；熔断/强制取证期豁免（降级重建证据需要真重读）；
- **跨平台命令拦截**（按检出 shell 适配）：PowerShell 会话禁 bash 管道（`\| head`、`&&`）与裸 Get-Content，改用 `Select-String`/`Measure-Object`/`-TotalCount`；macOS 禁 `sed -i` 无后缀、`grep -P`、`readlink -f`；大小写不敏感文件系统禁仅大小写不同的重名文件；Linux 标准 GNU 无特殊限制。

### 监察与留痕

- **盲写拦截**：写"本回合没读过的已存在文件"100% 拦截；
- **风险文件留痕**：`package.json`、lock、CI 配置、`.env`、`.csproj` 等修改 100% 记录；
- **抽查A**：每 5 次写操作全量审计 1 次（确定性节奏，不是随机抽样）；
- **上下文污染检测**：工具输出与指令矛盾（单条语句的 head 行数超限 / 清单路径重复；复合命令不整段对账——2.5.3）→ 立即停用该输出，用带标记的小命令隔离核实并报告人类；
- **回合卫生**：回合开始核验上一回合计数/熔断/取证/降权残留（43条），异常记档后清理；新会话发现 `HANDOFF.md` 注入交叉巡视提醒（36条）；引擎与工作区源码版本不一致告警（42条）；
- 一切执法行为（触发/处罚/抽查/特赦/预算伸缩）写入 `<工作区>/.focus-guard/AUDIT.log`（JSONL）：时间 / 会话 / 动作 / 触发条件 / 级别 / 证据 / 是否特赦。

### 授权与高危命令审批

- **授权识别**：凡声称依人类授权绕过护栏（熔断/锚点/预算/体积），必须先出【授权识别】引人类指令**原文** + 指明法条依据；引擎核验引文确实出现在本回合指令且含授权语义。伪造/事后补 → L3 熔断；意图明显但未明说 → 出【授权待确认】暂停并提问；
- **高危命令闸**：即使完全访问（yolo/自动批准）模式，**六类不可逆命令仍须实时审批**——
  破坏性删除（`rm -r`、`rm --recursive`、`shutil.rmtree`、`find -delete`、`rimraf`、`DROP TABLE`）、
  强制推送与历史覆盖（`git push`、`git reset --hard`、`git clean -fd`）、
  系统权限与配置（`chmod 777`、`chown`、`reg add/delete`、`net user`）、
  全局依赖安装（`npm i -g`、`pnpm add -g`、`yarn global add`、`apt-get install`、`docker run --privileged`）、
  对外发送与发布（`npm publish`、`docker push`、`curl -X POST`/`-d`、`wget --post-data`）、
  数据库影响（无 where 的 `DELETE`/`UPDATE`、`DROP DATABASE`）；
- **审批单是唯一通道**：命中 → 拒绝并要求一行
  `【高危申请】命令：<真实命令> | 真实目的：<一句话> | 影响范围：<具体文件/表/系统> | 回滚方案：<可否回滚> | 允许执行？(y/n)`；
  收尾没带单 → Stop 打回补交（一次性，不无限重复）；
- **`y` 放行本次**（一次性，改一个字符都要重新申请）；**`n` 彻底阻断**（会话内不得重发）。中文同样有效：**同意/批准** = y，**不/拒绝** = n；
- **预授权隔离**：任务指令里的「最后上传 github」只是目标预授权（goal），不解锁任何执行；执行级授权只认人类当下对审批单的短批示；
- **严禁脚本包装**：被拒后写 `push.sh` 再执行 = 对抗审查（从重记档）；高危脚本的**写入本身**也要走审批单；
- **不设卡**：普通单文件 rm、构建、测试、本地 commit、常规 `curl` GET——零打断。放松日常 + 刚性高危。

### 事前资格审核与司法救济（3.0.5 / 3.0.6 / 2026-10-18 增量）

高危命令闸管的是**事后拦截**（命中即拒，再交人类审批）。3.0.5 起在其之前加一道**事前资格审核**：高危工具**先申请、后执行**，无授权直接拒。

- **六层判定**（`packages/core/src/core/checkEligibility.mjs`，母版层、依赖注入、不反向依赖适配层）：

  | 层 | 判什么 |
  |---|---|
  | L0 | 申请完整性——`purpose` / `scope` 空白即拒 |
  | L1 | 状态——熔断 / 降权 / 预算耗尽 |
  | L2 | 绝对红线（命中即拒，且不进 L3） |
  | L3 | 高危资格——命中 `HIGH_RISK_TOOLS` 且本会话无授权 → 转人工审批 |
  | L4 | 前置条件——改动类目标须已取证；系统路径 / 特殊目录（`.git`、`node_modules`）加严 |
  | L5 | 语义信号——模型探针的 `mismatch` / 高风险分 |
  | L6 | 授权并留痕 |

- **双入口闭环**：`fg_apply`（申请 → 审核 → 按 session 授权）与 pre-execute 的 `gateToolCall`（无授权 → deny，理由指向 `fg_apply`）。审核期临时授权、未通过立即收回，避免申请通道被自己的 L3 挡死。
- **模型画像**：`src/profiles/` 五份纯参数画像（`deepseek-flash` / `deepseek-pro` / `glm` / `gpt-astra` / `default`），按画像跳层并把跳过项写入 trace 与审计。不传画像时与 3.0.4 行为一致。**画像不能关闭审批层**（`profileLoader.mjs` 的 `FORCED_ON_SWITCHES` 强制启用 `approvalGate`），也不能放行红线层；`approvalGate.scope` 只决定"哪些类别需审批"（`irreversible` 时非不可逆高危放行、不可逆类仍须审批）。
- **环境指纹与命令硬校验**：`packages/core/tools/env-fingerprint.mjs` 探测平台 / shell / 工具并产出 `.ai/env-fingerprint.json`；pipeline 第 1.5 层据其 `map` 表做命令硬校验（`grep`→`rg`、`find`→`fd` 等替代提示），不依赖模型自觉。
- **绝对红线上下文豁免**（3.0.6）：红线在**文本层**匹配，分不清"要执行的命令"与"被引用的命令字符串"。三条判据把后者**降级到第 2 层语义预判**（绝不直接放行）：① 命中片段完整落在引号字面量内；② 片段前有显式数据标记（`示例：`/`例如：`/`测试数据`/`prompt:`/`【假设】`/代码围栏）且命令非变更类；③ 首 token 属只读输出命令。**执行外壳一律不豁免**（`bash -c` / `cmd /c` / `eval` / `iex` / 解释器 `-e`·`-c`）——那些引号里的内容是真执行。豁免写 `AUDIT.log`（`action:"redline-exempt"` + 判据名 + 命中片段）。
- **误伤申辩（司法救济通道，3.0.6）**：`fg_appeal` 让被拦方能**当场申辩**，不必等修法。参数携带被拦命令原文，故 pipeline 在**所有闸之前**处理它（否则会被同一规则再拦一次），转成 `{kind:"ask"}` 交人类一次性裁决：批准 → 开通该工具一次授权（`ttl=turn`）+ 豁免本次命中红线；拒绝 → 维持拦截。全程留痕 `appeal-filed` / `appeal-granted` / `appeal-denied`。法条依据见 [RULES.md](packages/core/docs/RULES.md) 第八十三条(四)。

### 子代理委派（v2.3.0：高产出、低污染）

| 机制 | 规则 | 机械化 |
|---|---|---|
| 委托池独立核算 | 默认 20 次/任务，不占执行池；用尽批示『追加额度』三池各 +10 | 每次委派记 `delegate-used`；用尽拒绝并请示 |
| 摘要强制格式 | 主会话只收【子代理摘要】四字段（任务/结果/异常/文件线索），≤200 字 | 超长或缺字段 → 拒收要求压缩（KPI-3） |
| 强制委派场景 | 全库搜索 ≥3 目录或 ≥10 文件 / 大文档 >50KB 或 >2000 行 / 批量 ≥5 文件 | 未委派 → 未尽职提醒（KPI-5）；已委派 +5 |
| 独立并行任务 | 两个任务互不依赖 | **自申明**：引擎无机械特征，不判罚也不加分，AI 不得据此声称"已尽职" |
| 合法委派边界 | 正常委派放行不计违规 | 仅熔断期启动子代理 = 越权绕行（L4+L5） |

### 正面指引（告诉 AI 怎么干活）

负面清单管下限，正面指引给标准动作（法条第十五章之一，74–79 条；运行时镜像 [packages/core/skills/focus-thinking/SKILL.md](packages/core/skills/focus-thinking/SKILL.md) §10）：

| 树杈 | 标准动作 | 机械化 |
|---|---|---|
| 环境适配 | 环境不主动探测，行为暴露后自动适配；有 `.git` 用 `git restore`，没有用 `.ai/backup/` | 每次 Write/Edit 前自动备份到 `.ai/backup/`（保留最近 100 份；>200KB 跳过；`.env`/私钥不落明文副本） |
| 返工与提交 | 只回滚出错文件；重试带"失败包裹"（报错行号 + 堆栈尾 30 行 + 限定范围）；本地 commit 测试全绿 AI 可做 | **高危审批单**：`git push` 命中特征库须【高危申请】，`--dry-run` 例外 |
| 污染与日志 | 参数-输出矛盾 → 标记可疑；改文件前先出【污染核实】声明；超大日志只取统计 + 堆栈尾 30 行 | **污染核实闸**：污染检出后首个改动类先拦一次 |
| 任务编排 | 第一句话声明"通过条件"（可测 = 退出码 0；不可测 = 编译 + 不崩溃 + 《人类验收清单》）；机械任务优先内置库与既有预制脚本（`.ai/tools/`，存在则用） | 结案以机器退出码为准 |
| 人类交互 | 提交前固定一行：`【提交申请】修改:<文件> (+n,-m) \| 测试:n/n 绿 \| 允许提交？(y/n)`；仅不可逆操作请示 | 其余全自动 |
| 经验固化 | L2/L3 或回滚后往 `.ai/PATTERNS.md` 追加 `[环境:x] [任务:y] 以后遇到 X 必须先做 Y`；新任务不预读，卡点时 Grep 检索 | 熔断出口提示经验固化（触发熔断时引擎确保该文件存在） |

## 工作原理

```
SessionStart       → 环境检测一次 + 卷宗载入（重建取证缓存与 TTL 表）+ 注入执法模型
UserPromptSubmit   → 批示识别（关键词预算 / 信用延期 / 特赦 / 追加额度 / y-n）+ 重置任务态（保留侦查缓存）+ shell 变化重检 + 任务链起新链
PreToolUse         → 平台命令拦截 + 本地哨兵（opt-in）+ 图书馆直写拦截 + 高危审批闸 + 熔断白名单 + 未取证拦截 + 污染核实闸 + 体积三闸 + 盲写拦截 + 卷宗免重读 + 改动前备份
PostToolUse        → 进度检测引擎（三池 / 续杯 / 停滞熔断）+ 卷宗取证记录 + 污染检测 + 抽查 + 委派 KPI 计分
PostToolUseFailure → 失败计入停滞
Stop               → 回合边界 + 证据锚点检查 + 授权识别核验 + 审批单格式校验 + KPI 兑现结算 + 额度台账落卷
```

拦截协议：PreToolUse 以**退出码 2** 拒绝工具调用（原因走 stderr，原文透传给模型）；Stop / PostToolUse 返回 `{"decision":"block","reason":...}` 打回重写。所有打回路径都有一次性保护（`stopBlocked` + 宿主的 `stop_hook_active`），不会因强制续跑变成死循环。

DSH 原生插件（`src/dsh/pipeline.mjs`）在**同一条 PreToolUse 缝**上按序叠加（各段独立 fail-open，异常一律放行或原样透传）：

```
申辩入口(fg_appeal) → 第3层状态/取证校验 → 绝对红线(+上下文豁免/申辩凭据) → 第1.5层命令硬校验
→ 资格审核闸(fg_apply) → 第2层语义预判(哨兵) → next
```

- **第 3 层取证校验**只对**已存在文件**的修改要求先读；**新建文件**无目标可读，直接放行（否则死锁）；
- **L3 不接红线上下文豁免**（闸接、L3 不接）：闸是"无授权即 deny"、无人类环节，必须自判豁免；L3 是"转人工审批"、人类环节本身就是裁决。若 L3 也豁免，"数据形态的高危命令"会无人审批直接放行——风险不对称。判定写在 `checkEligibility.mjs` 第 3 层注释里，防后人当缺陷改回。

留痕协议：AUDIT.log（JSONL）每条带 `seq`（事件唯一号）/ `chain`（任务链，委派派生 `/dN` 子链）/ `ref`（父事件）三字段——流水账可随时重组为因果树：`node packages/core/tools/audit-chain.mjs <AUDIT.log> [--mermaid]`。

落盘全图（写入面共 9 处）：AUDIT.log、卷宗【一】环境声明、【三】侦查记录、【四】额度台账（同 CASE_FILE.md）、会话状态（%TEMP%）、改动前备份（.ai/backup/）、PATTERNS.md 经验库、TEMP 陈旧清扫、派生积木与索引（仅 library-build 写到 .ai/output/library/）。

### 双包架构（3.0.6）：范本 + 衍生

本仓是 npm monorepo，**一个项目、两个包**：

| 包 | 路径 | 定位 |
|---|---|---|
| **`focus-guard`** | `packages/core/` | **零依赖范本**——引擎钩子、技能、核心工具、法条文档、**DSH 原生插件**。`npm install focus-guard` 只下载本包，不拉任何外接依赖。主分支即从此包发版，可衍生无数变体。**DSH 挂载的正是这个包**——它的 `package.json` 版本就是 GUI 里显示的那个。 |
| **`focus-guard-extended`** | `packages/extended/` | **扩展衍生包**——依赖 core（`"dependencies": {"focus-guard": "^3.0.6"}`），承载重型外接三件套：OpenViking 积木同步桥（`viking-bridge.mjs`）、Needle 2 外判运行器（`needle2-sentinel.mjs`）、Semantica LPG 图谱导出（`audit-chain-semantica.mjs`）。 |

衍生纪律（详见 [packages/extended/bridges/README.md](packages/extended/bridges/README.md)）：桥只依赖主分支**契约**（审计 JSONL 格式、哨兵外判协议、积木 INDEX 格式），禁止 import 主分支源码，禁止被主分支引用（验收用例锁定零反向依赖）；桥故障一律静默回退核心默认行为。新增外接 = 在 extended 包加一个自包含文件 + 一条桥测试。

- **CI**：每次推送/PR 自动跑验收 + 对抗评测（[.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml)）。Windows 必过；Linux/macOS 为观察项（验收里仍有数处 Windows shell 检测用例未平台化），Node 18.20 / 20 / 22 矩阵；
- **本地质量闸（pre-push 钩子，GitHub Actions 不可用环境的主闸）**：`.githooks/pre-push` 在每次 `git push` 前强制 `npm run check`（验收 + 对抗评测），不过即阻止推送，结果留痕 AUDIT.log（`ci-pre-push` 事件）。克隆后启用一次：`git config core.hooksPath .githooks`；强行绕过（`--no-verify`）按法规须先批示——钩子留痕只在正常触发时写入，绕过即失察；
- **覆盖范围**（101 用例）：动态预算与三池分池、进度检测与信用延期、触发①②③④⑤（含审计豁免）、梯度处罚与熔断只读放行、卷宗体系（环境检测 / 环境声明落卷 / 免重读含会话内限定 / SHA 防伪 / TTL 三级覆盖 / 台账落卷 / caseCache 裁剪）、跨平台命令拦截、盲写与抽查A、上下文污染与污染核实闸（含复合命令不误报）、授权识别（伪造引文 → L3 / 合规声明 → 特赦 / 待确认 → 暂停）、高危命令闸（特征库 / 审批单 / y-n 一次性 / 预授权隔离 / 脚本包装端到端 / 熔断期拒绝 / 超长命令）、子代理委派与委托池、极限场景（80KB 命令行、2MB 响应、损坏状态、奇异会话 ID、中文路径）、DSH 桥接自适应，以及工程自检（七处清单版本一致性 / 版本追赶 / 五处说明互不重复 / 文档-实现口径对齐 / RULES 注入逐字镜像 / hooks.json ↔ 引擎映射 / 部署漂移核验 / 61条陈旧清理）；
- **对抗评测样本**按"同一危险动作的多种写法"组织（别名、长旗标、传参穿插）并配良性反例，避免用误报换检出。

## 设计取舍与已知边界

- **回合边界双保险**：实测 `UserPromptSubmit` 不保证触发，回合计数由可靠的 `Stop` 事件兜底清零，`reset` 仅作尽力而为的提前重置；
- **钩子读取的是安装副本**：改源码不会自动生效，需同步安装缓存或经市场更新——"源码已升级但引擎没变"是这套系统最常见的部署事故，[INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) FAQ 4 有排查步骤；
- **平台受限暂缓条款**：第 21 条 Token 成本核算、第 37 条思考链监管（钩子层不可见 token 用量与思考时长）、第 64 条(二)(三)(四)限流（无对应信号）；第 48 条子代理继承以留痕方式实现。**完整"未机械化条款清单"见 [packages/core/docs/RULES.md](packages/core/docs/RULES.md) 附注**——凡清单所列，AI 不得声称已由引擎自动执行；
- **>200KB 文件没有内容级防伪**：见上文卷宗体系边界说明；
- **引号内的危险字样：按上下文分级**（3.0.6）——`echo "git push"`、`grep -rn "delete from users"` 这类**被引用的数据**经三条判据（引号内 / 数据标记 / 只读命令）降级到语义预判，不再直接拒；**执行外壳内的一律不豁免**（`bash -c "…"`、`node -e "…"`、`eval "…"`），因为那是真执行。仍未覆盖的形态：无引号又无数据标记的裸引用、`rm${IFS}-rf` 类拼接。判据名与命中片段写入 `AUDIT.log` 可复核；
- **特征库不可能堵完**：`rm${IFS}-rf`、base64 管道、shell 别名等在射程之外，护栏治的是"顺手失控"，不是定向对抗；
- **免重读的边界**：指纹一致但会话上下文已被压缩时，用 `offset` 增量读或请批示；【二】依赖声明与【三】TTL 列人工标注可按需放宽/收紧；
- **行业对照（2026-10 系统提示词研究，详见 `docs/analysis/`）**：各大厂商把 Agent 持久性推到极致（"persist until complete"）且提示词层无一设预算机制。FocusGuard 的定位由此清晰：坚持性交给模型自判（厂商已做好），**成本台账与破坏性关卡由宿主侧硬约束承担**——熔断随模型进化从常开保险丝退为断路器，但断路器不拆；
- **违禁词扫描已废弃**（v3.0 起"不查词"）：空气层允许口语与主观语气，执法只看行为。

## 版本与变更

当前 **v3.0.7**。完整历史见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。近期版本：

- **3.0.7 运行面与自证**：心跳/存活确认（`status.json` + 11 模块自检 + `focus-guard-degraded` 注入）、L4 跨会话卷宗（按 `sha256(realpath(cwd))` 路由，hash 不符零注入）、第 1.4 层整文件读取闸（>300 行指向 XERJ `search`/`def`）、第 1.3 层 Superpowers 动笔闸（模糊开发任务先加载方法论）、破坏性 API 按目标分级、压缩监察、`FG_AUDIT_FILE` 优先 + deny 记录真实 trigger、审计零增长守卫；**首次通过 GitHub Actions OIDC（Trusted Publishing）发布，包内不含任何长期凭据**；
- **3.0.6 绝对红线上下文豁免与司法救济**：`redlineExempt()` 三判据（引号内 / 数据标记 / 只读命令）把"被引用的危险命令字符串"**降级**到语义预判，执行外壳一律不豁免；新增 **误伤申辩程序** `fg_appeal`（司法救济通道，补齐"只有立法救济、没有个案当场申辩"的结构缺口）；画像接入真实 pre-execute 链路 + 画像/豁免在真实入口失效的 4 项修复；审批层不可被画像关闭；`approvalGate.scope` 由死配置变真判定；闸接入红线豁免、红线判据 span 稳定化、取证闸对新建文件不再死锁；条款清理 91→87；**版本面补全为 8 处**（此前漏了 monorepo 子包，导致"清单齐 3.0.4 而代码已 3.0.6"）；
- **3.0.5 事前资格审核与模型画像**：`checkEligibility` 六层判定（L0 申请完整性 / L1 状态 / L2 绝对红线 / L3 高危资格 / L4 前置条件 / L5 语义信号 / L6 授权留痕）+ `fg_apply` 双入口闭环（申请 → 审核 → 按 session 授权）；`src/profiles/` 五份纯参数模型画像 + `profileLoader` 按画像跳层；环境指纹与命令硬校验（`grep`→`rg`、`find`→`fd`）；`guard.mjs` 三次拆出 `src/core/` 九个模块与 `src/adapters/dsh/protocol.mjs`（1707 → 1142 行）；

- **3.0.3 主分支精简版**：外接三件套移出主分支（迁 `packages/extended`），主分支保留哨兵本体与外判契约；
- **3.0.2 外接三件套**：`viking-bridge`（OpenViking 积木同步）/ `audit-chain --semantica`（Semantica 图谱导出）/ `needle2-sentinel`（Needle 2 外判运行器）+ 批示词尾置容错；
- **3.0.1 合并审批**：多条高危待批合并出示、一次 `y` 放行全部（各一次性消费）；批示词容错（"y，顺带把文档也改了"）；写入闸对抗审查同源判定；
- **3.0.0 协作治理版**：按 3.0 规划（十大原则）将治理面从单会话扩展到多代理协作与知识资产——中心调度与蜂群委派法典（第八十条）、去中心化验证（八十一）、静态积木图书馆 `.ai/library/`（八十二）、本地零成本哨兵 `tools/sentinel.mjs`（八十三，Needle 2 可插拔）、KPI 兑现闭环（八十四，收尾结算等次→委托池奖惩）、提问漏斗（八十五）、因果链留痕 seq/chain/ref + `tools/audit-chain.mjs`（八十六）；新增 `tools/library-build.mjs` 积木构建器；修复 deep-review 遗留：FG-D1 引文核验窗口 500→4000 字符、FG-D2 原子写、FG-D3 tmp 残片、FG-D4 降级防御、解释器 eval 不再判只读侦查；法典增第十五章之二（第八十～八十六条）；

- **2.5.3 实测误伤修复版**：卷宗继承指纹只提示不拦（跨会话首读不再被拦）；58 条对账限单条语句（复合命令误报清零）；审计任务体积闸豁免；卷宗【一】/PATTERNS.md 写失败告警；61 条落地（启动清扫 30 天未动临时文件）；法典 v1.1 修法（SKILL 效力条款改为"暂停机械执行＋报请裁决"、废止 19/24四/44/45/46 条、47 条限定同机跨运行时）；仓库迁移 irisblackwood；验收 86 → 90；

# DeepSeek 价格峰谷提醒

在 Harness Web UI 的输入框下方显示一个小胶囊，提醒你 DeepSeek 官方 API 当前处于 **峰价** 还是 **谷价**，以及距离下次切换还有多久。点开胶囊可以查看当前价目表（人民币）、峰时规则、数据来源和抓取时间，并可从官网重新抓取。

使用 DeepSeek Harness 的创造模式完成。

## 功能

- **实时读数**：按官网规则计算当前时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，周一至周五，不含中国法定节假日），并倒计时到下一次切换。
- **人民币价目表**：读取官方中文定价页，显示模型、档位、缓存命中/未命中输入价、输出价，峰/谷两档同时列出，当前生效的一档高亮。
- **从官网更新**：面板里的“立即更新”会读取 <https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing>，同时更新价格和峰谷时段规则（时间窗口、星期、是否排除节假日）。
- **自动更新**：启动时以及之后每 30 分钟检查一次，缓存超过 `autoRefreshHours` 小时就在后台重新抓取。抓取失败时保留旧表，并在面板里报告原因。
- **Agent 工具**：`deepseek_price_tip`，`action: status | refresh`，与面板共用同一份数据。

## 安装

本仓库就是插件包本身（`package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 和 `dsh.client`），没有构建步骤，也没有第三方依赖，只用 Node 内置模块。

**从 GitHub 安装**

在 Harness 的插件管理里安装这个 bundle，安装 spec 填：

```text
github:jaaaa34/dsh-deepseek-price-tip
```

也可以让 Agent 调用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，`target` 用同一个 spec。装好后重启 Harness Web UI，输入框下方就会出现胶囊。

**本地开发时直接 link**

在 profile 的 `package.json` 里把依赖指向本目录，并把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```json
"@local/deepseek-price-tip": "link:C:/path/to/dsh-deepseek-price-tip"
```

## 数据与缓存

| 内容 | 位置 |
| --- | --- |
| 人民币价格、峰时窗口、星期规则 | 首次抓取后写入 `data/pricing-cache.json` |
| 内置兜底数据 | `lib/pricing.js` 的 `DEFAULT_PRICING`（2026-10-18 抓取，人民币） |
| 中国法定节假日 | 内置 2026 年安排，来源见 `HOLIDAY_SOURCE`；跨年后请用配置补充 |

如果官网表格结构发生大改，解析会失败而不是写入半张表：界面继续显示上一次成功的数据，并提示失败原因。

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中给这一行加 `config`：

```yaml
- id: deepseek-price-tip
  name: '@local/deepseek-price-tip'
  config:
    autoRefreshHours: 6
    # 可选：覆盖峰时窗口，单位是 UTC 零点的分钟数
    # peakWindows: [[60, 240], [360, 600]]
    # 可选：覆盖星期（0 = 周日，6 = 周六）
    # weekdays: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    # 可选：追加法定节假日（YYYY-MM-DD）
    # holidays: ['2027-01-01']
    # 可选：换一个抓取地址（英文页会按美元解析并显示 $）
    # sourceUrl: 'https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing'
```

`autoRefreshHours: 0` 关闭自动抓取，只保留手动按钮。

## 验证

```powershell
npm test
```

也可以单独跑其中一组：

```powershell
node test/pricing.test.mjs   # 解析、峰谷计算、节假日、缓存校验
node test/host.test.mjs      # Host 路由、刷新、失败回退、Agent 工具
node test/client.test.mjs    # Client 注册、locale 字典、样式清理
```

不需要 `npm install`：测试只用 Node 内置模块（Node 20+）。GitHub Actions 在 Node 20/22/24 上跑同一套测试，见 `.github/workflows/test.yml`。

安装后在 Harness Web UI 里确认：输入框下方出现胶囊；点开有价目表；点“立即更新”后抓取时间变化。浏览器内的实际渲染效果需要在页面中查看，测试只覆盖模块注册和纯逻辑。

## 限制

- 峰时窗口支持官网中文页的“北京时间 … 为高峰时段”和英文页的 “Peak hours are … UTC” 两种写法；页面改版时可能需要调整解析器。
- 节假日只内置到 2026 年。2027 年及以后，界面会明确提示“未内置该年节假日”，避免把节假日误报成峰价。
- 价格表按官网当前的“模型列 + 峰/谷行”结构解析；Search & Fetch 的按次计费不在模型价目表内。
- 人民币价格直接取自官方中文页，不是按汇率从美元换算。
- 缓存写在插件包目录里的 `data/pricing-cache.json`（已在 `.gitignore` 中忽略）。重新安装或升级插件会让这份缓存丢失，下次刷新时重新抓取，期间用内置的 `DEFAULT_PRICING` 兜底。

No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# dsh-errkb

![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-P5%20complete-yellow)
![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/jingchangzhao-gif/dsh-errkb)
![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

> **Roadmap rebaselined on 2026-10-13.** The ordered implementation source is now
> [`docs/implementation-plan.md`](docs/implementation-plan.md), starting at `EKB-001`.
> The detailed sections below document the current DSH prototype and retain some legacy
> `T`/`X` task references until the README closeout card `EKB-055`.

> Recycles errors: the same failure is diagnosed once, recorded, and handed back as a known fix the next time it appears.

`dsh-errkb` keeps one numbered, human-editable error knowledge base and delivers it in **two forms**:

| Form | What it is | State |
| ---- | ---------- | ----- |
| **The plugin** (in-process) | A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin that turns the errors a model hits into a numbered knowledge base, then pushes the recorded fix back into context *before* the model starts diagnosing | T01–T15 merged; installation waits for T17 |
| **The toolbox** (external) | A Windows application — `errkb.exe`, Go + PostgreSQL, CUE for its schemas — that watches logs, wrapped processes and windows, searches the knowledge base like a browser, and serves any MCP client, `dsh` or not | **Planned, not started** — [details](#external-toolbox-planned) |

Both forms share one set of rules (normalize, fingerprint, redact, match) and, once the toolbox ships, one knowledge base.

> **Status: P5 complete.** The design document is written and under review —
> six of the eight decisions in its §17 are still open (Q2 and Q4 are decided) —
> and the work is broken into [eighteen tasks](#roadmap) across seven milestones.
> **T01–T15 are done:** the package installs, builds, type checks, lints, formats
> and tests (with the 99% coverage gate enforced), CI runs all five on every
> push to `main` and every pull request, and the pure local layer is complete:
> knowledge-base directory resolution (T05), error normalization and fingerprinting (T06), mandatory
> redaction (T07), the `ERRORS.md` store (T08) and matching (T09). The capture
> layer is wired: classification and the noise rule (T10), and the first two
> hooks, `agent/error` and `tools/result` (T11). The injection layer speaks:
> notice text, caps and fix trust (T12) are wired to the four injection points
> (T13), and resolution detection (T14) closes the loop. The five agent tools
> (T15) let the model look errors up and write fixes down.
>
> **The plugin records and injects, once installed.** Loaded into a profile,
> `apply` logs where the knowledge base is, records tool failures, non-zero
> command exits and turn-level errors into `ERRORS.md`, and hands a recorded
> fix back to the model when the same error repeats, within the caps below.
> When a recorded error stops failing, its fix earns trust, and an entry with
> no fix gets one prompt asking the model to record it with `err_record` (T14,
> T15), which writes it into `ERRORS.md`. Still missing: LLM request-failure
> capture (T16), and installation into a profile (T17) — nothing installs it
> for you yet, so the tools only reach a model once you add the plugin to a
> profile yourself. Anything below tied to T16–T18 is still a description of
> the intended path.
>
> - Implementation plan: [`docs/implementation-plan.md`](docs/implementation-plan.md)
> - What the plugin will do: [How it works](#how-it-works)
> - Where your data will land: [Where the knowledge base lives](#where-the-knowledge-base-lives)
> - What is still open: [Open decisions](#open-decisions) — Q2 and Q4 of §17 are decided, six remain
>
> **A second delivery form is planned.** An external Windows toolbox (`errkb.exe`, Go + PostgreSQL, CUE for its
> schemas) will watch logs, wrapped processes and windows and serve any MCP client, so the knowledge base stops
> being `dsh`-only. None of it is written yet; the requirements, architecture decisions, 55 ordered task cards, and
> implementation order are consolidated in [`docs/implementation-plan.md`](docs/implementation-plan.md).

## Contents

| `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `tsdown.config.ts`, `vitest.config.ts`   | ✅ In place (T01–T03)      |
| `.prettierignore`, `.gitattributes` — format and line-ending policy       | ✅ In place                |
| `cordis.patch.yml` — bundle patch                                         | ✅ In place (T04)          |
| `src/index.ts` — plugin entry (`name`, `inject`, `Config`, `apply`)       | ✅ In place (T04); `apply` reads the settings, registers the `agent/error` and `tools/result` listeners (T11), the four injection points (T13) and the five tools (T15) |
| `src/plugin.ts` — the capture pipeline and the injection wiring           | ✅ In place (T11, T13–T15), 100% statements and lines — T15 adds `write()` and the notice counters `err_stats` reads |
| `src/paths.ts` — KB directory resolution                                  | ✅ In place (T05), 100% covered |
| `src/signature.ts` — normalization and fingerprinting                     | ✅ In place (T06), 100% covered — used by capture and matching |
| `src/redact.ts`, `src/redact-patterns.ts` — mandatory redaction           | ✅ In place (T07), 100% covered — applied by the store on every write |
| `src/store.ts` — parse, render, append, archive                           | ✅ In place (T08), 100% statements and lines — written by the T11 listeners and the T15 tools; `archive(id, reason)` added for `err_forget` |
| `seeds/ERRORS.seed.md` — three curated, redacted seed entries             | ✅ In place (T08) — not copied into any knowledge base yet |
| `src/match.ts` — exact, fuzzy and fallback matching                       | ✅ In place (T09), 100% statements and lines — consulted before every write |
| `src/state.ts` — `state.json`, `.machine.json`, environment fingerprint   | Hit counters and fix-trust counters in `state.json`: ✅ In place (§4.3, T12), 100% statements and lines. `.machine.json` and the environment fingerprint: ⛔ Not started |
| `src/capture.ts` — classification, headline extraction and the noise rule | ✅ In place (T10), 100% statements and lines — called by the T11 listeners |
| `src/inject.ts` — notice generation, hard caps and fix trust              | ✅ In place (T12), 100% statements and lines — wired to the four injection points (T13) |
| `src/resolve-detect.ts` — resolution detection                            | ✅ In place (T14), 100% statements and lines — fed by `tools/result`; `recordFix()` is called by `err_record` (T15) |
| `src/tools.ts` — the five agent tools                                     | ✅ In place (T15), 100% statements and lines — `err_lookup`, `err_record`, `err_list`, `err_forget`, `err_stats`, registered through `ctx.tools.register()` |
| `tests/`                                                                  | ⚠ 598 discovered locally: 596 pass and 2 Windows real-filesystem store tests fail; repair is `EKB-003` |
| Installed into the `web` profile                                          | ⛔ Not started             |
| Published release                                                         | ⛔ Not started — release workflow is `EKB-054` |
| External toolbox — implementation plan | ✅ Rebaselined as `EKB-001`–`EKB-055` across `P0`–`P7` |
| External toolbox — code (`cmd/`, `internal/`, `db/`, `spec/`) | ⛔ Not started — begin with `EKB-001`, see [External toolbox (planned)](#external-toolbox-planned) |

## Why

An agent has no memory of the last time it hit an error, so it re-derives the diagnosis from scratch: reasoning, a failed attempt, another failed attempt. That costs somewhere between 800 and 3000 tokens.

For a failure you see once, that is fine. For a failure you see every week — an `EPERM` from a locked `node_modules`, a `CONTEXT_OVERFLOW`, a misspelled provider name — it is pure waste. A human recognizes "this is the one from last time" instantly. The model does not, because the path changed, the line number changed, and the PID is different.

`dsh-errkb` closes that gap by keeping the knowledge on disk and injecting what it already knows.

## Features

> **Designed, mostly implemented, not installed.** Everything below is
> specified in the design document and covered by a test plan. Recording and
> injection run: stable IDs, one ID per error and mandatory redaction apply to
> what the T11 listeners write, a recorded fix is injected before diagnosis
> (T13), a resolved error is noticed and asked for its fix once (T14), and the
> five tools write the answer down and keep the ledger (T15). Nothing installs
> the plugin into a profile until T17 — see
> [What works today](#what-works-today).

| Behaviour                     | Detail                                                                          |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Stable IDs**                | Every distinct error gets one, `E-0001` onward, and keeps it forever            |
| **Same error, one ID**        | Changed paths, line numbers, PIDs and timestamps still count as the same error  |
| **Injected before diagnosis** | On a hit the recorded fix enters context — about 80 tokens                      |
| **Human-editable**            | `ERRORS.md` is plain Markdown; a fix you type by hand is used immediately       |
| **Mandatory redaction**       | Secrets, emails and absolute paths are scrubbed before anything is stored       |
| **Cross-device by git**       | Append-only blocks merge cleanly; counters stay local and never conflict        |
| **An auditable ledger**       | `err_stats` reports hits, injections and estimated tokens saved                 |
| **Compaction-friendly**       | Facts live on disk and are injected on demand, not held in conversation history |
| **Fully local**               | Matching, storage and lookup call no model and touch no network                 |
| **Bounded by construction**   | Every injection is capped, and the caps are part of the specification           |

## How it works

```
1. CAPTURE      agent/error · tools/result · non-zero exits
                (agent/request-error: not yet wired, T16)
                observe only — never throws, never takes over retries
                                     │
                                     ▼
2. FINGERPRINT  normalize: strip ANSI; ts / pid / port / line / uuid / tmp → placeholders;
                absolute paths → <path>, filename kept
                signature = sha256(category + "\0" + message)[0:12]
                                     │
                                     ▼
3. MATCH        exact signature → Jaccard fuzzy (≥ 0.72) → short-message
                same-code fallback → otherwise assign a new ID
                                     │
                       ┌─────────────┴─────────────┐
                    hit│                           │miss
                       ▼                           ▼
4. INJECT     ≤ 120 tokens/notice             5. RECORD   append block to ERRORS.md
   ≤ 1/step, 3/turn, 2/ID/session                         assign next ID (append-only)
                       ▲                           ▲
                       └─────────────┬─────────────┘
                                     │
6. RESOLVE      model or user writes the fix via `err_record` (the sole entry point)
                resolution detection → one-shot prompt → status becomes `fixed`
```

The hard part is step 3, not step 2. Normalizing a message is mechanical; deciding that two different-looking messages *are* the same error is where a knowledge base either helps or quietly poisons the context with the wrong fix. Matching runs in three tiers — exact signature, then fuzzy token similarity, then a same-code fallback for messages too short to compare — and a near miss is labelled as one in the injected text rather than passed off as certain.

**One rule holds the whole thing together:** `ERRORS.md` is the single source of truth. `errors.index.json` is a derived cache that can be deleted and rebuilt; `state.json` holds local counters that can be lost without consequence. None of the three ever writes another's facts.

### What earns an ID

Not every failure deserves a number. Transient ones are counted and only promoted when they keep happening, because a rate limit is not knowledge.

| Source                               | Hook                                 | Captured as                                                    | Gets an ID?                                                                        |
| ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| LLM API failure                      | `agent/request-error` (waterfall)    | `code` + normalized message                                    | Permanent codes: `AUTH`, `QUOTA`, `INVALID_REQUEST`, `CONTEXT_OVERFLOW`, `NO_ADAPTER`, `UNKNOWN` → immediately — **not yet wired (T16)** |
| Turn-level exception                 | `agent/error` (emit)                 | `error.message` / `code` / `name`                              | Immediately (safely stringified when `unknown`)                                     |
| Tool failure                         | `tools/result` (emit)                | `exec.name` + `result.error.message` + `result.error.info.code` | Immediately (`result.isError`)                                                      |
| Command exited non-zero              | `tools/result` content sniffing      | matches `\[exit code: (\d+)\]` with N ≠ 0                      | Immediately, unless `captureExitCodes` is off                                       |
| Transient LLM failure                | `agent/request-error`                | `RATE_LIMIT`, `SERVER`, `TIMEOUT`, `TRANSPORT`, `EMPTY_RESPONSE` | ❌ counted only — promoted after `transientThreshold` (default 5) in one session — **not yet wired (T16)** |

When it lands (T16), the listener on `agent/request-error` must `await next()` and return the downstream result unchanged. It observes; it never recovers.

**What is wired today (T11).** `src/plugin.ts` holds the listener bodies; `apply` registers two of them. `agent/error` hands its `error` to classification as a turn-level exception. `tools/result` records a failed result (`result.isError`) as a tool failure with `result.error.message` and `result.error.info?.code`; any other result has its text blocks sniffed for `[exit code: N]`, with the command taken from the call's `command`, `cmd` or `script` argument. Each classified error is matched against the entries already in `ERRORS.md`: a hit bumps that entry's hits and last-seen in this machine's `state.json` and leaves `ERRORS.md` untouched (§4.3), a miss appends the next ID. A `count-only` error (a transient one below the threshold, or one after its promotion) only bumps an entry that already has its signature, the same way, and writes nothing otherwise. Transient counts are kept per session, by `Agent.id`; a payload with no agent counts under one plugin-wide counter. `agent/request-error` is not registered yet (T16), so no LLM failure reaches the pipeline.

**Promotion happens once.** A transient error's count is kept per session and per signature, and it takes an ID on the occurrence that *reaches* `transientThreshold` — not on every occurrence after it. With a source left out of `capture`, nothing is produced for it at all, not even a count.

**One line decides the signature.** Multi-line output — `tsc` with forty errors, a `pnpm install` log, a Python traceback — is reduced to one headline before fingerprinting, so a forty-first error or a reordered log keeps the same ID. The behavior is preserved by `EKB-012` in the [implementation plan](docs/implementation-plan.md). `src/capture.ts` picks:

1. for a Python traceback (`Traceback (most recent call last):`), the last non-empty line — checked first, because a traceback quotes source lines such as `raise ValueError(...)`;
2. otherwise the first line matching `ERR_[A-Z0-9_]+|E[A-Z]{2,}|[A-Z]\w*Error|error TS\d+` (log-level words such as `ERR` and `ERROR` do not count);
3. otherwise the last non-empty line.

The headline is capped at 200 characters, the code it names (`ERR_PNPM_…`, `EPERM`, `TS2307`, `ModuleNotFoundError`) becomes the entry's `code` when the source gives none, and the full text is kept as the raw sample. For a command, the harness's own `[exit code: N]` marker is left out of the headline. When a command's headline names no code — a silent failure reads `exit code 1`, a test runner's last line reads `1 test failed` — the command that ran leads it (`pnpm test → exit code 1`, its first line, cut to 120 characters), so silent failures of two different commands never share an ID.

## Where the knowledge base lives

`kbDir` resolves in three tiers, in order:

| # | Condition                                                                             | Resolution                                                 |
| - | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1 | `kbDir` is set                                                                        | Relative → against the **plugin package root**; absolute → as-is. Device-local differences belong here |
| 2 | `kbDir` is empty, the plugin root is writable and **not inside `node_modules`**       | `<plugin root>/errors/`                                    |
| 3 | Otherwise — global npm install, read-only package directory, unwritable disk          | `$DSH_HOME/errkb/`                                         |

At startup the plugin logs the resolved path on one line, so the location is never a guess. `err_stats` prints it too.

**Real entries belong in a private repository** (§17 Q4). Redaction by text rules cannot be complete, so this public repository ignores `errors/` entirely and only carries curated, redacted seed entries in [`seeds/ERRORS.seed.md`](seeds/ERRORS.seed.md). To sync your knowledge base across devices, clone a private repository of your own on each machine and point `kbDir` at it — an absolute path, or a path relative to the plugin root. The `link:` development install would otherwise land in `errors/` inside this repository, where git now ignores it. Either way, **no absolute path is ever written into the document**.

Inside that directory:

| File                 | Role                                                                              | Treat it as                                        |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `ERRORS.md`          | **The single source of truth** — numbered entries, append-only                     | Hand-editable; commit it to your private KB repository |
| `ERRORS.archive.md`  | Entries archived past `maxEntries`, append-only                                    | Commit it to the same private repository           |
| `errors.index.json`  | Derived cache: signature → ID                                                      | Deletable, rebuilt from `ERRORS.md`; gitignore it  |
| `state.json`         | Machine-local state: each entry's hits and `lastSeen` on this machine, and fix-trust counters (the environment fingerprint is not built yet) | Deletable; **machine-local, never commit it**      |
| `.machine.json`      | Device slug (`deviceSlug`, e.g. `DESKTOP-A`) used for the entry's device field     | Deletable/regenerated; device-local, keep it out of git |
| `.lock`              | Transient write lock, removed when the write finishes                              | Ignore it                                          |

A sensible `.gitignore` for that private knowledge base repository:

```gitignore
state.json
errors.index.json
.machine.json
.lock
```

The design document names `state.json` and `errors.index.json` explicitly; `.machine.json` and `.lock` are device-local or transient for the same reason.

That split is the whole cross-device story: knowledge merges by appending to `ERRORS.md`, counters stay on the machine that produced them, and the two never fight. See [Roadmap](#roadmap) for what is not built.

## The ERRORS.md format

IDs start at `E-0001`, built from `idPrefix` (default `E-`) and `idWidth` (default `4`), and are **append-only — an ID is never changed once written**, not even to resolve a merge conflict.

One entry, in the default English labels, with machine fields carried in an HTML comment so the rendered document stays clean and hand-editing stays safe:

````md
## E-0007 · [tool:pwsh] EPERM: operation not permitted, rename
<!-- errkb: sig=3f2a1c9d0b71 cat=tool code=EPERM first=2026-09-14T09:12:33Z -->

- Fingerprint: `3f2a1c9d0b71`
- Category: `tool / pwsh`
- First seen: 2026-09-14 09:12 · Last seen: 2026-09-14 15:40 · Hits: 5
- Trigger: `pnpm install` writing `node_modules` under a non-ASCII path while another process holds it
- Raw message:
  ```text
  EPERM: operation not permitted, rename '<path>\node_modules\.pnpm\<hash>'
  ```
- Fix:
  Close the editor or real-time antivirus scan holding the directory, then re-run `pnpm install`; if it persists, use `pnpm install --config.node-linker=hoisted`.
- Status: `fixed`
- Notes:
````

**Labels:** English by default. Set `labels: 'zh'` to write the Chinese labels of the design document's §8 instead (`指纹`, `分类`, `首次`, `最近`, `命中`, `触发`, `原始信息`, `解法`, `状态`, `备注`). The parser reads both sets — and a full-width `：` — whatever the setting, so a document may mix them, and an updated entry keeps the language it was written in. Machine keys in the comment are always English.

**Hits and Last seen:** the values written in a block are the ones it was created with (`Hits: 1`, the time of capture) or whatever a person typed there since. A repeat never rewrites the block: it is counted in this machine's `state.json`, keyed by ID, so two devices that both hit the same error never touch the same lines and their git histories merge cleanly (§4.3). Every count the plugin shows — notices, the session digest, `err_lookup`, `err_list`, `err_stats` — is the block's hits plus this machine's, with the later of the two last-seen times, so the numbers may differ between devices while the knowledge agrees. Deleting `state.json` drops the counts back to what the blocks say. Editing a fix, status or notes (by hand or through `err_record`) still rewrites that one block.

**Parsing rules:** blocks split on `^## (E-\d+) ·`; the `<!-- errkb: ... -->` comment supplies the machine fields; `- Fix:` (or `- 解法:`) runs until the next line that opens a known field, so a fix may hold blank lines, bullets and code. **Your hand edits win over the index** — the index is only a cache, so a fix you type in any Markdown editor is used on the very next hit. Every block keeps its exact text: reading and writing a document back is byte-identical, and an update rewrites only the entry it changes.

**Strict where it matters:** a git conflict marker, a malformed entry header, a missing machine comment, a duplicate ID, an unknown status or an unterminated code fence makes the document unparseable. It is then saved aside once as `ERRORS.corrupt-<timestamp>.md`, new entries are only appended, and updates are refused until it is repaired.

**Entry status:** `open`, `fixed`, or `wontfix`. Setting `wontfix` (or flagging an entry as a misjudgment) takes it out of automatic injection permanently while it keeps counting, so one bad record cannot keep poisoning the context.

> **Prototype field language:** English labels by default, `labels: 'zh'` for Chinese, both always parsed. The platform replacement is governed by the versioned event and configuration contracts in `EKB-006` and `EKB-007`.

## Injection: when it speaks and how much

| Situation                                  | Injection point                                                       | What arrives                                                                 |
| ------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| A tool or command failed in this step      | `tools/post-execute` → `additionalContexts`                           | Hit: the known fix. Miss under `inject: 'always'`: `recorded as E-0011 (no fix yet).`, on the next step (see below) |
| The turn died (an LLM or turn failure reported as `agent/error`) | The next `agent/pre-step` → `{kind: 'enter', messages}` | The notice for the entry that matches the failed step, appended after the step's own messages |
| Session opens                              | `agent/session-start` → `agent.inject()`                              | Whatever `sessionDigest` says: `off`, `counts` (one line), or `index` (up to 10 entry titles) |
| Always                                     | `ctx.systemPrompt.section({name: 'plugin:errkb', order: 10400})`      | ~50 tokens of standing behaviour: try a known fix before re-diagnosing, state new fixes |

On a hit the model does not receive a report — it receives an instruction, capped at 120 tokens:

```
[errkb] E-0007 known (5 hits) | cause: node_modules locked by an editor during
pnpm install | fix: close the locking process and re-run; if it persists, use
pnpm install --config.node-linker=hoisted. Known fix: try this first, before
re-diagnosing or researching.
```

(Wrapped here for reading; the real notice is one line.) The closing sentence orders the work instead of forbidding any, so it does not contradict a research nudge from another plugin on the same step. The other wordings, exactly as `src/inject.ts` (T12) writes them:

| Case                                   | Notice                                                                                     |
| -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Near hit (fuzzy or code fallback)      | `… \| fix: … Approximate match, verify first.`                                            |
| The fix recurred after a notice        | `… \| fix: … This fix failed here last time; verify before applying.`                     |
| Hit on an entry with no fix            | `[errkb] E-0007 seen before (5 hits), no fix recorded yet.` — short, about 15 tokens        |
| Miss, with `inject: 'always'`          | `[errkb] recorded as E-0011 (no fix yet).` — silent under the default `hit-only`           |
| An entry with no fix looks resolved    | `[errkb] E-0011 looks resolved. Record the fix with err_record in one sentence so it can be reused.` — once per entry per session, on the next step (T14) |
| `wontfix` or misjudged entry           | Nothing, ever                                                                              |

**Hard caps, and the caps are the point.** One notice per step, three per turn, two per ID per session; each notice ≤ 120 tokens by a conservative estimate (every non-ASCII character one token, ASCII three characters a token) and ≤ 400 characters. A long cause gives way first, then the fix; the closing instruction is never cut. The plugin-source `summary` goes through dsh-llm's own `boundContextSummary`, so it is ≤ 120 characters, for the `{kind: 'plugin', plugin: 'err-kb', form: 'notice', summary}` message shape (`MessageSourceMap['plugin']` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`). An entry whose status is `fixed` announces itself once and then goes quiet. An uncapped version of this plugin would be worse than no plugin: a hit rate bought with constant noise turns a saving into a cost.

**A fix that does not work stops being pushed.** When the same entry is captured again later in the turn that injected its fix, that counts as a recurrence: after one, the notice changes to "This fix failed here last time; verify before applying

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-jev-loop

Jev ([TypeSafe](https://typesafe.ai) System One) judgments at the DeepSeek
Harness agent-loop gates. No UI dependency: mount it in any Harness
composition, headless or otherwise.

This is the core of the Jev loop for moqi. The optional `/JevLoop` control panel
ships separately as
[`moqi-jev-loop`](https://github.com/JWE24-code/moqi-jev-loop), and depends only
on the `jevLoop` service this package provides.

> **Data flow: your tool calls leave the machine.** Every enabled gate sends a
> slice of the session to the third-party TypeSafe API (`api.typesafe.ai`, or
> whatever `baseUrl` you set) for judgment. That includes **each gated tool
> call's name and arguments** (pre-execute), **each successful tool call's
> output** (post-execute) — both alongside your latest prompt — and the
> **recent transcript** — your prompts, the
> model's replies, and tool results — for the pre-step and turn-stopping
> gates, capped at `maxStateChars` characters per request. File contents a tool
> read, command output, and anything secret that appears in them go along.
> Disable a gate (`*Enabled: false`), or list sensitive tools in
> `preExecuteSkip`, to keep that data local.

Published to npm as
[`dsh-jev-loop`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-jev-loop). This repository
carries the [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic — the
whole of the [dshfind](https://dshfind.com) listing mechanism: the marketplace
indexes public repositories by that topic and syncs daily, so there is no
listing step per release.

## Compatibility

Supported Harness lines: **0.1.5-rc.x** and **0.2.0 / 0.2.1** (CI typechecks
against `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.3`, `0.2.0-rc.2`, and `0.2.1-rc.2`). The
`peerDependencies` ranges say exactly that; a newer line is untested until it
is added to the CI matrix.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-jev-loop
```

Then give it a key: set `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` (or `TYPESAFE_APIKEY`) in the
environment, or store one in the Harness credential store under
`TYPESAFE_API_KEY`. The gates fail open — no key, timeout, 429, or bad JSON
never blocks the loop.

## The gates

| Gate | Event | What Jev judges | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pre-step | `agent/pre-step` | is the request underspecified? | inject an "ask before guessing" instruction |
| Pre-execute | `tools/pre-execute` | destructive · exfiltration · off-task | `log` / `ask` / `deny` |
| Post-execute | `tools/post-execute` | did a successful call silently miss? | `log` / `block` with corrective feedback |
| Turn-stopping | `agent/turn-stopping` | "is the request actually done?" | `nudge` the turn onward, or pass |

All four are automatic. Jev supplies a calibrated probability; this package owns
the thresholds and decisions, and every failure — no key, timeout, 429, bad
JSON — **fails open**, so a judgment service that is down never blocks the loop.

Configure them on the `dsh-jev-loop` row in a profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (see
this package's [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml)), or in a profile's own
patch layer. The `*Enabled` defaults can also be overridden at runtime from
moqi's `/JevLoop` panel, which persists to `$DSH_HOME/jev-loop.json`.

## Cost envelope

- One `POST /v1/systemone` per judgment; pre-execute asks its three hazards in a
  single call.
- State is capped (`maxStateChars`); the transcript gates only send the last
  `turnStoppingMaxMessages` messages.
- Answers are cached by a SHA-256 of the exact request body, so an unchanged
  judgment is free.
- Every judgment is appended to `$DSH_HOME/jev-loop.jsonl` with probabilities,
  cache hit/miss, latency, and token usage. Past `auditMaxBytes` (default
  5 MiB) the file is rotated to `jev-loop.jsonl.1`, replacing the previous
  rotation, so the trail stays bounded at roughly twice the cap.

## Config

Set on the `dsh-jev-loop` row in a bundle patch, or in a profile's own patch
layer.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | — | literal key; prefer `apiKeyEnv` so no secret is in a config file |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | env var read for the key; `TYPESAFE_APIKEY` is also read |
| `model` | `jev-latest` | TypeSafe model alias |
| `baseUrl` | `https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone` | evaluation endpoint |
| `timeoutMs` | `3000` | per-request timeout |
| `maxRetries` | `2` | retries on 429/529, network errors, timeouts |
| `maxStateChars` | `24000` | hard cap on state sent to Jev |
| `cacheEntries` | `500` | in-memory cache entries |
| `auditPath` | `$DSH_HOME/jev-loop.jsonl` | JSONL audit trail |
| `auditMaxBytes` | `5242880` (5 MiB) | rotate the trail to `<auditPath>.1` past this size; `0` never rotates |
| `statePath` | `$DSH_HOME/jev-loop.json` | persisted gate toggles |
| `preStepEnabled` | `false` | judge the request before the first step |
| `preStepThreshold` | `0.7` | clarification probability that injects a question |
| `preExecuteEnabled` | `true` | judge tool calls before dispatch |
| `preExecuteMode` | `log` | `log` observes, `ask` requests approval, `deny` refuses |
| `preExecuteThreshold` | `0.7` | hazard probability that flags a call |
| `preExecuteSkip` | `[]` | tool names to ignore |
| `postExecuteEnabled` | `true` | check a successful tool result |
| `postExecuteMode` | `log` | `log` observes, `block` turns feedback into an error |
| `postExecuteThreshold` | `0.7` | miss probability that blocks a result |
| `turnStoppingEnabled` | `true` | check the turn before it closes |
| `turnStoppingThreshold` | `0.5` | completion probability below which to nudge |
| `turnStoppingMaxSteers` | `2` | nudges per turn, so a wrong judgment cannot loop |
| `turnStoppingMaxMessages` | `14` | transcript messages fed to the completion judgment |

## Test it

```bash
npm install            # typescript + @types/node
npm run link-harness   # symlink the installed harness's @deepseek-ai packages
npm run build
npm test               # gates, keyring, loop, audit, render — no Harness, no network
npm run install-profile -- jev-core   # throwaway profile with just this bundle
TYPESAFE_APIKEY=… dsh --profile jev-core
```

`~/.dsh/jev-loop.jsonl` records every judgment.

To exercise the Harness-only build inside your own profile, list just the core
bundle:

```yaml
bundles: ['@deepseek-ai/dsh-base', 'dsh-jev-loop']
```

## Layout

```
src/gates.ts   the four judgments and their copy, as pure functions
src/keyring.ts key resolution order, storing, probing, clearing
src/loop.ts    JevLoop: state assembly, per-turn budgets, audit, one method per gate
src/jev.ts     the TypeSafe client: a Judger port and its live adapter
src/render.ts  derived session messages -> plain text (0.1.x and 0.2.x shapes)
src/audit.ts   the size-capped JSONL audit trail
src/index.ts   the Cordis adapter: config, event wiring, effects
tests/         the modules above, driven directly
scripts/       harness linking and the throwaway profile installer
```

## Docs

The module boundaries, the seams, and the generated whiteboard are documented in
[docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

[![SonarQube Cloud](https://sonarcloud.io/images/project_badges/sonarcloud-highlight.svg)](https://sonarcloud.io/summary/new_code?id=JWE24-code_dsh-jev-loop)
