# dsh-pii-anonymizer

[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/JWE24-code/dsh-pii-anonymizer)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/JWE24-code/dsh-pii-anonymizer)
[![CI](https://github.com/JWE24-code/dsh-pii-anonymizer/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/JWE24-code/dsh-pii-anonymizer/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-pii-anonymizer.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-pii-anonymizer)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

A native [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin
that replaces **detected PII with stable placeholders in what the model is sent**:
your prompt, the system prompt, runtime context, workspace instructions, recalled
sessions, relayed agent messages, and tool results.

Detection uses fixed rules and checksums (never a model). Every detected value is
replaced with a keyed placeholder such as `[[EMAIL_3f9a2c1d]]` before the request
goes to the provider. The real values do stay on this computer: the host app
commits your message to the local session log exactly as you typed it, and files
and tool outputs on disk are not changed.

```
you type:    email a@x.com or call +31 6 1234 5678
model sees:  email [[EMAIL_6c1f0a9e]] or call [[PHONE_d24b7c03]]
             + a notice: "🔒 PII shield: 2 item(s) in this step's input were
               replaced with placeholders before being sent to the model
               provider (1 EMAIL, 1 PHONE)."
local log:   the message as typed — raw values remain in the local session
             log and transcript.
```

The notice is a **user-role message**: it is shown in your transcript *and* the
model receives it (that is how the harness delivers plugin notices). It carries
only types and counts — never values or placeholders. Turn it off with
`notify: false`.

Anonymization is **one-way**: the plugin keeps no value → placeholder table and
has no restore path, so nothing it holds can put the real values back.

## Where it hooks

Each listener is registered with `prepend: true`, so it is the outermost
listener of its waterfall and rewrites the final value after every other plugin
has contributed.

| Hook (package) | What is rewritten |
| --- | --- |
| `system-prompt/assemble` (`dsh-system-prompt`) | prompt **section** text (e.g. a terminal app's workspace section), runtime-**context** text, and string prompt **variables**. The agent loop renders the assembled contexts into its `form: "snapshot"` user message, so snapshots (e.g. a memory index) are covered here, and the loop's "has the snapshot changed?" check stays stable. |
| `agent/pre-step` (`dsh-agent-loop`) | the text blocks of **every** message entering the step, whatever its source: the user prompt, runtime-context snapshots, workspace instructions (`AGENTS.md`), recalled sessions (`recall`), relayed agent messages (`relay`), skill catalogs, and contexts attached by tool results. |
| `tools/post-execute` (`dsh-tools`) | the tool **result content** the model reads (file reads, grep, shell output, memory reads…), a block decision's feedback, and attached contexts. |

### Why a native plugin, not a hook

The Claude Code / Codex hook bridges **cannot** do this. `HookOutput` in
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-hook-protocol` exposes only `additionalContext`; its
`updatedInput` is documented as *"PARSED but NOT honored."* There is no
prompt-rewrite channel. Only a native Cordis plugin can replace the messages,
prompt, and tool results that enter the model request.

## Detection scope

Deterministic means *structural*. The detectors find things with a grammar or a
checksum:

| Type | Trigger | Validation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `API_KEY` | known prefixes (`sk-`, `sk-ant-`, `AKIA…`, `ghp_…`, `github_pat_…`, `xox…`, `AIza…`) | — |
| `IBAN` | `CC00…`, compact or space-grouped | **mod-97 checksum** |
| `CREDIT_CARD` | 13–19 digits, spaces/dashes allowed | **Luhn checksum** |
| `SSN` | `DDD-DD-DDDD` | none |
| `EMAIL` | RFC-ish address shape | none |
| `IPV6` / `IPV4` | address shapes | octet range for IPv4 |
| `PHONE` | digit run with `+ ( ) . - space`, optional leading `(`, 7–15 digits | rejects ISO dates and version strings |

Free-form **names, postal addresses, and other context-dependent PII are not
detected** — a deterministic rule cannot catch them without unacceptable false
positives. Adding an ML/NER stage would break the "deterministic" property.

Overlaps are resolved by priority (checksum types beat the loose phone rule),
then span length, then position.

## Pseudonymization model

A placeholder is `[[TYPE_<hash>]]`, where `<hash>` is the first 8 hex digits of
HMAC-SHA256(key, type + normalized value). Normalization folds trivial spelling
differences (email case, IBAN/card/phone spacing and separators) into one value.

- **Stable everywhere.** The same value gets the same placeholder in every
  session, in subagents, and after a restart, so a placeholder saved into a
  memory or a note keeps meaning the same thing. Different values get different
  placeholders (barring a 32-bit truncation collision).
- **Keyed.** The key is a per-install secret: 32 random bytes in
  `$DSH_HOME/pii-anonymizer.key` (default `~/.dsh/pii-anonymizer.key`), created
  on first use with mode `0600` (an existing file with looser permissions is
  tightened). Without the key, a placeholder cannot be matched against guessed
  values, which matters for low-entropy values such as phone numbers. Keep the
  file private; deleting it changes every placeholder from then on. If the file
  cannot be read or created, the plugin logs a warning and uses a process-only
  key: values are still replaced, but placeholders are not stable across
  restarts.
- **No raw PII on disk.** The key file holds only the random key. The plugin
  keeps no value table and writes no values anywhere.
- **Idempotent.** Existing placeholders are never re-detected, so text that has
  already been rewritten passes through unchanged.

## What is and is not covered

Covered (model-facing text):

- your prompt and every other message entering a step — snapshots, workspace
  instructions, recall, relay, catalogs, tool-result contexts;
- system-prompt sections, runtime-context sections, and string prompt variables;
- tool result content, including errors returned by a tool body.

Not covered:

- **Local storage.** The session log, transcript, memory files, and any file on
  disk keep the raw values; this shield changes only what is sent to the
  provider. The raw values are protected by the file permissions of `$DSH_HOME`
  and nothing else.
- **Undetectable PII.** Free-form names, postal addresses, and other
  context-dependent PII are not detected (see *Detection scope*).
- **A `complete: true` system-prompt section.** `dsh-system-prompt` restores an
  effective complete section from its pre-waterfall text *after* the
  `system-prompt/assemble` waterfall, so a plugin cannot rewrite it.
- **Tool schemas** (tool names, descriptions, parameter schemas) are sent as is.
- **Tool results that skip `tools/post-execute`.** The registry finalizes a
  few outcomes without post-execute — cancellations and pipeline failures (for
  example a throwing `tools/pre-execute` or `tools/execute` listener) — and a
  tool's own `finalizeContent` callback runs after post-execute. Their text
  reaches the model unrewritten. Denials, approval rejections, tool errors and
  successes all pass through post-execute and are covered. A downstream
  post-execute listener that replaces the result's `value` is left alone (the
  registry forbids replacing both value and content).
- **Model output.** The assistant's replies are not rewritten; placeholders are
  not restored in them.
- **Requests made outside the agent loop** by other plugins (for example a
  session-title generator) only see what the loop already rewrote — the title
  request built from your messages receives the placeholders, but a plugin that
  reads raw files itself and calls a model directly is outside this shield.

Rewriting injected context can occasionally hide a value the agent genuinely
needs (for example an IP address in a workspace instruction). Disable the
system-prompt or tool-result rewrite with `systemPrompt: false` or
`toolResults: false` if that matters more to you than the coverage.

## Configuration

```yaml
- id: pii-anonymizer
  name: dsh-pii-anonymizer
  config:
    enabled: true        # master switch
    notify: true         # add the notice message when a step's input had PII
    debug: false         # log load/shield events (counts only, never values)
    systemPrompt: true   # rewrite system prompt + runtime context
    toolResults: true    # rewrite tool result content
    keyFile: ''          # empty = $DSH_HOME/pii-anonymizer.key
```

## Installation (as a bundle)

This package is a DSH **bundle**: `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, and
`cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `pii-anonymizer` row. A profile lists it in both
`dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles` — which is what the moqi-tui `/plugins`
picker reads (it reads the manifest, not the Cordis loader).

Install it from the registry into a profile:

```sh
npm install dsh-pii-anonymizer          # inside ~/.dsh/profiles/<name>
# or, from the terminal app:
/plugins add dsh-pii-anonymizer
```

`tools/register-profile.mjs <profileDir>` makes the manifest edit for a local
checkout, and writes a `package.json.bak` beside it:

```sh
node tools/register-profile.mjs ~/.dsh/profiles/tui
```

The package must also be resolvable from the profile, for example by
symlinking the checkout into the shared resolution root:

```sh
ln -s "$PWD" ~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/dsh-pii-anonymizer
```

Restart the app to load it. Rollback per profile: restore its `package.json.bak`.

## Development

```sh
npm test             # node --test: detectors, keyed pseudonymizer, key file, and
                     # the pre-step / assemble / post-execute rewrites
```

The unit tests import only `src/detectors.mjs`, `src/anonymizer.mjs` and
`src/hooks.mjs`, which have no harness dependencies, so CI needs no install.
`src/index.mjs` imports the harness peers; for local module-load smoke tests,
symlink `node_modules/@deepseek-ai` to the `@deepseek-ai` directory of your
harness install. An installed plugin resolves them from the profile instead.

### End-to-end test (no credentials, no network)

`tools/mock-provider.mjs` is a tiny OpenAI-compatible SSE server; `tools/e2e.patch.yml`
routes the deepseek adapter at it and loads this plugin. A real harness loop then
runs against the mock, and `tools/requests.jsonl` records exactly what the
provider received. With `MOCK_READ_FILE` set, the mock first asks the agent to
`read` that file, so the tool-result path is exercised too.

```sh
# 1. throwaway harness home (never ~/.dsh), with this checkout resolvable
export DSH_HOME=$(mktemp -d)
dsh --profile pitest --from-default-profile headless --dump-config >/dev/null
ln -s "$PWD" "$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules/dsh-pii-anonymizer"

# 2. a scratch workspace with PII in an instruction file and a data file
WORK=$(mktemp -d) && git -C "$WORK" init -q
echo 'Owner: owner@corp.example'                 > "$WORK/AGENTS.md"
echo 'customer: c@corp.example +31 6 9876 5432'  > "$WORK/notes.txt"

# 3. mock provider
MOCK_READ_FILE="$WORK/notes.txt" node tools/mock-provider.mjs &

# 4. one real turn
(cd "$WORK" && DSH_E2E_KEY=dummy dsh --profile pitest \
  --patch "$OLDPWD/tools/e2e.patch.yml" "My email is jane.doe@corp.example; read notes.txt")

# 5. confirm the provider only ever saw placeholders
grep -c 'corp.example' tools/requests.jsonl      # expect 0
grep -o '\[\[[A-Z_]*_[0-9a-f]*\]\]' tools/requests.jsonl | sort | uniq -c
```

Verified: across the agent requests and the session-title request, the
provider received placeholders for the prompt email, the `AGENTS.md` email
(workspace instructions), and the email and phone in the `read` tool result;
no `corp.example` value appeared. A second run with the same `DSH_HOME`
produced the identical placeholders, and the runtime-context snapshot was sent
once, not re-sent every step. The raw values do remain in the local session
log, as documented above.

## Status

- [x] Deterministic detectors with checksum validation
- [x] Keyed, cross-session stable placeholders (one-way, no reverse map)
- [x] User prompt and all injected messages (snapshot, instructions, recall,
      relay, catalogs, tool contexts) via `agent/pre-step`
- [x] System prompt, runtime context and variables via `system-prompt/assemble`
- [x] Tool result content via `tools/post-execute`
- [x] Run through a real headless harness against a mock provider

decision.reason: Held for versioned DSH compatibility. Exact npm source identity and MIT match native anonymizer/detector hooks. Wildcard DSH peers do not establish a versioned compatibility baseline. Local HMAC secret/data writes and heuristic detection cannot guarantee privacy. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# dsh-tidewatch

> DeepSeek Harness 的峰谷时刻挂件。一枚停在界面右下角的潮汐立绘，随时告诉你此刻是峰期还是谷期、距下一次切换还有多久、本次会话花了多少钱。

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/KhalilYamber/dsh-tidewatch)](https://github.com/KhalilYamber/dsh-tidewatch/releases)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/KhalilYamber/dsh-tidewatch)](LICENSE)

## 这是什么

DeepSeek 自 2026-08-17 起对 API 实行峰谷分时定价：峰期价目是谷期的两倍，周末与中国法定节假日全天按谷价。这意味着同样一次调用，落在不同钟点，账单可能差一倍。

`dsh-tidewatch` 把这件事摊开在你眼前：现在是什么档位、距离切换还有多久、这一场对话已经花了多少钱。金额按**每次调用实际发生的时刻**计价，回看历史会话也不会被当前价目重算。

它卖的是「口径可核对」：峰谷窗口、周末、法定节假日、调休、三段历史价格全部写在代码里，并配一条全年逐小时的口径比对脚本作为复核手段。

## 特性

| 分类 | 能力 |
|---|---|
| **峰谷** | 官方峰谷窗口判定；秒级倒计时到下一阶段；周末与法定节假日全天谷期；调休上班的周末同样全天谷期 |
| **计费** | 三段历史价格时代（基础价 / 首版峰谷价 / V4.1 Flash 新价）按调用时刻选档；缓存命中与未命中分开计价；输出含推理 token |
| **余额** | 读取 DeepSeek 账户余额（充值 / 礼金 / 合计）与读数时刻 |
| **挂件** | 右下角常驻立绘，可拖拽，松手吸附到较近的一侧，位置持久化；峰期与谷期换不同立绘 |
| **气泡** | 点立绘弹出漫画式对话气泡（大圆角 + 指向头顶的尖角）；**点气泡翻页**。收起只有两条路：约 5 秒后自己淡出，或点插件之外的任何地方 |
| **交互** | 点立绘出气泡、点气泡翻页；完整面板从气泡的「详情 ›」进入；面板右上角 `✕` 或点外部收起 |
| **编辑器** | 面板内置气泡编辑器：增删页与行、改模板文案、**拖拽排序**（也可点 ↑↓）、**模块库**（☆ 收藏常用行，一键插入）、一键恢复默认 |
| **泡泡玩法** | 一行内用 `A \|\| B` 并列随机、写成 `img:https://…` 渲染成图片（在线图与 data URI 均可） |
| **观感** | 跟随 GUI 亮暗主题（`--dsw-*` 变量）；复用 DSH 官方 UI 原语；合成提示音（无音频素材） |
| **不适用时** | 换成非 DeepSeek 模型时显示「不适用」，不拿 Flash 价硬凑数字 |

## 安装

### 前置条件

- Node.js ≥ 20
- 带 `dsh plugin` 命令的 DeepSeek Harness
- **桌面端**用户请把下文的 `--profile web` 换成 `--profile desktop`（桌面端读取的是 `desktop` profile）

### 从 GitHub 安装（推荐）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:KhalilYamber/dsh-tidewatch
```

### 从 Release 安装（可固定版本、可离线）

到 [Releases](https://github.com/KhalilYamber/dsh-tidewatch/releases) 下载最新的 `dsh-tidewatch-<版本>.tgz`，然后：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-tidewatch-1.14.4.tgz
```

### 本地链接安装（改源码即时生效）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-tidewatch
```

安装后**重启 DSH**（桌面端需完整退出再打开，热重载刷新不到客户端 bundle），右下角会出现潮汐挂件。

### 升级与卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-tidewatch    # 或重新执行 add
dsh plugin --profile web list dsh-tidewatch      # 查看已安装版本
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-tidewatch    # 卸载
```

> **npm 渠道已暂停**：npm 上只有一个 2026-08-22 发布的旧版本，价格与规则均已过时，请勿安装，也不要据它判断当前计价。
>
> **本仓库只保留当前版本的 tgz**，历史版本在 GitHub Releases 里可以取到。

## 使用

- **点立绘** → 弹出气泡（再点不会收起，只会重置计时）；**点气泡** → 翻到下一页；约 5 秒后自己淡出，**点插件外任意位置**也会收起
- **气泡里的「详情 ›」** → 完整面板
- **点气泡里的「详情 ›」** → 展开完整面板：官方峰谷时段表（北京时间）、当前档位价格、Token 明细、账户余额、币种切换、气泡内容开关、音效开关
- **拖动挂件** → 移到任意位置；松手靠近左右边缘会自动吸附，位置记在 `localStorage`
- **点「本次会话费用」行** → 展开分模型花费明细（各模型 token 与花费，合计等于各项之和）
- **收起面板** → 点面板右上角 `✕`、点挂件本身、或点面板外部

币种选择即时生效并记住；人民币 2 位小数，美元 4 位小数。

## 计费口径

### 峰谷时段（官方依据）

DeepSeek 官方自 2026-08-17 起实施峰谷分时定价：

| 时段（UTC） | 北京时间 | 档位 |
|---|---|---|
| 01:00 – 04:00 | 09:00 – 12:00 | 峰 |
| 04:00 – 06:00 | 12:00 – 14:00 | 谷 |
| 06:00 – 10:00 | 14:00 – 18:00 | 峰 |
| 10:00 – 次日 01:00 | 18:00 – 次日 09:00 | 谷 |

谷期价格为峰期的一半。本插件按 UTC 窗口判定当前档位（官方英文页即按 UTC 小时书写），周几与法定节假日按北京自然日判定（官方中文页把周期锚在「北京时间周一至周五」上）。两种读法在当前窗口取值下等价：窗口均落在同一北京自然日内，且不成对跨越 UTC 日界。时段表展示一律按北京时间。

### 三段价格时代

价格按**调用发生时刻**选档，历史会话回看不会被当前价目重算。档位顺序为 缓存命中 / 输入未命中 / 输出（美元 / 1M tokens）：

| 时代 | 时间范围（UTC） | deepseek-flash 档位 |
|---|---|---|
| 基础价 | 2026-08-16 16:00 之前 | 0.0028 / 0.14 / 0.28 |
| 首版峰谷价 | 2026-08-16 16:00 ~ 2026-09-10 04:00 | 峰 0.014 / 0.44 / 1.32，谷为峰的一半 |
| V4.1 Flash 新价 | 2026-09-10 04:00 起 | 峰 0.006 / 0.3 / 1.2，谷为峰的一半 |

成本 = 输入未命中 × cacheMiss + 输出 × output + (缓存读 + 缓存写) × cacheHit；「输出」已含推理 token。账本以美元存储。

人民币数字另存一份官方**中文**定价页的原样数字用于展示，不做汇率换算：官网两个模型的隐含汇率并不相同（flash 约 6.67、pro 约 6.82），统一换算会让 pro 的元数字比官网低约 2%。

### 周末与法定节假日

- **周六 / 周日**全天按谷期计价（官方公告：「周六、周日全天不再区分峰谷时段，统一按低谷时段价格收取调用费用」）
- **中国法定节假日**全天按谷期计价，无峰谷切换，也没有生效时间（官方定价页脚注：「高峰时段为北京时间周一至周五（不含中国法定节假日）……包括周末及中国法定节假日全天均为空闲时段」）
- **调休上班的周末**同样全天谷期（官方说明：「调休上班的周末、中国法定节假日全天均按空闲时段计费」）
- 下一阶段的切换点 = 下一个工作日首次进入峰时

节假日表依据《国务院办公厅关于 2026 年部分节假日安排的通知》（国办发明电〔2025〕7 号，共 33 天）：元旦 1/1–1/3、春节 2/15–2/23、清明 4/4–4/6、劳动节 5/1–5/5、端午 6/19–6/21、中秋 9/25–9/27、国庆 10/1–10/7。

## 兼容性

| 项目 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| DSH | 0.1.7-rc.2 及以上；已适配 0.2.0 |
| 模型 | 峰谷档位与金额只对 **DeepSeek 自家模型**成立。换用其他提供商时金额显示「不适用」 |
| 官方 UI 原语 | 优先使用 shell 模块表中的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`；模块表没有该包时自动降级到内置实现 |
| 主题 | 跟随 GUI 亮暗主题 |
| 数据边界 | 余额查询由 DSH 宿主执行；本插件不接触 API Key、不直接发 HTTP 请求、不落盘 |

模型名映射：现役 `deepseek-flash`（V4.1 Flash），别名 `deepseek-v4-flash`、`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`、`deepseek-v4.1-flash` 均按现役 Flash 价计费。

## 工作原理

```
模型调用的 usage 块（assistant/message 事件，现行版本唯一带 usage 的事件）
        │  lib/index.js：costUsage 会话投影（zod schema 校验）
        ▼
  token 桶 + 美元成本（按事件发生时刻的峰谷档位）
        │  useProjection('costUsage')（浏览器端）
        ▼
  lib/client.js：挂件渲染（立绘 + 角标 + 秒级倒计时）
```

挂件注册在 DSH 的根级浮层插槽 `shell.overlay`；数据由注册在 `conversation.composer.dock` 的探针经模块级 bridge 提供（根级插槽没有投影席位）。

### 文件结构

```
dsh-tidewatch
├── lib/
│   ├── pricing.js        # 纯函数：峰谷窗口、三段价格时代、节假日表、costOf
│   ├── index.js          # 宿主：costUsage 会话投影
│   ├── client.js         # 前端：挂件与面板（__ModuleLoader__ bundle）
│   └── assets/mascot/    # 挂件立绘原图（压缩后内嵌进 bundle）
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 装配行
├── docs/PORTING.md       # 移植到其他宿主的适配说明
└── test/
    ├── verify.mjs        # 全套自检入口
    ├── client-fixture.mjs# 前端夹具：真实加载 lib/client.js 的假 React 环境
    ├── adapt-repro.mjs   # 宿主计费口径回归
    └── ownership-repro.mjs # 前端归属判据回归
```

## 开发与验证

```sh
# 构建（语法检查 + zod 依赖 junction）
DSH_CHECKOUT=<harness 源码根目录> bash scripts/build.sh

# 全套自检（97 项）：峰谷数学、双份常量一致性、计费口径回归、用量双路读取、挂件钳位、随机并列、归属判据回归
node test/verify.mjs

# 布局冒烟测试：用真实样式表在无头 Chrome 里渲染挂件/泡泡/面板并断言布局
# （无 Chrome 时自动跳过；这段覆盖纯逻辑测不到的层叠与定位问题）
node test/ui-smoke.mjs
```

`DSH_CHECKOUT` 在 Git Bash 下需用 **Windows 形式**路径（如 `D:/DeepSeek-Harness/DSHAR工作目录/deepseek-harness-src`）：传 `/d/...` 会被 Node 解析成 `D:\d\...`，生成悬空 junction；插件为 link 安装时，坏链接会让下次启动装配失败。脚本在替换链接之前校验解析结果，坏路径当场报错。

## 已知限制

- **价格表内置**，官方调价后需手动同步 `lib/pricing.js`（计费）与 `lib/client.js` 的 `DISPLAY_PRICES`（展示）两处常量，并为旧价补一段历史档
- **节假日表内置 2026 年**，2027 年安排公布后需手动同步 `CN_PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS`（同样两处）
- **V4 Pro 换价分界**目前是哨兵值：官方声明计费方式保持不变，如有变动需把日期填回 `V4_PRO_RETIRE_BOUNDARY`
- **失败或被重试的调用不计费**，与官方 token-meter 口径一致；这是口径上限，不是遗漏
- **用量缺失时如实标注**：某些通道（例如账号内置通道）可能不在结算事件里返回 usage，此时界面显示「未提供」而不是 `¥0.00`，避免把「没有数据」呈现成「免费」。用量的读取口径与 DSH 官方 `token-meter` 一致：同时读 `assistant/message` 与 `assistant/attempt`，按 `(turn, step)` 替换，重试清槽
- **不提供余额预警**：早期版本有一个「余额低于阈值响一声」的功能，阈值写死且不可配置，属于半成品；DeepSeek 控制台本身可能已有余额提醒，故移除，不做重复建设

## 致谢

这个插件站在其他人的肩上：

- **[dsh-cost-meter](https://github.com/Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter)**（MIT）—— 峰谷数学（`isPeakHour` / `peakPhaseAt` / `tierFor` / `costOf`）与会话投影结构的出发点，本仓库按其精简目标重写。
- **[DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget](https://github.com/MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget)**（MIT）—— 挂件的产品形态参考：右下角常驻、点击弹泡泡、提示音、余额预警这几项交互，是照着它做的。它的代码与本插件互相独立，未直接引入。
- **「大肥鱼」形象** —— DeepSeek 蓝鲸吉祥物的社区拟人化二创，最早自百度 deepseek 吧的社区共创扩散开来；原始 OC「溟月」由社区创作者「上善无形」确立，本项目所用立绘来自小红书作者，原图存于 `lib/assets/mascot/`。形象版权归各自创作者所有，**收到权利人要求将立即替换或移除**。
- **[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)** —— 插件运行其上的宿主；状态点、标签、悬浮提示、外点关闭等控件复用其官方 UI 原语。

## 版本说明

历次变更见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)，当前版本 **1.14.4**。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 KhalilYamber

# 个人知识库（Personal Knowledge Base）

> **产品愿景**
>
> 一个个人的知识库，它可以记录你的性格、做事方式和你所有的资料，并帮你有序的归档整理，并带有一个专门用于管理与对话的Agent。你可以随时向他提问，查资料等等，它会根据你的习惯与你规定的方式进行回答。你能够掌握全局资料给你更全面更好的答复与建议。

---

## 一、这个仓库里是什么

一个 **DSH（DeepSeek Harness）桌面版插件**：`@local/dsh-knowledge-base`。

它给宿主加三样东西：

1. **7 个知识库工具**（见第四节）—— 让 Agent 能读写、检索、自检一个**本地 Markdown 知识库**；
2. **设置页「个人知识库」** —— 选目录、识别目录类型、建库/接入/导入、看导入进度；
3. **顶栏页签** —— 浏览当前库的分类与文件清单（隐私分区只给数量）。

当前源码版本：**0.2.0-rc2**（npm 版本号 `0.2.0-rc2`）。本次版本标记更新后，新的 buildId 须以对应 npm 包重新计算；旧版本 buildId 不适用于此版本。

## 二、安装

本插件只针对 **DSH 桌面版**验证过（`profiles/desktop`）。桌面版 profile 由 Electron 应用独占管理，**不能**用命令行 `dsh plugin add` 安装——只能从应用的插件管理界面装。

1. 打开桌面版 → **设置 → 插件**，安装本地包（或用本仓库源码 `npm pack` 出 tgz，见第六节）；
2. 装完**必须完全退出应用（含系统托盘图标）再打开**——插件行只在 profile 启动时读入，只关窗口不算退出；
3. 重开后进「设置 → 个人知识库」，能看到状态块（知识库路径 / 条目数 / 构建号）即为装好。

包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 在加载时只会自动插入一行 `kb-core`（插件本体），**不会**改动宿主的其他任何配置。

## 三、首次使用（三步）

1. 进「设置 → 个人知识库」；
2. 在「待处理的文件夹」里选一个目录 —— 点 **「选择知识库文件夹」**（或直接粘贴路径）；
3. 点 **「自动建库 / 识别」**，由服务端自己判断该怎么处理：

| 你选的目录 | 会发生什么 |
|---|---|
| 空目录 | 建一个标准库（按 `categories` 建分类目录，不建空壳文件） |
| 已经是本插件的库 | 直接接入，不覆盖任何既有文件 |
| 普通资料文件夹 | 先识别结构（文件数/目录数/可写性），再按分类导入 |

**要点：选目录只记录候选，不绑定、不切换、不改动它**；只有点第二个按钮才会真正执行一次判断与动作。重复导入同一来源不会重复建条目（按来源 + 相对路径去重）。

取消选择不会改变当前绑定；正在跑的导入可以随时取消，取消后原库绑定保持不变。

## 四、7 个工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `kb_status` | 看状态：绑定的库、条目数、索引健康、构建号、状态目录 |
| `kb_bind` | 绑定 / 切换知识库目录（原子提交，提交前会核对配置版本与目标库身份） |
| `kb_init` | 初始化或补齐一个库的分类目录与索引（幂等） |
| `kb_record` | 写入或更新一条条目（**更新必须带 `entryId` + `expectedRevision`**，版本不符返回 conflict 且不改文件） |
| `kb_search` | 检索（索引层 + 正文全文；索引失效会自动回退扫描磁盘） |
| `kb_check` | 自检：孤儿条目、死链、frontmatter 缺失、索引陈旧；`rebuild` 可重建索引 |
| `kb_import` | 导入外部资料（plan / run / status / cancel；attach 接入原目录或 copy 复制进收件箱） |

## 五、配置项（`cordis.patch.yml`）

装好之后这些都在插件配置里，一般不用手改。

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `kbPath` | `''`（未绑定） | 知识库根目录。留空 = 首次进设置页时再定 |
| `stateDir` | `''` | 插件状态目录（`config.json` / `binding.json` / 索引 / 日志 / 自检报告）。留空 = 按 profile 自动隔离为 `<profile>/kb-state` |
| `categories` | `00-画像` … `90-收件箱` | 初始化时创建的分类目录（只建目录，不建空文件） |
| `privateDirs` | `00-画像`、`30-人物关系` | **隐私分区**：清单与地图里只给数量，不列文件名 |
| `excludeFromSearch` | `.kb`、`.kbmeta`、`50-底稿`、`90-收件箱`、`00-知识库请求通道`… | 不参与检索的目录（工具、原始材料、加工件） |
| `followLinks` | `false` | 库内链接/重解析点是否允许写入；`false` = 一律拒绝 |
| `logLevel` | `info` | `debug` / `info` / `warn` |

## 六、构建、验收与目录结构

### 打包

```bat
npm.cmd pack
```

包内只含 `src/`、`cordis.patch.yml`（以及存在时的 `README.md`）。本仓库的 `tests/` 与 `LICENSE` **不算装载文件**，不影响构建 ID。

### 构建 ID 的口径

由下列 **10 个文件**的 sha256 汇总（`相对路径 + \0 + sha256` 逐行拼接后再取 sha256，前 16 位）：

```
package.json
cordis.patch.yml
src/host/index.js      src/host/kbcore.js    src/host/fsindex.js
src/host/importer.js   src/host/import-service.js
src/host/map.js        src/host/selftest.js  src/client/index.js
```

所以「版本号」可以自称，**构建 ID 不能**——文件内容不同，ID 必不同。运行态里设置页「构建」一行显示的就是它。

> 注：git 会把文本文件的换行统一为 LF（Windows 检出时才转回 CRLF），所以**直接拿克隆目录算哈希可能与发布包不一致**。要对齐发布包，请以 `npm.cmd pack` 产出的 tar 包内容为准。

### 自检测试

```bat
node tests/directed-f1f4.mjs        :: 22 项：更新契约 / 隐私反例 / 提交并发
node tests/directed-r1r7.mjs        :: 75 项：R1–R7 定向回归
node tests/independent-import-counters.mjs   :: 17 项：导入计数独立反例
node tests/label-no-numbering.mjs   :: 设置页按钮文案闸门（禁序号 ①–⑳）
```

说明：这些套件是在 Windows + DSH 桌面版上实测通过的（p8：22/22、75/75、17/17），部分断言绑定 Windows 路径行为；在别的平台上跑可能需要对路径判据做调整。它们都应在**独立临时目录**里跑，不要指向你的真实知识库。

### 目录结构

```
├─ package.json          插件清单（main / exports / dsh.bundle.patch）
├─ cordis.patch.yml      装载行（唯一会自动插入宿主的配置）
├─ src/
│  ├─ host/              宿主半边：工具、核心、索引、导入、地图、自检
│  └─ client/            客户端半边：设置页与顶栏页签
└─ tests/                定向回归（不随包分发）
```

## 七、隐私与安全

- **全部本地**：宿主侧不发起任何外部网络请求；客户端唯一的请求是同源的本机接口 `/kb-core/api`（插件自己注册的）。没有遥测、没有上报。
- **隐私分区遮罩**：`privateDirs`（默认 `00-画像`、`30-人物关系`）命中的内容，在清单/地图/最近变更里**只给数量与体积，不出现文件名与正文**。
- **状态不落工作目录**：默认写在 `<profile>/kb-state`，不会把配置、索引、日志散落到你当时的工作目录。
- **写入是谨慎的**：更新必须带版本号（`expectedRevision`），版本不符直接拒绝不改文件；写前自动备份；`update` 失败**不会**退化成 `create`（避免绕过冲突）。

## 八、当前状态与未验证项

历史验证记录（V1.0-rc1，2026-10-18）：工具注册 7/7；定向回归 22/22、75/75、17/17；设置页两按钮文案闸门通过；当时的安装包已装进桌面版 profile 并逐个核对源=装哈希。此后源码版本标记更新为 `0.2.0-rc2`，本次没有改功能代码，也未对新版本重新打包、安装或运行测试；当前运行态仍由已安装的包决定。

未验证：Junction / 符号链接场景、万文件规模下的性能、检查历史与时间线、PDF / OCR / ASR 内容的解析、真实浏览器端的端到端点击。

## 九、许可证

MIT，见 `LICENSE`。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# @laoyinbai/dsh-tool-android-files

面向 **Android 版 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** 的文件整理插件。当前版本 `0.3.0`：**M1 只读分析 + M2.1 计划与授权**。

M1 能做的事：把指定目录**索引**到手机本地 SQLite，做分类、内容级去重、自动编号文件名识别、APK 结构检查，
然后以**聚合数字**的形式向模型汇报。**不会移动、重命名、删除任何用户文件。**

M2.1 能做的事：把去重结果固化成**不可变计划**（含 digest），在 UI 里弹出 plan-review 卡片请用户真正点确认，
确认后把计划标成 `approved`。**本版本仍然不移动任何文件**——执行器在下一个版本。

唯一的临时写操作是 `af_probe_write`：它只在插件自己的数据目录（以及你显式配置的 `probeDir`）里建几个临时文件，
测完立刻删除并核对残留。它不碰任何用户文件。

M2 的正式写入能力（不可变计划 + 可信授权 + 隔离区 + 状态机）尚未实现，也没有注册任何移动/改名/删除工具。

---

## 1. 设计取舍（为什么和常见插件不一样）

| 取舍 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| **没有构建步骤**，`lib/` 就是源码（纯 ESM、零运行时依赖） | 手机端不具备构建能力，pnpm 对 git 依赖又禁止 `prepare` 脚本。把源码直接当产物，从根上消除"仓库里 `lib/` 与 `src/` 不一致"这一整类故障。 |
| **不导出 Schemastery `Config`** | 配置非法时若 schema 校验失败，Cordis 会跳过整个插件，工具全部消失。改为在 `apply()` 内手工归一化，非法项降级并写入 `af_backend`，插件仍可加载。 |
| **只读，且默认遮蔽文件名** | 文件清单、完整路径、哈希都属于隐私数据。默认只回传计数与匿名 id；只有显式 `reveal=true` 才返回真实名称。 |
| **所有结论都写进 `render()` 文本** | DSH 只把 `render()` 生成的文本交给模型，`execute()` 返回的 JSON 值**不进模型上下文**（那是给 PTC/UI 用的）。因此每个工具的渲染文本都自带一行 `key=value`，含 `ok=`、`scan_id=`、全部计数与 `error=`，模型不需要“猜”结构化字段。 |
| **不跟随符号链接** | 目录遍历永不进入 symlink，符号链接目录一律跳过并计数。 |
| **不做 `ctx.fs` 调用** | DSH 原生文件服务没有 move/copy/delete，且受沙箱策略影响；本插件统一用 `node:fs/promises`。 |
| **`node:sqlite` 而非 better-sqlite3** | 设备上没有任何原生模块预编译产物，也没有编译器。 |

## 2. 安装（手机端）

插件按 DSH 官方插件格式交付：npm 包 + Cordis 插件 + `dsh.bundle.patch`。

```sh
# 变量
DSHBIN="$HOME/payload/dshroot/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js"
NODE="$HOME/payload/runtime/bin/node"

# 方式 A：从 GitHub 仓库直接安装（推荐本次使用）
"$NODE" "$DSHBIN" plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/LaoYinBai/dsh-tool-android-files.git

# 方式 B：GitHub Release 预打包 tgz
"$NODE" "$DSHBIN" plugin --profile web add \
  https://github.com/LaoYinBai/dsh-tool-android-files/releases/download/v0.3.0/laoyinbai-dsh-tool-android-files-0.3.0.tgz
```

> 版本门禁：DSH 在加载前会校验 `peerDependencies` 里 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 与运行时版本是否兼容。
> 本包声明 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools: ^0.2.0-rc.2`、`@deepseek-ai/cordis: ^4.0.4`。
> 目标设备为 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`。若加载行被标成 `disabled: true`，先看 `plugins.log` 的版本拒绝原因。

## 3. 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中追加（或由 `dsh plugin add` 自动生成 `insert` 行后编辑 `config`）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: android-files
      name: '@laoyinbai/dsh-tool-android-files'
      config:
        roots:
          - /storage/emulated/0/Download
```

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `roots` | `[]` | **必填**的绝对路径白名单。为空时所有工具都拒绝执行并说明原因。 |
| `dataDir` | `$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/dsh-tool-android-files` | 索引库与插件数据目录。 |
| `maxEntries` | `5000` | 单次扫描索引条目上限，达到后标记 `truncated`。上限 `200000`。 |
| `includeSubdirs` | `true` | 是否递归子目录。 |
| `excludeNames` | `[]` | 精确跳过的文件名。 |
| `excludeExts` | `[]` | 跳过的扩展名（不含点）。 |
| `excludePatterns` | `[]` | 只支持 `*` 的简单通配。 |
| `rules` | `[]` | 追加在內建规则之后的分类规则，见下。 |
| `probeDir` | '' | `af_probe_write` 在共享存储上做写入探测的目录。必须绝对路径且已存在；只有位于已配置根目录内（或 Android 上位于 `/storage/emulated/0/DeepSeekHarness` 内）才会被采用。 |
| `quarantineDir` | `''` | **生成计划所必需**。隔离区根目录，必须是绝对路径。建议放在共享存储（与用户文件同卷）：`/storage/emulated/0/DeepSeekHarness/quarantine`。未配置时 `af_plan_create` 直接拒绝。 |
| `enableWrite` | — | 执行器开关，M2.2 起生效。本版本忽略并给出提示。 |

规则对象可用的条件（**全部满足**才算命中，按数组顺序首条命中生效）：

```yaml
rules:
  - id: camera-raw
    category: image            # image|video|audio|document|archive|installer|other
    exts: [dng, cr3]
    keywords: [img_]           # 名称包含
    minSize: 1048576           # 字节
    maxSize: 209715200
    dirIncludes: [dcim]        # 相对目录包含
```

> 命中不同类别的两条规则时，记录 `conflict` 并标记待确认，**不会**自动移动（M2 生效）。

## 4. 工具

| 工具 | 副作用 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `af_backend` | 仅插件目录 | 报告版本、平台、Node/SQLite 版本、索引库位置与可写性、配置的根目录当前是否可打开、能力清单。 |
| `af_probe_write` | **会写临时文件** | 在插件数据目录与已配置的 `probeDir` 内测 `O_EXCL`/独占复制/硬链接/rename 是否覆盖/跨目录 rename/fsync/时间戳精度/剩余空间，测完自清理并报告残留。不碰用户文件。 |
| `af_scan` | 仅索引库 | 扫描已配置根目录（或其中一个），入库并计算候选哈希。只读用户文件。 |
| `af_scan_report` | 无 | 单次扫描的聚合报告：分类计数、重复统计、零字节、冲突、错误。**不含路径**。 |
| `af_files` | 无 | 分页浏览索引条目。**默认遮蔽名称与路径**；分卷家族名替换为 `family=#<hash8>` 短令牌。 |
| `af_duplicates` | 无 | 按 `大小 + SHA-256` 输出重复组，并单列 `protected_groups` / `protected_bytes`。**默认遮蔽成员名**。 |
| `af_names` | 无 | 自动编号文件名发现：`(1)`/`（1）` 位置、规范名候选、APK 结构检查结果、冲突/待确认标记。 |
| `af_plan_create` | 仅计划表 | 为一次扫描生成**不可变去重计划**：每组保留一份，其余移入隔离区。受保护的组整组跳过并计入 `skipped_groups/skipped_bytes`。返回 `plan_id + digest`。 |
| `af_plan_preview` | 无 | 分页预览计划里的每一条操作（源、隔离目标、大小、原因），默认遮蔽路径。 |
| `af_plan_apply` | 计划状态 | **只接受 `plan_id`**；重算并核对 digest 后，调 `ctx.userQuestions` 弹 plan-review 卡片；只有用户点 Approve 才把计划置为 `approved`（单次、CAS）。**不移动文件**，返回 `executed=0`。 |
| `af_plan_execute` | **会移动文件** | 执行已 `approved` 的计划：逐项复核 `dev+ino+size+mtime+sha256` → 独占创建目标 → `fsync` → 回读校验 → 删除源 → `fsync` 目录。目标已存在或源已变化则**跳过该项并保留源**。每步落 journal。 |

工具名使用 `af_` 前缀并保持裸标识符形式（`^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`），兼容 PTC 代码模式。

## 5. 隐私边界

- 文件**内容**从不离开设备；只有工具返回值会进入模型上下文。
- 索引（名称、路径、大小、哈希、关系）只存在手机本地 SQLite。
- 默认返回值只含计数、分类与匿名 id。`af_files` / `af_duplicates` 的 `reveal` 默认 `false`；
  设为 `true` 表示**文件名与相对路径会随工具结果发送给云端模型**，只应在用户明确要求查看时使用。
- 分卷家族名（`protection` 里的 `family=`）在遮蔽模式下替换为 8 位短 hash：既能跨行分组，又不泄露真实基名。
- 错误信息只含错误码、路径相对形式与系统 errno，不含文件内容、不含任何凭据。

## 6. 安全边界

- 根目录必须显式配置且为绝对路径；工具传入的 `root` 必须是已配置根目录的子路径，
  且其 `realpath` 仍落在该根目录的 `realpath` 之内（防止树内符号链接把范围放大）。
- 永久拒绝：`/storage/emulated/0/Android/data`、`Android/obb`、`/data`、`/proc`、`/sys`、`/system`、`/vendor`、`/apex`、`/dev`。
  含性判断使用 `path.relative`，**不使用字符串前缀**。
- 遍历不跟随符号链接；每次下降前重新 `lstat` 目录，发现已变成链接或非目录即跳过。
- 扫描开始与结束各校验一次根目录 `dev+ino`，被替换则整次扫描失败（`AF_ROOT_CHANGED`）。
- 同一时刻只允许一个扫描；取消通过 `exec.signal` 传递，文件之间与哈希分块之间都会检查。

## 7. 已知限制（诚实清单）

- **未在真机验证**：本版本在开发机（Windows + Node 24）用**真实的 DSH `defineTool` 编译器**跑通了注册与全流程冒烟，
  每个工具返回值都按各自的编译后输出 schema 校验过，并跑了 44 个单元测试；
  但 Android 设备上的加载、SQLite 落盘、FUSE 路径行为尚未实测。
- **没有 MIME 类型**：Node 不提供 MIME 探测，分类只看扩展名。`af_backend` 会明确说明这一点。
- **没有进度事件**：普通工具没有调用中进度，只有开始/结束。大目录请配合 `maxEntries` 与取消。
- **扫描是同步工具**：未使用 `ctx.jobs`。超长扫描会占用该次工具调用；中断后重新扫描会重建索引（哈希有缓存）。
- **零字节文件不参与去重**，只单独计数。
- **未做 5GB 大文件与万级目录的性能验证**（M1 未要求，属 M4 验收项）。
- **不使用 `ctx.approval`**：当前 `danger-full-access` 预设下它恒返回 `rejected`；M2 的授权走 `ctx.userQuestions` 的 plan-review。

## 8. 开发

```sh
node --test          # 44 个单元测试（不需要任何依赖）
npm run check        # 全部 lib 文件语法检查
npm pack             # 产物：laoyinbai-dsh-tool-android-files-0.3.0.tgz
```

仓库内 `lib/` 即发布物，提交前请确认 `node --check` 与 `node --test` 均通过。
`tools/smoke/` 下有一套用**真实 DSH 编译器**做端到端冒烟的方法，见该目录 README。

## 9. 路线图

| 阶段 | 内容 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| M1 | 索引扫描、分类、内容去重、编号名识别、SQLite 持久化、隐私裁剪 | 完成 |
| M2 | 不可变计划 + digest、`userQuestions` plan-review 授权、独占复制 + 校验 + 删源、状态机、journal、重启核对 | **完成（0.3.0）** |
| M3 | 恢复方案、空间统计、隔离区浏览（仍不开放永久清空） | 未开始 |
| M4 | 独立测试目录里的异常场景验收、性能与取消验证 | 未开始 |

## 10. 真机实测的写入语义（M2 设计依据）

`af_probe_write` 在 Xiaomi `24031PN0DC` / Android 16 上实测（FUSE 共享存储 + ext4 应用卷）：

| 能力 | 应用私有卷 (dev 65078) | 共享存储 (dev 1048595) | 结论 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `O_EXCL` 独占创建 | ✅ | ✅ | 不覆盖创建有可靠底座 |
| `COPYFILE_EXCL` 独占复制 | ✅ | ✅ | 复制落盘可保证不覆盖 |
| `link()` 硬链接 | ❌ EACCES | ❌ EACCES | `link`→`unlink` 方案出局 |
| `rename` 静默覆盖目标 | ⚠️ 是 | ⚠️ 是 | **裸 `rename` 不能当移动用** |
| 跨目录 `rename` | ✅ inode 稳定 | ✅ inode 稳定 | 同卷移动可用但不安全 |
| `fsync` 文件 / 目录 | ✅ / ✅ | ✅ / ✅ | 可承诺"内容已校验 + 目录项已提交" |
| 时间戳分辨率 | 4 ms | **8 ms**（`mtimeNs` 可用） | 并发核对以 `dev+ino+size+mtimeNs` 为必要条件，非充分条件 |
| `statfs` 可用空间 | 370.4 GiB | 370.4 GiB | 空间预检可行 |

**由此确定的移动策略**

1. 同卷移动 = `copyFile(COPYFILE_EXCL)` → `fsync(file)` → SHA-256 校验 → `unlink(源)`。
2. 目标已存在 → 直接 fail-closed，绝不覆盖。
3. 跨卷（应用卷 ↔ 共享存储）必须 copy→verify→delete，并预检剩余空间。
4. 隔离区应放**共享存储**（与用户文件同卷），否则每次隔离都是一次跨卷复制。
5. 裸 `rename` 只在"目标确认不存在 + 同卷 + 单文件"时作为优化，失败立即回退 copy 方案。
6. 任一前提不成立 → `AF_UNSUPPORTED`，不降级。

**永不自动处理的文件**（真机数据里真实存在这些）

| 类型 | 判据 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| 未完成下载 | `.part` `.downloading` `.crdownload` `.tmp` `.aria2` | 只索引，永不移动/隔离/改名 |
| 数据库旁路 | `.db-journal` `.db-wal` `.db-shm` `.lock` | 只索引，永不移动 |
| 分卷成员 | `.1` `.001` `.002` `.z01` `.r00`（按家族保护） | 整组保护，绝不单独去重 |

实测案例：一个 80.9 MB × 4 的重复组，四个成员扩展名都是 `.1` —— 若按普通重复文件处理，会破坏一个分卷集合。

### 授权卡片（v0.2.0 真机实测）

| 现象 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 标题显示「计划待审」，按钮显示「要求修改 / 同意执行」 | Web UI 用 `intent.kind='plan-review'` 套了自己的**本地化模板**，会替换插件传入的 header 与选项文案 |
| 但 `af_plan_apply` 拿到的是 `authorized=true` | **回传给插件的仍是你传入的 approve label**，UI 只翻译显示、不改回传值——判定逻辑必须基于 canonical label，不能基于界面文字 |
| 折叠态标题/摘要由客户端的 `extractMarkdownPlainText` 取**第一行/第一段** | 所以第 1 行是标题、第 2 行必须是关键数字（`26 项操作 · 移动 203 MiB · 跳过 1 组受保护（243 MiB）`） |
| 「查看全文」打开的是侧栏文档；本机实测该面板**按原文显示**，不解析 Markdown | 所以正文改成无 Markdown 语法的纯文本排版（分隔线 + 缩进块 + 千分位），在原文显示和 GFM 渲染两种情况下都读得下去；digest 仍在正文里，需要展开才能看到 |

实测对账：`skipped_bytes(254,407,380) + planned_bytes(213,372,998) = 467,780,378`，与 `af_duplicates` 的 `wasted_bytes` 总额完全相等——保护跳过与可执行量之间没有漏算。

## 11. 许可

未声明许可证，保留所有权利。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-cad — CAD Plugin for DeepSeek Harness

![dsh-cad banner](docs/img/banner.svg)

[![homepage](https://img.shields.io/badge/homepage-dsh--cad-4D6BFE)](https://lau-mars.github.io/dsh-cad/)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-cad)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cad)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@deepseek-ai%2Fdsh?label=dsh)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D%2022-4D6BFE)](https://nodejs.org/)
[![occt](https://img.shields.io/badge/occt-7.9.3-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/LAU-MARS/opencascade-ts)
[![occt.ts](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/occt.ts?label=occt.ts)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/occt.ts)
[![ansatz](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/ansatz-wasm?label=ansatz)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ansatz-wasm)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-4D6BFE)](./LICENSE)

English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A CAD plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):
an **embedded 3D/2D CAD viewer** plus a **native parametric modeling tool family**
(OCCT kernel) in the Web UI, letting the agent build and inspect CAD geometry
step by step — "model while you watch".

## Preview

A full modeling session, end to end: the agent builds a parametric assembly
from plain chat — a 120×80×8 base plate with R5 rounded corners, then four
bolt instances placed at the corners — while the resident CAD panel tracks
every step live (parts tree with per-instance colors, ViewCube, "装配体"
assembly tab, 5 instances · 1,740 triangles). The finished assembly exports
as a structured STEP document and the agent verifies it by reading the file
back — 2 solids, 3 products, 2 assembly usages, 1,125.00 mm³:

![dsh-cad assembly session](docs/img/assembly-preview.png)

## Downloads

Cumulative downloads from the npm registry, refreshed daily by CI:

![npm cumulative downloads](docs/img/downloads-cumulative.svg)

## Feature Overview

| Capability | Description |
| --- | --- |
| ⚙️ Single-kernel architecture | **occt.ts as the primary modeling kernel** (true B-splines, native shell/draft, centroid); opencascade.js stays only as the fallback backend; the old "no editing after shell" seam is gone — fillet/chamfer/boolean keep working after shelling |
| 🔍 CAD viewing | STL / OBJ / STEP / IGES / BREP / DCPRT (3D), DXF / SVG (2D); interactive viewport in the resident right panel (orbit / zoom / wireframe / pan), with a one-line result row in the conversation |
| 🧭 CAD editor interactions | Onshape-style ViewCube (26-zone click-to-orient), hover/click face & edge picking with live measurement (area mm² / length mm), Faces+Edges / Faces / Wireframe render modes, switchable BRep demo parts (bracket / flange / shaft) |
| 🏗️ Parametric modeling | Primitives, profile extrusion, **loft**, **sweep**, **revolve**, booleans, all-edge fillet/chamfer, **shell**, **draft**, **patterns** (linear/circular), transforms; profiles take **curve segments** (arcs/circles exact BRep; B-splines sampled approximation) — exact OCCT BRep, not a mesh approximation |
| ✏️ Named sketches | Standalone named profiles (Sketch1…) kept in the document (`cad_sketch_new` / `edit` / `list` / `delete`); extrude/revolve/sweep reference them **by name**, and `cad_sketch_edit` rewrites the definition in place + replays the log, rebuilding every dependent feature — the parametric loop. Sketches render as Onshape-style **blue curves + plane frame** in the viewport (refreshing live on edit), listed in a left-side **feature tree** (sketches + features, eye-toggle visibility, click-to-highlight bodies) over the Part tab |
| 🗂️ Codex-style document tabs | The resident display panel gets a tab strip with a "+" menu: **Part** (Part Studio, the default) / **Assembly** (instance insert/move/remove) / **Drawing** (true hidden-line sheets); tabs are closable and keep their state |
| 📁 Multi-document file space | Named documents per workspace (`.dsh-cad/docs/`), each session bound to its own active document — new sessions start empty instead of inheriting leftovers; a folder button in the panel lists every document (preview / delete), and `cad_doc_new` / `cad_doc_open` manage the modeling target from chat |
| 📐 Engineering drawings | GB first-angle layout: front / top / left views + isometric, true OCCT hidden-line removal via the **occt.ts** kernel (an npm dependency, dashed); sheet frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale series; exports SVG / DXF |
| 🔗 Constraint solving & motion | **Ansatz** geometric constraint solver (**one command: `npm install ansatz-wasm`** — a wasm dependency, no Rust toolchain, no native binary): entity/constraint modeling (assembly instances ↔ rigid3 poses mapped automatically), solve-with-writeback, full DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics (LLM-oriented), and parametric kinematic sweeps (`cad_constraint` / `cad_solve` / `cad_motion`) |
| 📐 Geometry measurement | Exact volume (mm³), bounding box, triangle counts, DXF layers |
| 📤 On-demand export | STEP (parametric) / STL (mesh); files are written only when the user asks |
| 🖥️ Resident CAD panel | A permanent panel right of the conversation: Codex-style tabs (Part / Assembly / Drawing), tracking the latest model in real time while modeling |
| ⚡ Zero-copy render pipeline | worker mesh → in-memory binary → three.js typed arrays; zero base64 / zero intermediate files / zero per-step disk writes |
| 💾 Modeling document persistence | Operation log (JSON) + debounced disk mirror; automatically replayed to restore state after a process restart |
| 🖼️ Image → profile | PNG sketch/screenshot → Otsu binarization → contour tracing → extrusion-ready polygon (`cad_image_profile`) |
| 🔌 FreeCAD executor | Run the same op family on an external FreeCAD console (STEP in/out); requires a local FreeCAD install |
| ☁️ Onshape executor | Run the same op family on **Onshape** over its signed REST API — zero local install; every op compiles to a **standard Onshape feature** pushed into the target Part Studio (no Feature Studio setup). Readback is three-tier: cheap per-part STL by default, `readback: "step"` for exact-BRep-derived named meshes via a server-side STEP translation, or `readback: "none"` — build only and return the document link (~3 calls, quota-friendliest). Exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid). Quota-aware errors distinguish credential problems from free-plan cooldowns; the Onshape document URL is always surfaced |

## Installation

The plugin is published to npm — one line:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cad
```

The installer applies the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` (declared in the `dsh.bundle` manifest) automatically, so there is nothing to configure by hand.

### Version requirements

- **Node.js** and **dsh CLI** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`): minimum versions live in
  the badge row above and the `engines` field of `package.json` — kept out of
  the prose so they never go stale

### Install from source (dev mode)

```sh
git clone https://github.com/LAU-MARS/dsh-cad.git
cd dsh-cad
npm install && npm run build && npm test   # deps include occt.ts (true-HLR drawing kernel, ~20MB wasm)

npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh pnpm
dsh web                                  # let the first launch init the profile, then Ctrl-C

dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-cad

dsh web
```

The patch insert ships as `cordis.patch.yml` in the package root and is applied by the installer via the same `dsh.bundle` manifest.

Set `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` and you are ready — for example:

- “open bracket.stl” → `cad_view`
- “model a 100×60×5 plate, punch a ⌀20 hole in the middle, R2 fillets on the four
  corners, add a ⌀16 boss 20 tall, export plate.step”
  → `cad_create_prim` + `cad_boolean` + `cad_fillet` + `cad_export`, with the 3D tab
  updating live at every step
- “build a snowman” → spheres + a cone nose + a cylinder hat (precise `at`/`axis` placement)
- “add two more b1, one rotated 90 degrees” → `cad_assembly_insert` + `cad_assembly_move`, the Assembly tab updates live
- “make an A3 drawing of b1 and export dxf” → `cad_drawing` (three views + iso + dashed hidden lines + dimensions) → `cad_export` `.dxf`

## Modeling Tool Family

| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cad_view` | Open a CAD file and render it in the viewer (resident panel) |
| `cad_info` | Read-only geometry metadata (format / counts / bounding box / units / layers) |
| `cad_create_prim` | Primitives (mm, Z-up); `at` for placement, `axis` for orientation (exact axis-angle rotation) |
| `cad_sketch_new` | Create a named sketch (Sketch1…): {start, segments} / {circle} / flat points loop — referenced by name from the profile features |
| `cad_sketch_edit` | Redefine a sketch (回改): the definition op is rewritten in place and the log replayed — every referencing feature rebuilds |
| `cad_sketch_list` | List the document's sketches (name / form / size) |
| `cad_sketch_delete` | Delete a sketch (refused while features still reference it) |
| `cad_extrude_profile` | Extrude a closed XY-plane profile along +Z into a solid — inline points/segments/circle or a named sketch (`sketch`) |
| `cad_loft` | Loft: skin a solid through successive closed sections (each a [x,y,z,…] loop in its own plane); sections may differ in shape and point count; `ruled` for straight sides |
| `cad_revolve` | Solid of revolution: revolve a closed profile around an axis (profile coords = (radius, height); curve segments supported — rounded rims exact); optional `angle`; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_chamfer` | Chamfer: bevel every sharp edge with one equal distance (mm) |
| `cad_pattern` | Pattern: linear (`delta` spacing) or circular (principal axis + `at` point + sweep angle); creates copy bodies, fuse afterwards for one body |
| `cad_shell` | Shell: hollow to a wall thickness (inward, outer skin preserved); `open` lists outward normals of the faces to open (empty = sealed). Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_draft` | Draft: tilt the walls `angle` degrees about a neutral plane (mold release); `direction` is the pull direction, walls auto-selected by default. Runs on the occt.ts kernel; the result is a HOSTED body |
| `cad_sweep` | Sweep: pipe a closed 2D profile along a 3D [x,y,z,…] path; the profile is auto-placed on the start plane, so no manual orientation; accepts a named sketch |
| `cad_boolean` | fuse / cut / common (classic hole punching: plate cut cylinder) |
| `cad_fillet` | Constant-radius fillet on all sharp edges |
| `cad_transform` | Translate / Euler rotate / mirror |
| `cad_volume` | Exact BRep volume (mm³) |
| `cad_drawing` | Engineering drawing: front/top/left + isometric views, dashed hidden lines, frame, title block, overall dimensions, standard scale, A4/A3 |
| `cad_assembly_insert` | Insert a body into the assembly as a placed instance (`at` position, `rotate` orientation) |
| `cad_assembly_move` | Set an instance's absolute placement |
| `cad_assembly_remove` | Remove an instance from the assembly (the body stays) |
| `cad_constraint` | Declare the constraint model: entities (assembly-instance bindings) + constraints (distance/angle/mate/coaxial…), persisted in the op log |
| `cad_solve` | Solve with Ansatz and write poses back; returns DOF/residual/redundancy/suggestion diagnostics |
| `cad_motion` | Kinematic sweep: drive one constraint value from `from` to `to`, solve frame by frame, apply the last pose, return the motion table |
| `cad_export` | Export STEP / STL / DCPRT (the native replayable part document) to a workspace path; `target: "assembly"` writes the assembly STEP, `target: "drawing"` writes the sheet as SVG / DXF |
| `cad_delete` | Delete a body |
| `cad_docs` | List the workspace's modeling documents (id / name / bodies / updated, active marked) |
| `cad_doc_new` | Create a named document and make it the session's modeling target (start multi-part projects here) |
| `cad_doc_open` | Open an existing document (by id or name) as the session's modeling target — bodies replay exactly |
| `cad_doc_rename` | Rename a document |
| `cad_doc_delete` | Permanently delete a document (requires `confirm: true`) |
| `cad_freecad` | Run an op program on an external FreeCAD executor (optional STEP input / export) |
| `cad_fusion` | Run an op program on an external Fusion 360 executor (GUI bridge; optional export) |
| `cad_onshape` | Run an op program on the Onshape cloud (signed REST API): creates or drives a document, returns its URL; `readback: "step"` for exact BRep meshes; exports `.stl` / `.step` / `.x_t` (Parasolid) |
| `cad_image_profile` | PNG → contours → extrusion-ready polygon points |
| `cad_script` | Deterministic script evaluation for geometry math (profile point arrays, arc coordinates): `js` runs in-process (Node vm — works even when the host shell is unavailable), `py` uses a system Python |

After every modeling step: **the chat result row updates in place** (stable viewId +
versioned URL), and the resident panel's "Part" tab tracks the latest model in real time.

## Connectors (roadmap)

Modeling primarily runs on the **occt.ts kernel** (opencascade.js as the fallback backend) (OCCT in the browser —
zero install). The connectors below refer to **external CAD engines** acting as
executors for the same tool family, planned for future support:

| Connector | Suite | Platform | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Built-in kernel** | CAD modeling kernel based on OCCT + WebGL, runs in the browser — zero install | All platforms (WebGL rendering) | ✅ Built-in |
| FreeCAD | open-source parametric suite — natural local executor via its Python API (console + GUI window modes) | Windows / macOS / Linux | ✅ Available (needs local install) |
| Fusion 360 | Autodesk CAD/CAM — resident add-in + spool bridge (no headless; the Fusion window doubles as a viewer) | Windows / macOS | 🧪 Experimental (`cad_fusion`) |
| SolidWorks | Dassault Systèmes industry-standard 3D CAD, COM/.NET automation | Windows only | 🚧 Windows demo scaffold (`scripts/solidworks-bridge/`) |
| Onshape | PTC cloud-native SaaS CAD, fully in the browser — signed REST API (cad.onshape.com or chamber hosts); every op compiles to a standard Onshape feature pushed into the Part Studio, results read back as per-part STL + mass properties, the cloud is the viewer | All platforms (browser) | ✅ Available (`cad_onshape`; set `DSH_ONSHAPE_ACCESS_KEY` / `DSH_ONSHAPE_SECRET_KEY`) |
| ZW3D（中望3D） | ZWSOFT all-in-one CAD/CAM | Windows / Linux | 🚧 Planned |
| GstarCAD 3D（浩辰3D） | Gstarsoft 3D CAD | Windows | 🚧 Planned |

All external engines implement the same **GeometryExecutor contract** (`available()` /
`run(opProgram) → meshes`), so the WebGL display layer never changes — swapping a
backend changes only the quality of the produced geometry.

## Architecture

```
cad_view(path)                        modeling tools (cad_create_prim, …)
  → import worker (occt-import-js)      → modeling worker (opencascade.js WASM)
  → CadScene JSON (base64-f32)          → exact BRep geometry + meshing
  → GET /dsh-cad/scene/<id>            → in-memory binary scene (f32/u32 packed)
                                        → GET /dsh-cad/bin/<docId>
            ↓ session presentationMeta (viewId + versioned URL) ↓
        browser card + persistent "3D" tab (three.js / SVG, Z-up, XYZ axes)
```

- **Two workers**: import (occt-import-js, read-only STEP/IGES/BREP) and modeling
  (opencascade.js, full OCCT) are separate, both lazily started; the `_N`
  suffix convention of embind overloaded constructors is wrapped in
  `src/modeling/occt-adapter.cjs` (all verified at runtime)
- **Zero-copy pipeline**: modeling scenes use zero base64 / zero large JSON arrays /
  zero per-step disk writes (disk mirror debounced 1.5s, replayed only on service
  restart); `cad_export` is the only explicit file export
- **Modeling document**: `<workspace>/.dsh-cad/model.json` operation log; all bodies
  are restored by replay after a restart
- **Drawing HLR kernel**: hidden lines run on **occt.ts** (npm dependency,
  `npm i occt.ts`) — true OCCT removal, no fallback engine, a missing kernel is
  a hard error. New APIs over opencascade.js: `hiddenLines()` true hidden-line
  removal, byte-level STEP/BRep `readStep`/`readBrep`/`writeStep`/`writeBrep`
  without MEMFS, tessellation with built-in feature-edge extraction, and a
  `hasError()`/`lastError()` error contract. Geometry crosses kernels as STEP
  bytes and the projected segments are remapped into the sheet frame. Kernel
  dist resolution: `DSH_OCCTJS_DIST` env var → Node's own resolution of the
  `occt.ts` dependency (walks up every parent node_modules — npm/yarn flat and
  pnpm symlink layouts all hit) → `<repo>/../opencascade-ts/dist` (sibling
  checkout) → `vendor/` → `node_modules/opencascade-ts`
- **Constraint solving (Ansatz)**: the solver is the npm dependency
  **`ansatz-wasm`** (a wasm-bindgen build, single package ~538KB, zero deps) —
  installing dsh-cad pulls it automatically, and `npm install ansatz-wasm` alone
  upgrades it. **No Rust toolchain, no native binary, platform independent.**
  Resolution: the npm package (node_modules) → a `DSH_ANSATZ_WASM` directory → a
  sibling Ansatz checkout's pkg-node. The solver speaks one JSON envelope
  contract, with tool-layer errors (e.g. `unsupported_constraint`) surfaced
  verbatim for the LLM. Assembly placements (translate + XYZ Euler
  degrees) map bidirectionally to the solver's rigid3 poses (translate +
  exponential-map rotation, radians). Solver capability is staged
  (point-distance-to-origin today) — the plumbing contract is finished and needs
  no changes as it grows
- **Single-kernel architecture**: the primary modeling kernel is
  **occt.ts** — primitives, curve-segment profiles (TRUE B-spline
  interpolation), loft/sweep/revolve, booleans, fillet/chamfer, shell/draft,
  mirror (composed as scale(-1) + a π rotation) and centroid all live in one
  session; engineering-drawing HLR takes the shape directly (zero STEP hops);
  editing after shelling is seamless (the old hosted-body seam is deleted).
  opencascade.js remains as the FALLBACK backend (auto-selected when occt.ts
  cannot load). Assembly STEP export writes a **structured document** (occt.ts
  `writeStepDocument`): one root product plus one named, placed child
  per instance — instance separation survives the file (STL stays a single
  fused mesh; the fallback backend also fuses). Instance separation stays in
  the assembly scene/document for the fuse paths.
  Face selection matches `describe()` plane normals (outermost along ±normal)
- **Client**: esbuild single-file CJS factory (three.js inlined ~560KB, react provided
  by the host module table), Z-up CAD convention, empty scene with XYZ axis labels
  and a ground grid always displayed

## Tests

```sh
npm test                             # full suite: converters / modeling worker (exact volume assertions) / DCPRT round-trip / FreeCAD + Onshape executors / image profiles / binary pipeline / document persistence
node test/m0-kernel-check.cjs        # OCCT kernel API smoke test
node test/route-check.mjs            # JSON scene routing layer
node test/visual/serve.mjs           # browser card/tab visual verification page (http://127.0.0.1:3987)
```

Representative assertions covered: the boolean-punched volume exactly equals the
analytic value (28429.20 mm³), L-shaped profile extrusion 3000 mm³, volumes and
bounding-box flips of sphere/cone/torus placed with `at`/`axis`, 8-byte alignment
of the binary packing, an STL export round-trip (export → read back by the
phase-1 parser), and a DCPRT document round-trip (serialize → replay on the
OCCT worker → exact bounds).

## Known Limitations

- DWG (closed-source) is unsupported; DXF bulge arcs are approximated by chords;
  glTF/3MF viewing is not implemented (the structure is reserved)
- `cad_fillet` is all-edge constant-radius (per-edge selection is unstable under
  embind); chamfer is not implemented
- Sketch extrusion supports polygon profiles only (arc profiles are constructed by
  boolean combinations of cylinders/tori)
- dsh framework limitation: an already-mounted single slot (the right-side details
  panel itself) does not respond to components registered later, so the persistent
  view is provided as the "3D" view tab (a list slot, the official composition)
- The host reads CAD files via node:fs (the platform fs service supports UTF-8 text
  only and cannot carry binary data)

## Community

| QQ Group (🇨🇳 China) | Feishu (🇨🇳 China) | X / Twitter (🌍 International) | Discord (🌍 International) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `485038246` (join note: dsh-cad) | 🚧 Coming soon | 🚧 Coming soon | 🚧 Coming soon |

# dsh-wsl-file-open

Fix **"open in File Explorer"**, **"open with…"**, and the **"Open In…"** button for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) web when the
host runs inside **WSL2**.

On a WSL deployment these gestures fail in four different ways. This repository ships a
small profile plugin plus a skill that fixes all four without patching DSH itself.

## What it fixes

| UI gesture | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Card menu → *Show in File Explorer* | Opens `Documents` (or the user profile) instead of the file's folder; CJK file names are never selected | Opens the containing folder **and selects the file** |
| Card menu → *Open* (default app) | `打开失败` / `Could not open` | Opens with the registered default application |
| Card menu → *Open with…* | `Could not load applications` | Lists the real Windows handlers (icons included) |
| Session header → *Open In…* | `打开失败` (only `xdg-open` is offered) | Opens the workspace folder in Windows Explorer |

## Why it breaks (short version)

1. **Service PATH** — `dsh-web` started by systemd inherits a PATH without
   `/mnt/c/Windows/**`, so bare `explorer.exe` / `powershell.exe` spawns are `ENOENT`.
2. **`explorer.exe /select` cannot select a UNC or CJK path** — upstream builds a
   percent-encoded `file://` URI; non-ASCII names are silently not selected.
3. **The application list shells out to a bare `gio`** on the Linux branch, and this
   host has no desktop MIME database → the query throws.
4. **Picking an application via Shell COM loses the app's registered arguments** — apps
   that need a flag (e.g. Navicat's `-uri`) hang or do nothing.

Details and code references: [docs/upstream-analysis.md](docs/upstream-analysis.md).

## How it works

```
~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml   ← insert one loader entry
        │
        ▼
wsl-file-open/index.js                       ← package main (re-exports)
        │
        ▼
wsl-file-open/impl.mjs                       ← overrides four sessionController integrations
    ├─ fileApplications     → absolute-path runner around dsh-native-command
    ├─ openFileApplication  → the app's registered command (registry), not Shell-COM invoke
    ├─ openPath             → absolute-path runner
    └─ revealPath           → Shell namespace + SelectItem (program.ps1)
        │
        ▼
wsl-file-open/program.ps1                    ← read from disk on every call (editable live)
```

The plugin is a normal DSH package: `package.json` declares `main`/`exports`, and
`cordis.patch.yml` declares a **bundle patch** so the package can also be installed the
standard way (see *Alternative: install as a bundle*). The vendored installer mounts it
through DSH's documented **profile patch layer**; neither path modifies any DSH package. It replaces `sessionController` fields that DSH treats as
replaceable host integrations, so the controller keeps its own path verification, error
mapping, and wire schema.

## Requirements

- WSL2 with Windows mounted at `/mnt/c` (override with `DSH_WSL_FILE_OPEN_WINDOWS_ROOT`)
- DSH **0.2.x** (tested on `0.2.0-rc.2`), `dsh web` profile
- Windows PowerShell at the standard location, `explorer.exe` present

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ldwdg/dsh-wsl-file-open.git
cd dsh-wsl-file-open
bash install.sh
```

Optional flags:

```bash
bash install.sh --with-xdg-open     # also install ~/.local/bin/xdg-open (fixes "Open In…")
bash install.sh --force-xdg-open    # overwrite an existing ~/.local/bin/xdg-open (backs it up)
```

The installer is idempotent: it backs up `cordis.patch.yml`, copies `lib/` into the
profile, writes a named+versioned `package.json` beside it, adds a marked insert block only
when absent, and installs the skill to `~/.dsh/skills/dsh-wsl-file-open/`.

### Alternative: install as a bundle

The repository is also a valid DSH bundle (`package.json` → `dsh.bundle.patch`). If you
have `pnpm` on PATH:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ldwdg/dsh-wsl-file-open   # or a git/file spec
# then add "dsh-wsl-file-open" to dsh.profile.bundles in ~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json
systemctl --user restart dsh-web
```

This path needs no vendored copy; the bundle patch inserts the package by name and pnpm
also installs the plugin's `@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command` dependency. The default
installer remains dependency-free (it works without pnpm or a package registry) because the
vendored copy resolves that library from the DSH installation closure.

### Restart is required

DSH 0.2 does **not** hot-reload the profile patch into a running service:

```bash
systemctl --user restart dsh-web     # or however you launch `dsh web`
```

Then hard-refresh the browser. Buttons may stay grey for a moment on first use — that is
the desktop warm-up, not a failure.

## Verify

```bash
bash scripts/verify.sh              # host metadata + application list
```

Or manually (see [docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md)):

```bash
TOKEN=$(journalctl --user -u dsh-web --since "10 min ago" | grep -o 'token=[A-Za-z0-9_-]*' | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2)
curl -c /tmp/c.txt -b /tmp/c.txt -L -o /dev/null "http://127.0.0.1:30808/?token=$TOKEN"
curl -b /tmp/c.txt http://127.0.0.1:30808/api/present.host     # {"available":true,...}
curl -b /tmp/c.txt http://127.0.0.1:30808/open-in-app/apps     # {"apps":[...]}
```

Then click a card and confirm the file is **selected** in Explorer.

Verification opens real Windows windows; close them and delete probe files afterwards
(see the skill's *Cleanup after verification* section).

## Configuration

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_WSL_FILE_OPEN_WINDOWS_ROOT` | `/mnt/c` | Windows mount root |
| `DSH_WSL_FILE_OPEN_LOG` | `/tmp/dsh-wsl-file-open.log` | Diagnostic log; `off` disables |
| `DSH_WSL_FILE_OPEN_DEBUG` | unset | `1` adds phase timings |

The diagnostic log records which branch ran and which registered command was used — the
fastest way to debug a per-application quirk.

## Uninstall

```bash
bash uninstall.sh                  # removes plugin, skill, and the marked patch block
bash uninstall.sh --with-xdg-open  # also restores/removes the xdg-open shim
systemctl --user restart dsh-web
```

## Known limitations

- **"Open with…" is best-effort per application.** The plugin runs the application's
  registered command. Applications that do not accept a file argument on the command line
  launch without opening the file. **Navicat Premium 17** is one: its registration is
  `"…\navicat.exe" "%1"`, yet `"%1"`, `-uri file:///…` and ShellExecuteEx with the
  application class all leave the file closed (verified). Use Explorer's right-click
  *Open with* for those applications.
- The application list only contains handlers Windows registers for the file extension;
  an application with no registration will not appear.

## Compatibility caveats

- The plugin relies on `sessionController` fields that DSH documents as **internal test
  seams** (`fileApplications`, `openFileApplication`, `openPath`, `revealPath`). They are
  ordinary instance properties today; a future DSH release may rename or privatise them.
  The plugin checks each field with `typeof … === 'function'` and simply leaves it alone
  when absent, so a change degrades to upstream behaviour instead of breaking DSH.
- `program.ps1` is re-read per call; `impl.mjs` / `index.js` are **cached by URL** — after
  editing them, rename the entry (and update the patch) or restart the service.
- Selecting a file launches a PowerShell process (≈3–6 s). Reveal is the slow path;
  default-open is faster.

## 中文速览

- **修什么**：WSL 上 DSH web 的「资源管理器显示（含选中）」「默认应用打开」「打开方式」「Open In…」四个入口。
- **装**：`bash install.sh`，然后 `systemctl --user restart dsh-web`，刷新页面。
- **卸载**：`bash uninstall.sh` 后重启。
- **排障**：看 `/tmp/dsh-wsl-file-open.log`；详细根因见 `docs/upstream-analysis.md`。
- **注意**：插件依赖 DSH 的内部接缝（非官方扩展点），缺失时自动降级；改 `impl.mjs` 需重启，改 `program.ps1` 立即生效。

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

Hooks replace lower-level file-opening helpers while retaining the host controller path checks; Windows associations, registry commands, PowerShell and Explorer run with host-user authority. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# dsh-disco-whale > DSH（DeepSeek Harness）桌面端 / Web 端的 **「鲸鱼蹦迪」彩蛋插件**。 > 发送「欧耶耶」，整个界面秒变舞厅。 > > GitHub: **灵感来源**：B 站视频 `BV1kTp962EJG`（UP 主：幸羽雪雪） **音频来源**：B 站视频 `BV1hXbN6VEKV`（UP 主：活跃黑江乐）——《朋友的酒》DJ 完整版

## 效果 **平时完全隐身**：小鲸鱼、音响、气泡全部不显示（右下角只剩你的余额插件），不会挡任何界面。 发送触发词（默认 **「欧耶耶」**）后，角色带着整套舞台一起淡入： - 🪩 **全屏舞厅灯光**：顶部迪斯科球 + 旋转彩色光幕 + 镜面球光斑 + 5 束长激光 + 舞池反光 + 扫描线 + 随拍频闪； - 🐳 **小鲸鱼蹦迪**：按节拍上下压缩/拉伸（squash & stretch），并左右平移在整个屏幕里摇摆； - 🔊 **音响**：角色旁边立起一只音响，低音喇叭随拍鼓动、指示灯闪烁； - 💬 **气泡歌词**：小鲸鱼顶上的气泡每隔 9.2 秒换一句《朋友的酒》歌词； - 🎵 **音乐**：插件内置一段 188 秒的舞曲（`assets/music.mp3`），装上就有声；也支持换成自己的曲子；整段音乐播完之前不会自己结束； - 📝 **回复变歌词**：触发后紧接着的那条助手回复会被替换成 16 行歌词。 消息里带 **「新宿决战」或相关梗**：模型先在真实聊天回复里接住这个梗，自然把话题转到新宿决战；等回复完成，页面最上层才**全屏无边框播放彩蛋视频**。视频到 **00:28** 和 **01:28** 时，Q 版 DeepSeek 娘会在右下角发射球形虚式「茈」，白发龙角角色的 Q 版在旁边受击；**00:41** 双方以各自的结印姿势同时展开领域并产生碰撞。点画面 / 右上角小 ✕ / 按 `Esc` 关闭，放完自动关闭。 发送 **「？」**：助手回复被替换成一句—— > 发什么问号，严肃点全体保持Q弹！ **手动结束**：按 `Esc`，或双击小鲸鱼。音乐结束（或手动结束）后，整套角色与灯光**自动淡出消失**，回到平时隐身状态。 ## 安装 插件是标准 DSH bundle 插件，装进 `web`（桌面端为 `desktop`）profile 即可。 ### 方式 A：从 GitHub 安装（推荐） ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:learnfrom325/dsh-disco-whale ``` > 本插件目前**未发布到 npm**；也可以用 DSH 桌面端的插件管理器（市场）按 GitHub 地址安装。 ### 方式 B：本地目录（开发 / 自用） ```bash git clone https://github.com/learnfrom325/dsh-disco-whale.git dsh plugin --profile web add link:<克隆下来的绝对路径> ``` ### 方式 C：手工复制 把本仓库的 `lib/`、`assets/`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`package.json` 复制到： ``` /profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-disco-whale/ ``` （`` 默认是 `~/.dsh`，Windows 上是 `C:\Users\<你>\.dsh`） 安装完成后 **重启 DSH**，再刷新页面（桌面端 `Ctrl+R`）。控制台出现下面这行即成功： ``` [dsh-disco] ready v0.5.2：发送「欧耶耶」或「？」触发；提到「新宿决战」播放彩蛋视频 ``` ## 触发词 默认触发词： ``` 欧耶耶 / 欧耶 / 欧也 / 耶耶耶 / oh yeah yeah / ohyeahyeah / our ye ye / ouyeye / oyeye ``` 匹配规则是 **整条消息等于触发词**（忽略空白与标点、大小写），所以「把…欧耶耶…」这种长句不会误触发。 自定义触发词（浏览器控制台执行一次，刷新后生效）： ```js localStorage.setItem('dsh-disco-words', '蹦迪,跳舞,ohyeahyeah') // 英文逗号分隔 ``` ## 视频触发词 消息里**包含**以下辨识度高的梗（忽略空白与常见标点）就会播放视频： - 新宿决战／人外魔境新宿决战／最强的战绩铭刻于新宿 - 五条悟赢了、你才是挑战者、2.5 条悟、一刻也来不及悼念五条悟 - 虚式「茈」、无限制虚式、没能让宿傩大人使出全力、我打宿傩？真的假的？ - 中间忘了后面也忘了 - B 站二创开头「真拿你没办法，坐好喽」、茈发动前的 41 秒、回到那个夏天依旧赌你会赢 - 「我已经 0.01 秒没看新宿决战了」、DeepSeek 娘 VS 豆包 「会赢的」单独发送或与五条悟等上下文同句时触发；「雨爱」「41 秒」需要与五条悟、宿傩、新宿等上下文同句。「两者皆有可能，这就是答案」需要与 DeepSeek、ChatGPT 或豆包同句，避免普通聊天误播。简繁体常见写法都支持。视频触发优先于蹦迪触发词。 新增词例参考 B 站的[《新宿决战》雨爱版](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1QC3G6DEKX/)、[音效版](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV193Ye6BE9g/)、[41 秒二创](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1LPoXBSEUh/)与[DeepSeek 娘 VS 豆包](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1dsai6CErz/)；插件只匹配短语，不复制视频内容。 自定义视频地址（控制台执行一次，刷新后生效）： ```js localStorage.setItem('dsh-disco-video', 'https://…/你的视频.mp4') // 换视频地址（相对路径 / https / data:video 均可） ``` ## 音乐 插件**已内置**一段舞曲：`assets/music.mp3`（3.6 MB，48 kHz / 160 kbps 立体声，188 秒），装上即有音乐，无需任何配置。 > 音频来自 B 站视频 `BV1hXbN6VEKV`（UP 主：活跃黑江乐）的《朋友的酒》DJ 完整版，仅作彩蛋演示使用，版权归原作者。 想换曲子：把音频放到下面任意位置，命中的优先使用（越靠前优先级越高）： ``` /disco-whale/music.mp3 ← 优先级最高（你自己的曲子） <插件目录>/assets/music.mp3 ← 内置（仓库自带） /whale-audio/dance.mp3 ← 兜底：复用 dsh-whale-widget 的音频目录 ``` 支持 `mp3 / wav / ogg / m4a / flac / aac`；换曲子后刷新页面即可生效（无需重启 DSH）。所有候选都找不到时，用内置的 150BPM 合成旋律兜底。 **节拍对齐**：默认按 130 BPM、首个拍点距音频开头 0.199s 对齐（对应内置那段 188 秒舞曲）。换成别的曲子后如果"踩不准"，改 `assets/disco-widget.js` 顶部的 `DISCO_BPM` / `DISCO_PHASE`。 ## 彩蛋视频 插件**已内置**彩蛋视频：`assets/video.mp4`（26 MB，1920×1080，1 分 33 秒，H.264 + AAC），触发后由前端 `

decision.reason: Held for versioned DSH compatibility, repository or package licensing, package or companion artifact mapping. Own Git mapping exists but no versioned DSH baseline. Code MIT excludes unresolved DJ/character media rights. Bounded archive exceeded 25 MB, so native artifact completeness remains unverified. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-opencode-mode

**opencode 式 plan/build 双挡位 for DSH**：`OC Plan` / `OC Build`，Tab 键切换，计划挡位在调度层硬拒写操作与高危命令（不弹审批框），挡位提示走尾部用户消息以保住 KV 前缀缓存。

## 为什么需要它

DSH 内置的 `/plan`（`dsh-plan-mode`）只注入系统提示词：工具目录**刻意保持不变**（为请求缓存稳定），所以模型仍看得见 `write`/`bash`，越界时才靠沙箱/审批兜底——于是出现"plan 下还试图写、写就弹框要权限"。opencode 的 plan agent 是**运行时 deny**（`edit: {"*":"deny"}`），模型直接调不动，只会说"请切 build"。

本插件把 opencode 的口径搬到 DSH，同时**不牺牲缓存**：

| 机制 | opencode | 本插件 |
|---|---|---|
| 两挡位 | build / plan agent | `OC Build` / `OC Plan` 权限档 |
| 切换 | Tab（agent cycle） | Tab 键（可用 `/mode` 命令，客户端可改键） |
| 计划挡位约束 | `edit: deny`（运行时） | `ctx.tools.guard()` 运行时硬拒，**不改工具 schema** |
| 模式提示 | system-reminder（尾部用户消息） | `agent.inject()`（尾部用户消息） |
| 缓存 | 前缀不动 | 前缀不动（system prompt 不重写） |

## 安装

本插件是标准 DSH bundle（`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`），用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle` 指向本目录安装；HMR 热加载，新装 bundle 不需要重启。

## 挡位定义

本 bundle 自带 `cordis.patch.yml`，定义 `OC Plan` / `OC Build` 两挡并**整段替换** `permission` 行。⚠️ DSH 的 patch 对同一 `id` 是**整段替换、不做深合并**——如果你的 profile 自己也有 `permission` 行，请把这两挡写进去（示例）：

```yaml
- id: permission
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets"
  config:
    presets:
      oc-plan:
        sandbox: workspace-write      # 沙箱允许 /tmp（练习场）；正式目录由 guard 拦
        approval: never               # 不弹审批框
        name: OC Plan
        description: 只读计划：临时目录可写，正式目录与高危命令被拒
      oc-build:
        sandbox: workspace-write
        approval: never
        name: OC Build
    defaultPreset: oc-build
```

## 用法

### 挡位切换

- `/mode oc-plan` / `/mode oc-build`（服务端命令，带挡位提示）
- `/mode`（不带参数）报告当前挡位
- **Tab 键**：在当前查看的会话里切换挡位（覆盖浏览器焦点导航；改键见 DSH 设置里的快捷键面板）

### OC Plan 挡位放行/拒绝清单

| 放行 | 拒绝 |
|---|---|
| 只读工具：read / grep / glob / list / web / image / skill | write / edit / patch 到**正式目录**（只允许 `/tmp`、平台临时目录） |
| bash 只读命令：ls/cat/head/tail/wc/stat/du/df/find/rg/sed -n/awk、git status·log·diff·show·branch·rev-parse、ps/top/free/uname/ss/netstat/ip a、docker ps·images·logs·inspect、systemctl status·journalctl、nvidia-smi | 包管理：apt/pip install/npm install -g |
| **ssh 只读命令**（`ssh host "ls"` 等） | 服务变更：reboot/shutdown/systemctl restart·stop·enable |
| 临时目录练习：`javac`/`java 输出 main`、`python -c`、`node -e`、`go run` 等一次性运行 | 进程：kill/pkill |
| 临时目录读写：`mkdir -p /tmp`、`touch /tmp`、`mktemp`、`> /tmp`、`tee /tmp` | 容器变更：docker run/rm/stop/pull/exec |
| 拉取/下载到 /tmp 阅读：`git clone`、`curl`、`wget`、`pip download`、`npm pack` | git 写入：commit/push/reset/checkout/clean |
| — | 沙箱升级（避免弹框） |
| — | 重定向（`>`/`>>`）到非临时目录 |

原则：**临时目录是 AI 的练习场**——可以编译、运行、下载、写草稿，但不得影响任何程序运行（不装包、不改服务、不动进程、不写正式目录）。

### 缓存行为

- 挡位提示通过 `agent.inject()` 落在**尾部用户消息**，system prompt 与工具 schema 不变 → 切换挡位后前缀缓存仍命中（与 opencode 同口径）
- guard 只在调度时拒绝，不改工具目录 → 不破坏请求字节

## 设计取舍

- **不用 `tools.restrict()`**：裁工具会改 schema，导致从第一个改动 token 起缓存失效
- **不用内置 `/plan`**：它的 section 在 system prompt 中部，切换会改写 system 节点、丢前缀缓存
- bash 白名单基于命令前缀匹配，与 opencode 的 bash 权限同口径——能防住常见误操作，不是沙箱级保证（`$()`、管道、二进制编码等仍可能绕过）

## 后续计划

- `/undo`（消息版撤回：截断历史、保留日志，撤回点之前缓存命中）+ `/redo`
- `/rename`（接 `sessionTitle.rename`）、`/export` markdown 到指定目录、`/seesession`（查看其他会话）

## 许可

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
在一个侧栏里读完 Git 的分支、工作树和改动。
只读查看，不 checkout、不切目录；DSH / Codex / Claude 共用同一套拓扑与数据层。

## 长什么样

上半：分支 / 合并拓扑，主干竖直、分支向右；下半：WORKTREES、CHANGES、FILES。

点开任意提交，完整消息、修改文件和单文件差异就在同一栏展开：

## 为什么不是普通的 git 图 多数 Git 图把提交均匀铺开，分支一动，主干就跟着拐。这里按阅读顺序排： - **主干永远是一条直线。** first-parent 链固定在 lane 0，其他分支不会把它推来推去；没有新提交时，它就停在最后一个主干提交。 - **一个分支，一条右侧轨道。** 分支从分叉点斜着离开主干，之后沿自己的 lane 竖直生长；分支比主干新，就自然地高出主干。 - **合并把线收回主干。** merge 提交落在主干上，第二父回接分支，主干同时补到合并的高度。 - **已合并且落后于主干的引用只保留标签。** 不再为它长出空轨道；刚创建、还没有提交的分支也只有一个标签和一个空心端点。 - **点一条线，就高亮整条分支。** 其他路径变淡，流动方向是旧提交 → 新提交；`Enter` / 空格选择，`Esc` 取消。

## 安装 ### DSH 仓库根目录就是一个标准 DSH 插件包：`package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`、`dsh.client` 与 `engines.dsh`。 **从「发现」安装（推荐）**：打开 **插件 → 实验性插件 → 更多 → 自定义插件市场**，添加索引源： ```text https://leonz666.github.io/dsh-gitworktree-gui/market/index.json ``` 然后在 **发现** 里搜索「Git 工作树面板」点安装。 **直接安装**（插件页或 `plugin_manager` 工具）： ```text plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=dsh-gitworktree-gui ``` | target 形式 | 适用场景 | | --- | --- | | `dsh-gitworktree-gui` | npm 上的已发布版本 | | `git+https://github.com/LeonZ666/dsh-gitworktree-gui.git` | 直接安装当前 `main`（不要用 `github:` 简写，匿名用户会走 SSH） | | `/绝对路径/dsh-gitworktree-gui-0.6.0.tgz` | 离线包，仓库根执行 `npm pack` 得到 | | `/绝对路径/dsh-gitworktree-gui` | 本地源码，`link:` 安装，改代码即时生效 | 非桌面 profile 也可以用终端： ```sh dsh plugin --profile add dsh-gitworktree-gui ``` `engines.dsh` 要求 `>=0.2.1-rc.2`，不满足时安装会被拒绝并回滚。装好后刷新 Web 页面；宿主入口 `index.js` 的改动需要重开 DSH。 ### Codex ```sh npm ci npm run build:codex codex plugin marketplace add . codex plugin add git-worktree-panel@local-git-worktree ``` 然后在目标项目的聊天里发一句：**打开当前项目的 Git 工作树面板**。这是聊天指令，没有同名菜单按钮。 ### Claude Code / Claude 桌面端 需要函数钩子模块与 `$.ui` Pane API；普通 Claude 网页聊天不在适配范围。 ```sh claude plugin validate . claude plugin test . claude --plugin-dir "/绝对路径/dsh-gitworktree-gui" ``` 或在支持该 API 的交互会话里：`/plugin marketplace add /绝对路径/dsh-gitworktree-gui`，再 `/plugin install git-worktree-gui@dsh-gitworktree-gui`。 ## 用起来 1. **DSH**：点会话头部右上角的 Git 图标，面板作为右栏标签打开；**Codex**：发送上面的聊天指令；**Claude**：`/git-worktrees`。 2. 默认读取当前会话目录。在 WORKTREES 里点别的工作树，只切换「看哪棵树」，不执行 checkout，也不改变聊天的工作目录。 3. 点提交看详情，点线段选路径；「返回会话工作区」回到默认目录，关闭标签页即停止轮询。 4. 目录还没 `git init` 时，面板会给出提示；初始化后点「已初始化，重新读取」。插件不会替你初始化或修改仓库。
更新与卸载 **DSH**：用新 spec 再执行一次 `install_bundle`；同名包已安装时先卸载再装。停用与卸载： ```text plugin_manager action=set_bundle target=dsh-gitworktree-gui enabled=false plugin_manager action=remove_bundle target=dsh-gitworktree-gui ``` **Codex**：重新 `npm run build:codex` 后执行 `codex plugin add git-worktree-panel@local-git-worktree`；卸载用 `codex plugin remove git-worktree-panel@local-git-worktree`。 **Claude**：`/plugin uninstall git-worktree-gui@dsh-gitworktree-gui`；临时加载方式下次启动不传 `--plugin-dir` 即可。
## 三端能力 | 能力 | DSH | Codex | Claude | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 拓扑、工作树、改动、文件树 | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | | 常驻入口 | 会话头部图标 | 聊天指令 | `/git-worktrees` + 状态栏摘要 | | 点击线段高亮 / 流动动画 | ✓ | ✓ | — | | 悬停分支卡、提交详情与 diff | ✓ | ✓ | — | | 刷新 | 打开时 5s 轮询，隐藏页暂停 | 同左 | 打开时 5s，工具调用后再刷新 | 共享逻辑在 [`lib/core.js`](lib/core.js)：DSH 用 HTTP 适配器 [`index.js`](index.js)，Codex 用 [`codex/`](codex/)，Claude 用 [`hooks/register.tsx`](hooks/register.tsx)。Claude 侧的 Pane 是独立渲染，暂不包含路径动画、悬停卡和提交差异。 ## 安全边界 - **只读。** 不提交、不切分支、不合并、不删除工作树、不初始化仓库。 - **不拼 shell。** DSH / Codex 用固定参数的 `execFile`，Claude 用 `$.process.run` 参数数组，Git 命令带超时。 - **只在本机。** DSH / Codex 的 HTTP 接口要求 loopback 连接与 loopback `Host`；DSH 只放行 `allowedRoots` 内的显式路径，会话 cwd 由宿主解析；Codex 额外校验同源，只提供固定静态资源。 - **有上限。** 采集 120 个提交、700 个文件；提交详情最多 300 个文件，单文件 diff 最多 128 KiB / 1200 行，超出会明示截断。 - **读失败不等于干净。** Git 出错时保留同一目标的旧快照并标记过期，不会把读取失败显示成「没有改动」。 ## 隐私与数据 - 插件不收集、不上传任何数据，也没有遥测；除本机 loopback 路由外不发网络请求。 - 不写入你的仓库：只读 Git 状态，不 checkout、不 commit、不建删工作树、不初始化仓库。 - 唯一持久化是浏览器 `localStorage` 里的「当前查看路径」（按会话隔离）；关闭标签或清除浏览器数据即消失。 - 默认配置为空：没有预置仓库、没有作者目录，面板默认读当前会话的工作目录。
配置：默认仓库与可点击范围 DSH 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里可以为这一行补配置；两个键都可选。 ```yaml - insert: - id: dsh-gitworktree-gui name: dsh-gitworktree-gui config: repo: /绝对路径/项目 allowedRoots: - /绝对路径/项目所在目录 ``` `repo` 是会话路径解析不到时的兜底目录；`allowedRoots` 限制显式选择路径的范围，默认是用户主目录。会话自己的 cwd 由宿主解析，优先于兜底仓库，且不受「显式路径」围栏限制。
图谱间距与布局规范 几何尺寸统一定义在客户端的 `GRAPH_SPACING`，DSH 与 Codex 共用： | 项目 | 尺寸 | | --- | --- | | 相邻轨道中心距 | 32px | | 主干左侧留白 | 20px | | 文字区域最小宽度 | 200px | | 有标签 / 无标签提交行距 | 60px / 44px | | 无独立提交的分支行距 | 48px | | 单轨道转弯高度 | 32px，跨轨每多一轨 +8px | 轨道变多时扩展图谱宽度，不压缩字号；窄侧栏只让图区横向滚动。提交按 `--topo-order` 排列，布局在拓扑候选间做有界交换以减少交叉，但不保证复杂 DAG 完全没有交叉。
常见问题 | 现象 | 检查方法 | | --- | --- | | DSH 里看不到 Git 图标 | 确认 bundle 已选入、页面已刷新；改过宿主代码就重开 DSH | | 打开面板提示「不是 Git 仓库」 | 目标目录没有 `.git`；`git init` 后点「已初始化，重新读取」 | | 路径被拒绝（403） | DSH 检查 `allowedRoots`，Codex 只允许启动项目与启动时已有的工作树 | | Codex 找不到入口 | 入口是聊天指令；用 `codex plugin list` 确认安装，必要时重新加载 skill | | 更新后还是旧界面 | 区分源码与安装副本：Codex 重新构建并重启旧服务，DSH 重载宿主 | | 启动报缺少 `dist/server.mjs` | 在仓库根执行 `npm ci && npm run build:codex` 后再安装 |
## 开发 ```sh npm ci npm run check # 语法检查 npm test # 构建 Codex 页面后跑 Node 回归 npm run market:check # 校验市场索引（docs/market/index.json） ``` 当前 `npm test` 为 65 项，覆盖拓扑布局、路径选择、提交详情、轮询、并发与读取围栏。Codex 侧在合并前用内置浏览器验收过多分支、路径选择、悬停卡、提交详情和窄栏；DSH 侧已验证路由与注册；Claude 侧需要本机 `claude` 环境自行 `validate` / `test`。 包目录里是同一份源码的三个入口：DSH（根目录）、Codex（[`codex/`](codex/)）、Claude（[`.claude-plugin/`](.claude-plugin/) + [`hooks/`](hooks/)）。`npm pack` 只带运行所需文件，可直接作为上面的 tarball target 安装。 ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

decision.reason: Static evidence chain reviewed. Exact npm gitHead, MIT and DSH at least 0.2.1-rc.2 match the native Host/client bundle. Three-file closure captured. Host checks socket loopback and Host, canonicalizes allowed roots and uses fixed execFile Git arguments for status; it does not expose a generic shell command. Default home-root visibility should still be narrowed by operators. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

capability.invocation: Boot the profile's Web GUI and read the first frame from the page: document.documentElement.classList.contains('dshboot-on') on the way in, then #dshboot-host and its shadowRoot's #stage/#boot once parsed. Replay: GET /__boot-compass/window answers {ok, visible, iconic, epoch, kind, at, hiddenFor}; hide the window to the tray and reopen it to see epoch advance.
capability.expected: The host half's CSS-only cover lands while <head> is still parsing, so DSH's [data-dsh-boot] card is never visible. The splash then mounts in a shadow root and retires the cover on the same task, plays its five stages to completion, and releases at the HOLD frame (0.84) only if the app is not yet ready. Reopening a window that was really hidden (tray) or minimized replays the whole sequence; a window that was merely covered by another application does not, and on platforms without a window-state reader the replay is simply absent.
